author: Hayley Tsukayama
title: Why VPNs Are Worth Defending
content:
Developers of virtual private network (VPN) apps are reporting that their products are again being pulled from Apple’s App Store in Russia. This is an unacceptable crackdown on a vital tool to protect privacy and speech online.

Why? VPNs give people a way to control their own online activities. When you visit a website through a VPN, that website only sees the VPN server's location (well, IP address) rather than your actual location. It's like sending a letter through a P.O. box so the recipient doesn't know where you really live. It can also disguise where you’re accessing information from, which can make it possible to access information banned by your government.

This is an unacceptable crackdown on a vital tool to protect privacy and speech online.

Going after tools that give people the space to communicate and access information freely is a common tactic from the totalitarian playbook. This latest demand comes after several steps the Russian government’s taken to surveil speech specifically on Apple products. In 2024, the Moscow Times reported that Russia’s state media watchdog, Roskomnadzor, went after VPN apps on the Apple App Store, after banning access to Western social media platforms and blacklisting opposition media sites. Russia then blocked Apple’s FaceTime software in 2025, according to Apple Insider.

Bloomberg also recently reported that the Russian government has added Apple and Microsoft to its state surveillance registry. This gives Roskomnadzor access to local users’ correspondence, Apple Insider reported, and puts both companies in a position to turn over customer information to the country’s security services as required.

With government control encroaching on their devices and less access to tools that give them alternate methods, people in Russia are left with shrinking options to communicate online or find information that isn’t state-sanctioned.

While Russia’s actions offer a more extreme vision of what happens when the government tries to enforce speech rules by attacking vital privacy tools, it is far from the only government doing so. Several states in the U.S., bent on making it difficult to circumvent invasive age-gating laws, have suggested banning VPNs—either to access certain content or in some cases to simply ban them outright. EFF has publicly (and loudly) criticized these proposals, because going after VPNs is a dangerous step down the road of censorship.

Attacks on speech and privacy online are deeply troubling, no matter where they happen. What those in power may see as a “loophole” in their invasive laws is actually an expression of user control. We’ll continue to speak out when we see governments going after them to take that control away.

author: By Elvis Takahashi Mantello, Contributor
title: Inside Rouvikonas’ Push to Build a Nationwide Movement
content:
Athens, Greece — Best known for its direct actions in Greece’s capitol city, the anti-authoritarian collective

Rouvikonas

 has increasingly expanded beyond Athens. Over the past year, the collective has established a presence in Thessaloniki and Larissa, as well as in other parts of the country.


Their expansion, which includes mutual aid projects and volunteer firefighting, comes as they face new challenges including state repression. Greek Justice Minister Giorgos Floridis recently described

Rouvikonas

 as a “

criminal organization

,” arguing that its activities warranted consolidating criminal case files across the country, as had been done in the case of Golden Dawn.


Rouvikonas has rejected the characterization

, describing the government’s actions as

another

 attack by the Greek state who is attempting to quell their popular buildup. Unicorn Riot sat down with several members of the collective to learn more – see the

video

 below.


History and Expansion


Rouvikonas emerged in 2013, as Greece was still grappling with the aftermath of its financial crisis and years of austerity. Its name refers to crossing the Rubicon, the point of no return. Its signature phrase is “Not a Step Back.”


In the years following massive mobilization and civil expression, Rouvikonas maintained its political activity through direct action while building connections beyond traditional anarchist circles.


In recent years, Rouvikonas has gained greater public recognition and built a social media following of tens of thousands.


“The aim is one day to have a nationwide organization,” says Luka, a member of Rouvikonas. “We want common people, people from the working class, from the social base to join.”


This aim forces the collective to rethink how it organizes and builds relationships with emerging groups outside the capital.


Related:

Passing the Point of No Return: Interview with Rouvikonas Anarchist Collective


K-Vox: The Base


This year, K-Vox, a squat in the Exarcheia district of Athens where political history has made it synonymous with resistance, marked its

14th anniversary

 with several days of cultural events and open political discussions.


A rap performance inside K-Vox during its 14th-anniversary celebration, April 17, 2026. Photo contributed by Elvis Takahashi Mantello.


On a typical week, K-Vox operates as a bar and social space, drawing a mix of residents, activists and foreigners. Its walls echo histories of various movements beyond Greece, with murals and posters referencing the Paris Commune, Nestor Makhno’s Black Army and other revolutionary movements. Housed on the side of the building is a

free healthcare clinic

. The political character of the space is hard to miss.


But K-Vox is not a sanctuary free from external pressure. Riot police carrying shields, stun grenades, tear gas grenades and service pistols are stationed only a few hundred meters away. At the same time, metal barricades obscure what was once a

community park at Exarcheia Square

, now surrounded by construction for a new metro station.


A front view of K-Vox and the metro barricades along the streets of Exarcheia Square. Photo contributed by Elvis Takahashi Mantello.


Past coverage:

Altering Exarcheia From the Square to Strefi Hill: A Timeline and Film


And for years K-Vox has faced the threat of eviction. When the current government came to power in 2019,

cracking down on squats

 was among its

stated priorities

.


According to Periklis, a veteran member of Rouvikonas, authorities have tried to pressure or remove K-Vox over the years but have never successfully evicted the squat, even as they cleared other spaces.


Periklis argues that the government and police have struggled to confront Rouvikonas because the collective has broader support in society. Even if the government removed the space, he said, the movement behind it would remain.


The collective has responded by maintaining its everyday activities, said Periklis. This continuity is central to Rouvikonas’ relationship with the wider community. K-Vox functions not only as a space for political organizing but also as a means of sustaining the group’s social base.


From Base to Network


Rouvikonas establishes support through its social centers, providing practical assistance to people in need, from food to medical care. These activities have helped the collective build connections beyond its traditional political base.

author: David Swanson
title: The 10 Worst Congressional Excuses for Voting for More Military Spending
content:
Economic Cost, Immorality, Law, Myth of Necessity, North America, What to do

By David Swanson, World BEYOND War, October 30, 2026

Every year for many years now, the bitterly divided, grid-locked, virtually civil-war-waging United States Congress (as it’s commonly depicted) has harmoniously voted for vastly more money in war spending than it had done the year before. Our lords and misrepresentatives are threatening the same again right now.

It’s a heartwarming story of cooperation and understanding, no doubt, but how can you, as an elected official, explain to constituents living third-world lives in a wealthy nation that, not only can you not tax the rich or the corporations, but you also cannot afford to fund education, energy, environment, transportation, retirement, healthcare, or housing because the weapons dealers just want more and more?

The trick, of course, in most cases is to keep your head down and your mouth shut until a bigger military spending bill than last year’s is guaranteed to pass no matter how you vote, and then vote No. You’ll be untouchable. It’s golden. You won’t have publicly organized your colleagues or used various available procedures to actually try to reduce the war spending, but you’ll have an “I voted No” shield, and that’s all you’ll need. Constituents will fall for it without fooling any weapons dealers.

But what if it’s your turn? What if you’ve drawn the short string this year? What if you can either vote Yes or anger your party’s “leader”?

Never fear! That’s what this handy guide is for! Here are 10 popular categories of excuses that have proven effective through the past quarter-century.

You can easily depict an increase to military spending as a decrease if it’s a smaller increase than someone — ideally the president — had initially proposed. This one is in the works right now and may prove very successful. A variation on this is to claim that the bad political party (the one you’re not in) would have gotten a larger increase if you hadn’t hurried or stalled, depending on which party is gaining or losing a majority.

Almost foolproof is the oft-used explanation that you focused your efforts on doing exactly what the peace activists wanted by removing some nasty section from the bill. “You didn’t want the U.S. and Israeli militaries to merge. You said to only vote for the bill if that was removed. We got it removed on condition that we vote for the bill. This is how things work in the real world.” This excuse gets a 5 out of 5 on Yelp. Anyone who objects is a silly dreamer, so you need not address their concerns.

Almost matching the batting record of #2 (removing something) is adding something. It hardly matters how absurd the thing or how out of place in an institution of mass-murder and destruction, as long as it’s humanitarian. Create an agency of environmentally sustainable carpet bombing, or eliminate discrimination against transgendered pilots, or establish a proactive contracting program to minority-owned surveillance companies. Whatever. Anyone who objects will be objecting to that thing you voted for. You should be clear that it is only that thing for which you voted; nothing else exists.

If you cannot use the top three steaming turds of the coming apocalypse, or don’t have time to come up with anything concrete, just fall back on troopism. You voted to fund the troops. Anyone objecting hates the troops, wants the troops left in the wars but their armor and weaponry carefully collected and brought home without them. If you can, grab an actual troop or three to stand in front of and ask one of them to slap you in the face really quickly until there are tears visible in your eyes before the cameras are ready.

Numerous other excuses can work beautifully, depending on the circumstances. There’s always a most-unpopular war among the current wars. Right now, for example, some people are more upset about the crumbs going to the war on Iran than about the mountain of loafs going to the Pentagon in its entirety. So, here’s what you do. You make getting a war powers resolution on Iran vetoed part of a grand bargain in which you vote for the money to create 10 more similar wars. Or you join in a lawsuit against the war on Iran. Or you actually include in the spending bill or elsewhere a ban on spending money on that particular crime — but make clear to everyone that it’s part of a grand bargain on a 4-D chessboard. You voted for increased war money FOR PEACE and so that …

author: Mag
title: Rentabilität vor Sicherheit: Spanische Eisenbahngewerkschaften protestieren nach wiederholten tödlichen Unfällen
content:
Dossier


Nach dem Zugunglück in Adamuz (Córdoba) am 18. Januar 2026 und dem Unfall der Rodalies-Bahn in Gelida (Barcelona) kurz darauf hat die spanische Eisenbahngewerkschaft Semaf in einer Erklärung angekündigt, dass sie die für die Sicherheit der Eisenbahninfrastruktur verantwortlichen Personen strafrechtlich zur Verantwortung ziehen werde und dass die Aufnahme des Betriebs in Katalonien nicht ohne ausreichende Sicherheitsgarantien für den Verkehr erfolgen werde. Die Gewerkschaft hat zudem für den 9., 10. und 11. Februar 2026 zu einem Generalstreik im Eisenbahnsektor aufgerufen, dem sich auch Sector Federal Ferroviario der CGT und Sindicato Ferroviario der Intersindical anschließen. Siehe diese Erklärungen und weitere Informationen zur Kritik am Bahnprivatisierungsprogramm auch in Spanien – sowie einen erneuten Unfall:


Ein noch größeres Zugunglück in Spanien am Tag vor Streiks gegen den unveränderten Verfall des Bahnnetzes als Ursache der tödlichen Unfälle im Februar 2026 führt zu weiteren Streikaufrufen


[„Es ist der Aufschrei der Belegschaften aller Eisenbahnunternehmen“

]

Wir werden nicht auf den nächsten Unfall warten – SFF-CGT ruft zu Streiks bei der Bahn auf


„

Nach den Unfällen in Adamuz, Gélida und Urda kann der Bahnbetrieb nicht länger mit Notlösungen weitergeführt werden. Sicherheit erfordert ausreichendes Personal, Wartung, Schulungen, Investitionen und menschenwürdige Arbeitsbedingungen.


Wir von der SFF-CGT leiten die rechtlichen Schritte ein, um Streiks im Eisenbahnsektor auszurufen. Es ist an der Zeit, echte Lösungen einzufordern und die Zukunft der Eisenbahn zu verteidigen!


Nach den Unfällen in Adamuz und Gélida haben wir gesagt, dass die Bahn nicht weiter darauf warten darf, dass sich eine Tragödie ereignet, um über Sicherheit zu sprechen. Monate später konfrontiert uns der schwere Unfall in Urda erneut mit einer Realität, die wir nicht ignorieren können.


DAS PROBLEM IST NACH WIE VOR DAS MODELL (…)


Deshalb wollen wir kein weiteres Abkommen voller guter Absichten, Arbeitsgruppen und Teilmaßnahmen, das die Probleme wieder auf morgen verschiebt. Wir wollen ausreichend Personal, angemessene Ausbildung und Erfahrung, echte Investitionen in die Instandhaltung, eine Entlastung bei der Arbeitsbelastung, ausreichende Mittel, um unter normalen Bedingungen zu arbeiten und zu reagieren, wenn diese nicht mehr gegeben sind, sowie eine wirksame Regelung hinsichtlich Ermüdung, Arbeitszeiten und Ruhepausen.


WIR GEHEN WIEDER IN DEN STREIK (…)


Die SFF-CGT hat die rechtlichen Schritte eingeleitet, um Streiks bei der Bahn auszurufen und konkrete Maßnahmen zu fordern, mit denen die Probleme angegangen werden, auf die wir schon viel zu lange hingewiesen haben. Wir fordern die übrigen Gewerkschaften auf, sich dieser Mobilisierung zur Verteidigung der Belegschaft und der Bahn anzuschließen. Das ist nicht nur der Wille unserer Mitglieder: Es ist der Aufschrei der Belegschaften aller Eisenbahnunternehmen.


Denn Sicherheit entsteht nicht dadurch, dass man sich mit dem Verkehrsminister fotografieren lässt, keine Notlösungen zu ergreifen oder nach jedem Unfall Maßnahmen anzukündigen, um die Wogen zu glätten. Sicherheit entsteht durch Personal, Ressourcen, Ausbildung, Erfahrung, Instandhaltung und Arbeitsbedingungen, die es denjenigen, die den Bahnbetrieb aufrechterhalten, ermöglichen, ihre Arbeit unter sicheren Bedingungen zu verrichten

.“ span.

Pressemitteilung vom Sector Federal Ferroviario de la CGT am 30.10.2026


 (maschinenübersetzt)


Tödlicher Wettbewerb. Spanien: Zugunglück bedeutet Rückschlag für Premier Sánchez mitten im Wahlkampf. Seine Partei ist mitverantwortlich für Liberalisierung der Bahn

Mit dem Streik wollten die Eisenbahner verbesserte Sicherheitsmaßnahmen durchsetzen. Nun kollidierten in Urda in der Provinz Toledo zwei Hochgeschwindigkeitszüge – nachdem das Sicherheitssystem ausgefallen war. Bei dem Unglück kamen 69 Menschen ums Leben, über hundert wurden verletzt, mehr als ein Dutzend schwebte am Donnerstag in Lebensgefahr. Es handelt sich um eines der schwersten Zugunglücke in der Geschichte Spaniens, die Regierung in Madrid hat drei Tage Staatstrauer angeordnet. author: webdev@democracynow.org (Democracy Now!)
title: "Ungrounding": Eyal Weizman on Gaza Genocide & Israel's "Permanent Architecture of Control"
content:
We speak with Forensic Architecture’s Eyal Weizman about his new book,

Ungrounding: The Architecture of Genocide

, a meticulous investigation into Israel’s genocide in Gaza, the physical destruction of the territory and its impact on the Palestinian people.


Forensic Architecture was founded in 2010 as an interdisciplinary research group focused on investigating state violence and human rights violations. Since 2023, Forensic Architecture has focused on producing evidence for South Africa’s genocide case against Israel at the International Court of Justice.


Weizman says “ungrounding” is “a kind of destruction that we have not seen anywhere else,” with Israeli bulldozers “terraforming” the landscape to erase all traces of Palestinian life. With thousands of bodies still unrecovered from under destroyed buildings, Israel’s flattening, extraction and reshaping of the rubble in Gaza is a continuation of its crimes, says Weizman.


“Israel is actively and against court order, against the order of the

ICJ

, destroying the evidence of the genocide that it has perpetrated,” he says.

author: TGEU
title: Trans activists and stakeholders gather at TGEU’s Pre-Council to advance trans rights in Eastern Europe and Central Asia
content:
On 9-10 September in Ljubljana, Slovenia, 27 trans activists from Eastern Europe and Central Asia (EECA) and international stakeholders came together to ask one question: how do we protect trans people in a region where democracy and human rights are deteriorating?


The second TGEU Pre-Council Strategic Meeting on Trans Rights in EECA took place ahead of TGEU’s 10th European and Central Asian Trans Council. Over two days, participants analysed the rapidly changing political and legal environment, exchanged lessons learned, and explored ways to strengthen cooperation, joint advocacy and coordinated action.

 


The Strategic Meeting brought together three groups with different but complementary types of expertise and mandates: 


EECA trans activists with direct experience working with communities and conducting national advocacy


International stakeholders working on human rights and the rule of law


Allied movement leaders engaged in human rights protection.


Together, they aimed to build a shared understanding of key challenges and possible responses, identify political and legal leverage points for 2026–2027, and strengthen trust and cooperation.


Key takeaways


Participants shared strategies for responding to anti-trans policies.


They explored practical approaches to depathologisation and healthcare, and how strategic litigation can drive wider legal and social change.


TGEU will follow up on the priorities, requests and commitments that emerged, including by connecting participants with international organisations.


The Pre-Council was intended not as a stand-alone meeting, but as a point for continued exchange and action.


A region under pressure 


Across EECA,  trans people are being used as scapegoats to reinforce authoritarian power and control. Trans people are portrayed as a threat to ‘national identity and values’ or ‘women and children’ within a broader and increasingly coordinated anti-gender discourse. 


Pressure from authoritarian states and anti-gender forces is growing alongside:


Laws and policies that increasingly target civil society


War and armed conflict


Cuts to funding for civil society programmes


Increasingly unsafe conditions for trans human rights defenders


Limited opportunities to protect rights through national and international human rights mechanisms


Transforming exchange into action 


Rather than simply sharing information, the meeting focused on turning shared experiences into action.


Participants discussed specific examples from different countries, exchanged tried-and-tested strategies, and learned more about the work of the Council of Europe, the OHCHR, the UN Human Rights Committee, and international human rights organisations. They examined examples of solidarity with other civil society movements and explored practical approaches to improving healthcare for trans people and strengthening their autonomy, including the role of ICD-11 and WPATH standards.


They also mapped alliances, explored the potential of strategic litigation, identified concrete opportunities for collaboration, and had a forum where various actors could ask questions and get practical answers.


The discussions strengthened a sense of regional solidarity and created a space for new partnerships and commitments to emerge. 


What happens next 


In the coming months, TGEU will stay in contact with participants and support follow-up on the priorities, requests and commitments that emerged during the discussions. 


This will include facilitating connections between participants and relevant branches of international organisations interested in further collaboration, including opportunities for strategic litigation. 


TGEU will also continue to monitor cross-sectoral and international health-related initiatives and processes to identify relevant developments early and connect EECA activists with stakeholders in advance, so they can engage strategically and contribute their perspectives. 


Your support makes change possible


We work across Europe and Central Asia to advance trans rights, build strong communities, and drive change through research, advocacy, and community-building.


Your donation helps us continue this vital work — defending trans lives, amplifying trans voices, and advocating for justice every day.

author: Konstantinos Kontis
title: The Psychotherapist as a Paid “Fantasy-Friend”: The Taboo of Money and Payment in Therapy
content:
T

his text consists of a series of reflections that arose and developed from two events—one personal, the other relayed to me—concerning the act of payment in psychotherapy as well as the therapists’ own attitudes toward it.


The two incidents are the following:


My psychotherapist was quite clear and strict. Payment is made in cash at the end of the session—50 euros—and it’s best to have the exact amount. One day I had 60 euros (I can’t recall the reason for this “oversight” of mine), which obviously would have required her to give me 10 euros in change. At the time of payment, when I showed her the three 20-euro bills and told her that unfortunately I didn’t have the exact amount, I noticed an expression of obvious uneasiness on her face as she hurriedly opened her wallet and handed me the change for this transaction. This reaction struck me as particularly odd, as if she preferred to avoid such minor interactions in her psychotherapeutic practice.


The following incident was communicated to me by a friend. During a session in a psychoanalytic training program, the training psychoanalyst noted that payment in psychotherapy is of the utmost importance and must always be required. In one instance where a patient of his could not pay, the psychoanalyst urged him to take a day job at the Varvakios Market (the biggest market in Greece) so that he could raise the necessary amount to continue therapy. When the patient asked the psychoanalyst if he himself would go to do such labor, the analyst replied that he certainly would, but simply did not have the time. Note that the analyst charges 70 euros per session.


I think these two incidents demonstrate, in their own way, that the issue of payment in psychotherapy is treated somewhat paradoxically and ambivalently. On the one hand, it is considered important and is treated with (sometimes inflexible) strictness; on the other hand, it can be an extremely uncomfortable topic, capable of “contaminating” the therapeutic process itself and is sometimes met with evasiveness on the part of the therapist, if addressed at all.


One reason, I believe, that payment is an uncomfortable topic is that it represents an intrusion of the outside world into the supposedly pure intersubjectivity of the therapeutic process. In a 50-minute session, various processes may have unfolded; the client may have cried, been moved, gotten angry, relived traumatic moments, and/or simply gotten bored, irritated, etc. The session ends, and after all these moments, the client opens their wallet and hands over (in my case, I was leaving the money on the table) the payment for all these processes, usually with a serious, if not cold, gesture. One can’t help but feel that one has purchased either a kind of empathy or, more often than not, a technical service (of which compassion is merely one component) and wonder whether all the preceding reactions, transference, and psychological processes would occur, if they were not accompanied by this transaction.


I think we could insert here some thoughts expressed (better than I or anyone else could put them) by David Foster Wallace (1999) in his story “The Depressed Person,” in which he describes the psychotherapy of a woman suffering from depression:


“[…] the depressed person shared long-distance, she had discovered and struggled in therapy to work through her feeling that it was ironic and demeaning, given her parents’ dysfunctional preoccupation with money and all that that preoccupation had cost her as a child, that she was now, as an adult, in the position of having to pay a therapist $90 an hour to listen patiently to her and respond honestly and empathetically; i.e., it felt demeaning and pathetic to feel forced to buy patience and empathy […]. The depressed person also knew perfectly well, she had acknowledged, that it was in fact the $90 an hour which made the therapeutic relationship’s simulacrum of friendship so ideally one-sided: i.e. the only expectation or demand the therapist placed on the depressed person was for the contracted hourly $90; after that one demand was satisfied, everything in the relationship got to be for and about the depressed person […] and yet the depressed person confessed to the therapist that she nevertheless still felt, on a more basic, emotionally intuitive or “gut” level, that it truly was demeaning and insulting and pathetic that her chronic emotional pain and isolation and inability to reach out forced her to spend …

author: CNT Valencia
title: CNT sigue su expansión en el sector del transporte con una nueva sección sindical en la empresa Trasn Ruiz Aparicio
content:
CNT ha constituido una nueva sección sindical en la empresa Trans Ruiz Aparicio ampliando así su implantación en el sector del transporte de mercancías. La nueva sección sindical ha solicitado ya una reunión a la Dirección de la empresa que esperan celebrar antes del 31 de octubre.


En ella, además de la presentación de los representantes sindicales y la designación de interlocutores válidos para el diálogo y la negociación, se abordarán diferentes cuestiones que afectan a la plantilla.


Entre otras cuestiones se abordarán la superación de la jornada anual y el devengo de horas extraordinarias así como el trabajo en festivos


Del mismo modo, los representantes del sindicato pretenden abordar cuestiones como la aplicación del convenio colectivo en diferentes materias y otros asuntos relevantes para la plantilla.


La intención de la nueva sección sindical es iniciar la andadura en la empresa de una forma cordial, cercana y colaborativa, consensuando con la Dirección fórmulas que favorezcan un buen ambiente.


Además, dado el tamaño de la empresa y que no existe representación unitaria, la sección sindical pretende servir de vía para canalizar las reivindicaciones y defender los intereses de la amplia afiliación que CNT ya dispone en la empresa.

author: Unknown
title: Ballon d’Or’da "sonuçlar sızdırıldı" şüphesi: 200 bin dolarlık bahis inceleme altında
content:
Ballon d’Or (Altın Top) ödülünde ilk beş sırayı eksiksiz tahmin ederek yaklaşık 200 bin dolar kazanç sağlayan şüpheli bahisler üzerine soruşturma başlatıldı. Organizasyonu düzenleyen France Football’un, sonuçların tören öncesinde sızdırılmış olabileceği şüphesiyle konuyu incelemeye aldığı ve polisle de temasa geçtiği belirtildi.

Fransa merkezli medya kuruluşu Upside’ın araştırmasına göre, kripto para tabanlı tahmin platformu Polymarket’teki 12 hesap, pazartesi günkü törenden önce sonuçlar üzerine toplam 264 bin doların üzerinde bahis oynadı. Hesaplar, farklı ihtimallere dağılmak yerine Harry Kane’in birinci, Kylian Mbappé’nin ikinci, Lamine Yamal’ın üçüncü, Rodri’nin dördüncü ve Lionel Messi’nin beşinci olacağı sıralamaya odaklandı. Londra Palladium’daki törende açıklanan sonuçlar bu tahminlerle birebir örtüştü.

Upside’ın kurucu ortağı Raphaël Pautard, söz konusu hesapların 1–20 Ekim arasında açıldığını ve birbirlerine oldukça benzeyen işlem örüntüleri sergilediğini söyledi. Bu benzerlikler, hesapların aynı kişi ya da grupla bağlantılı olabileceği şüphesini doğurdu. İncelenen 12 hesaptan yedisinin başka hiçbir bahis piyasasında işlem yapmadığı, altısının ise açıldıktan yalnızca 15 dakika sonra ilk bahislerini oynadığı belirlendi.

Araştırmada, şüpheli bahislerin finansmanında kullanılan işlemlerden birinin izi Fransa merkezli bir platforma kadar sürüldü. Pautard’ın aktardığına göre Upside ekibi, ilgili blokzincir işlemlerini ve dijital cüzdan adreslerini şirketle paylaştı. Platform da bahisleri finanse eden hesaplardan birinin arkasındaki kişinin kimliğini tespit ettiğini bildirdi. Kimliği kamuoyuna açıklanmayan bu kişinin belirlenmesinin, hesaplar arasındaki bağlantıların ve para akışının ortaya çıkarılmasına yardımcı olabileceği ifade edildi.

İşlemlerin zamanlaması ve bahis stratejisindeki değişiklikler de incelemede dikkat çekti. Bir hesabın, Kane’in kazanacağına ilişkin kontratı 37 sentten satın aldığı, fiyat 67 sente yükseldiğinde sattığı ve elde ettiği parayı belirli sıralamalara yönelik bahislere aktardığı kaydedildi. Bu bahisler arasında Yamal’ın üçüncü olacağı tahmini de bulunuyordu.

Bulgularını France Football’a ileten Upside’ın, cuma öğleden sonra soruşturma açıldığına ilişkin teyit aldığı belirtildi. Groupe Amaury bünyesindeki France Football, ödülü 1956’dan bu yana düzenliyor. Kuruluştan konuya ilişkin yorum istendiği de aktarıldı.

Tören öncesinde kazananı yalnızca birkaç kişinin bildiğinin açıklanmış olması, olası bilgi sızıntısına ilişkin kuşkuları artırdı. Eski France Football editörü Pascal Ferré de önceki hafta, kazananın kimliğini gizli tutmanın yolunun bilgiyi mümkün olduğunca az kişiyle paylaşmak olduğunu söylemişti.

31 yıldır emeğin sesi olan Evrensel, gücünü sadece okurlarından alıyor. Emeğin sesinin daha gür çıkması için sen de güç ver.

author: Unknown
title: Muş'un Xwarik köylüleri mera savunmasında: JES projesine direnişin 180. günü
content:
Muş'un Varto/Gimgim ilçesine bağlı Çalıdere/Xwarik köyünde, ABD şirketi IGNIS H2 Enerji Üretim AŞ'nin jeotermal kaynak arama projesine karşı çadır nöbeti, Jinnews'ın haberine göre 180. gününe girdi. 


3 Mayıs'ta başlatılan direnişte köylüler, projenin su kaynaklarına, meralara, hayvancılığa ve doğal yaşama zarar vermemesi için sondaj faaliyetlerinin durdurulmasını istiyor.


Varto Ekoloji Platformu Gençlik Meclisi öncülüğünde sürdürülen nöbeti cuma günü Segiran, Dapak ve Muzuran köylüleri devraldı. Nöbet alanında "Varto halkı jeotermal enerji santrali istemiyor. Suyuma, toprağıma dokunma" pankartı taşındı.


2 Kasım'da gerçekleştirilecek bilirkişi keşfi öncesinde direnişin 180'inci gününe ulaşması, bölgedeki hareketliliği artırdı. Köylüler ve ekoloji örgütleri, Bingöl İdare Mahkemesi'nin yaptıracağı incelemede bölgenin doğal ve toplumsal özelliklerinin dikkate alınmasını istiyor.


Bakanlık: Jeolojik ve hidrojeolojik veriler eksik


Köylülerin su kaynaklarına yönelik kaygıları, Tarım ve Orman Bakanlığının 21 Ekim'de TBMM'ye gönderdiği resmî yanıtta yer alan eksikliklerle de gündeme geldi.


DEM Parti Muş Milletvekili Sümeyye Boz Çakı'nın 27 Şubat tarihli yazılı soru önergesine sekiz ay sonra yanıt veren Bakanlık, jeotermal arama projesinin tanıtım dosyasında bölgeye ait ayrıntılı jeolojik ve hidrojeolojik verilerin bulunmadığını bildirdi.


Bakanlık, yeraltı su kaynakları ve içme suyu rezervleri üzerindeki olası etkileri değerlendiren hidrojeolojik raporun da sunulmadığını belirterek eksikliklerin giderilmesini ve su temini ile çevre mevzuatına ilişkin gerekli taahhütlerin dosyaya eklenmesini istediğini açıkladı.


Yanıtta, proje alanının Güllüce Regülatörü ve Hidroelektrik Enerji Santrali'nin iletim hattı güzergâhıyla doğrudan etkileşim içinde bulunduğu da belirtildi. Bakanlık, çalışmaların ilgili iletim hattını etkilemeyecek biçimde sınırlandırılması ve sondaj sonrasında Devlet Su İşleri'nden yeniden görüş alınması gerektiğini bildirdi.


Bakanlık, mera tahsislerinde çiftçilerin görüşlerinin dikkate alındığını ve faaliyetlerin çevresel etkilerinin mevzuat çerçevesinde değerlendirildiğini savundu.


Köylüler ise karar süreçlerine yeterince katılamadıklarını ileri sürüyor.


4 bin hektarlık sahada 10 sondaj kuyusu


Şirketin Güzelkent sahası için hazırladığı projede, yaklaşık 4 bin 38 hektarlık ruhsat alanında toplam 10 jeotermal arama kuyusu açılması öngörülüyor. Sondajlar için belirlenen ÇED alanı ise 8 hektar.


2025 tarihli proje bilgilerine göre yaklaşık 95 milyon lira yatırım bedeli öngörülen arama çalışmalarının 20 ay sürmesi, 30 kişinin istihdam edilmesi planlanıyor.


Proje dosyasından aktarılan verilere göre bir sondaj noktası Küçüktepe köyündeki bir konuta yaklaşık 160 metre, bir diğeri Mengeneç Çayı'na 103 metre uzaklıkta bulunuyor. Bazı sondaj noktaları orman alanları içinde yer alıyor.


IGNIS, kendi internet sitesinde Güzelkent sahasının Kuzey Anadolu ve Doğu Anadolu faylarının kesişimine yakın bir bölgede bulunduğunu belirtiyor. Şirket, jeolojik ve jeofizik araştırmalar yürüttüğünü, rezervuar özelliklerini belirlemek amacıyla yeni sondajlar planladığını açıklıyor.


Henüz faaliyette bir elektrik üretim santrali bulunmuyor. Tartışma, ileride santral yatırımına dönüşebilecek jeotermal kaynak arama ve sondaj aşamasında yoğunlaşıyor.


Köylüler jeotermale neden karşı çıkıyor?


Bölgenin başlıca geçim kaynakları hayvancılık, küçük ölçekli tarım ve arıcılık. Köylüler sondaj sahalarının yalnızca kapladıkları alanla değil, su dolaşımı, otlaklar ve doğal yaşam üzerindeki olası etkileriyle değerlendirilmesini istiyor.


Jeotermal enerji, fosil yakıtlara alternatif yenilenebilir bir kaynak olmakla birlikte, çıkarılan sıcak ve mineralli akışkanların yönetimi özel önlemler gerektiriyor. Kuyuların sızdırmazlığının sağlanamaması, sondaj atıklarının uygunsuz depolanması veya kullanılmış jeotermal akışkanın güvenli biçimde yeniden yeraltına basılamaması halinde su ve toprak kirliliği riski doğabiliyor.


Jeotermal akışkanların kimyasal bileşimi sahadan sahaya değişiyor. Bazı alanlarda bor, arsenik ve çözünmüş başka minerallerin çevreye yayılması tarımsal üretim açısından sorun oluşturabiliyor. Bu risklerin Varto'da gerçekleşip gerçekleşmeyeceği ise saha ölçümleri ve bağımsız bilimsel incelemelerle belirlenmek zorunda.


Sondaj ve akışkan enjeksiyonunun fay sistemleri üzerindeki olası etkileri de bölge halkının itirazları arasında. Jeofizik uzmanları, deprem tehlikesi bulunan alanlarda doğal sismik hareketliliğin …

author: Λουκάς Σταμέλλος
title: Δίκη για τον βασανισμό Μάγγου: Ψεκ αγορεύσεις με χυδαία προσβολή θύματος και γονιών
content:
Σύνδεσμος δημοσίευσης:

Δίκη για τον βασανισμό Μάγγου: Ψεκ αγορεύσεις με χυδαία προσβολή θύματος και γονιών


Φανταστείτε λίγο τα παρακάτω:


***


Ο Βόλος έχει μακρά ιστορία παρουσίας σκληρών αναρχικών. Εκεί, οπαδοί του Κροπότκιν, του Μπακούνιν και του Νετσάγιεφ (μαζί), σε συνεργασία με πράκτορες της Στάζι που μετεγκαταστάθηκαν στη Μαγνησία από τη δεκαετία του ‘90, διατηρούσαν στον νομό δύο γιάφκες της Συνωμοσίας των Πυρήνων της Φωτιάς και έφτιαξαν μια συλλογικότητα που ονομαζόταν «Συντονισμός Συλλογικοτήτων Βόλου Ενάντια στην Καύση Σκουπιδιών», με επικεφαλής και ιδεολογικούς καθοδηγητές – ινστρούκτορες καθηγητές Πανεπιστημίου.


Τη νύχτα της 13ης Ιουνίου 2020, αφού είχαν στείλει υψηλόβαθμους αξιωματικούς στο νοσοκομείο με μπροστάρη τον Βασίλειο Μάγγο, αποπειράθηκαν να καταλάβουν το κτίριο της Διεύθυνσης Αστυνομίας Βόλου αλλά τελικά απωθήθηκαν χάρη στην ηρωϊκή αντίσταση των – εξαντλημένων από τις υπερωρίες και την ανίκανη επιχειρησιακή ηγεσία τους – αστυνομικών.


Το ασήμαντο περιστατικό με το σπάσιμο των πλευρών του Βασίλειου Μάγγου (που δεν ήξεραν ποιος είναι) έξω από τα δικαστήρια, στις 14 Ιουνίου 2020, έτυχε να καταγραφεί σε βίντεο, το οποίο μπορεί να αποκτήσει όσο αντίκτυπο θέλει αυτός που το διακινεί, ασχέτως του τι δείχνει. Για κακή τύχη της Ελληνικής Αστυνομίας, της Δημοκρατίας και της Δικαιοσύνης και προς μεγάλη ικανοποίηση των ηγετών αυτής της συλλογικότητας σκληρών αναρχικών, η οποία ελέγχει και τους δημοσιογράφους στην ΕΡΤ, στο The Press Project και στο OmniaTV, ένα νέο καταχθόνιο σχέδιο αυτών των ολετήρων της Τάξεως τέθηκε σε εφαρμογή.


Κάποιος δημοσίευσε ένα κείμενο καταγγελίας, το οποίο θα ήταν απολύτως αδύνατον να έχει δημοσιεύσει ο ίδιος ο Βασίλειος Μάγγος, επειδή περιείχε πολιτική τοποθέτηση. Οπότε το κείμενο είναι πλαστό εντελώς, αλλά ταυτόχρονα αποτελεί και απόδειξη ότι οι μάρτυρες που κατέθεσαν στη δίκη χάρη στις μηχανορραφίες του Συνηγόρου του Πολίτη (ο οποίος δεν έχει κανένα ρόλο εκτός από το να εξυπηρετεί σκοπιμότητες, είκοσι χρόνια ο ίδιος) δεν είναι πραγματικοί μάρτυρες, επειδή δεν αναφέρει τα ονόματά τους η καταγγελία. Είναι κομάντο της συλλογικότητας αυτής που προαναφέρθηκε: οι καθηγητές πανεπιστημίου τους επέλεξαν ως μέλη του σκληρού πυρήνα και τους καθοδήγησαν τι να πουν στο δικαστήριο. Ούτε είχαν δει τον Μάγγο ούτε τίποτα. Αλλά δεν είχαν προλάβει να προετοιμάσουν καλά την πρώτη μάρτυρα (έξι χρόνια μετά) και κάτι της ξέφυγε. Αλλά τελικά δεν είπε και κανείς από αυτούς τίποτα στο δικαστήριο.


Επίσης, την καταγγελία την έγραψε ο ίδιος ο Μάγγος για να γίνει αποδεκτός από αυτή την ενιαία και συμπαγή συλλογικότητα σκληρών αναρχικών. Το κείμενο της καταγγελίας έχει επίσης την ίδια γραμματοσειρά με τα υπομνήματα που κατατέθηκαν από μάρτυρες, επομένως όλοι καταλαβαίνουμε τι μας κρύβουν.


Η δίωξη των αστυνομικών για βασανιστήρια στον Βασίλειο Μάγγο, είναι μέρος του ίδιου σχεδίου με τον θανατηφόρο τραυματισμό του αστυνομικού της ΥΑΤ, Λυγγερίδη και με την προφυλάκιση δύο αθώων αστυνομικών στο Άργος από τους οποίους, ενώ καταδίωκαν κάποιον που κρατούσε πιστόλι – δεν ήξεραν ότι ήταν ρέπλικα, πού να το ξέρουν; – «έφυγε» μία σφαίρα και εποστρακίστηκε και έτυχε να βρει τον καταδιωκόμενο. Το σχέδιο αυτό (αφού απέτυχε η κατάληψη της Διεύθυνσης Αστυνομίας Βόλου το 2020; έμεινε αδιευκρίνιστο) είναι να αποθαρρυνθούν οι Έλληνες Αστυνομικοί από το να κάνουν τη δουλειά τους. Θα λέτε «χρειάζομαι αστυνομία» κι εκείνοι θα λένε «χρειάζομαι την οικογένειά μου» γιατί θα κινδυνεύουν με φυλάκιση. Αυτή την αστυνομία θέλουμε; Παλιά η τηλεόραση έδειχνε ωραίες εκπομπές με μότο «Σύμβολον θυσίας υπέρ του έθνους ο Έλλην Χωροφύλαξ». Αλλά όχι πια, οπότε μη ξεχνάτε ότι κινδυνεύει η Δημοκρατία, η Δικαιοσύνη, η Κοινωνία, η Ειρήνη και το Έθνος.


Ταυτόχρονα, ο πατέρας και η μητέρα του θύματος, χρησιμοποιώντας τον Συνήγορο του Πολίτη και μια σειρά από εισαγγελείς – οι οποίοι, να σημειωθεί, είναι είτε ανίκανοι είτε υπηρετούν σκοπιμότητες – τα έστησαν όλα αυτά μόνοι τους, για να κάνουν αγωγή στο Δημόσιο και να πάρουν λεφτά. Αν θέλουν να αποδείξουν ότι όντως πιστεύουν ότι φταίνε οι αστυνομικοί για κάτι, ας παραιτηθούν από τα δικαιώματά τους για να μας πείσουν. Αλλιώς έρχονται μαύρες μέρες για το έθνος μας.


***


Αυτή είναι η εικόνα των ισχυρισμών που προέβαλαν οι τέσσερις συνήγοροι αστυνομικών που αγόρευσαν την Πέμπτη 29 και την Παρασκευή 30 Οκτωβρίου 2026, στη δίκη για τον βασανισμό του Βασίλειου Μάγγου, ως εναλλακτική/-ές θεωρία/-ες που εξηγεί, κατά την άποψή τους, το γιατί οι πελάτες τους πρέπει να κηρυχθούν αθώοι.


Για του …

author: Unknown
title: Sciopero generale: l’Italia si blocca
content:
Giornata di sciopero generale: numeri ancor più massicci delle prime manifestazioni dell’autunno scorso. Blocchi in tutta Italia e cortei da decine di migliaia di persone, dalle metropoli alle province.


Contro la guerra, contro il carovita, contro il riarmo voluto dal governo Meloni. E ancora, contro una vita precaria e indignitosa, per dire basta ai sacrifici che il governo italiano, insieme ai governi di tutta Europa, vogliono imporre alla popolazione. La partecipazione è stata impressionante, da Sud a Nord, oltre un milione in tutta Italia. Il Paese che per anni è stato narrato come il bacino dell’indifferenza e che nei migliori dei casi avrebbe voluto “fare come in Francia” in queste settimane, sull’onda del ciclo di movimento iniziato un anno fa a sostegno della Palestina e contro la complicità dei governi con il genocidio, sta dando un segnale chiaro: è giunto il tempo di alzare la testa.


Grazie ai giovani che a fronte del peso di un futuro rubato stanno occupando scuole e università da un mese per affermare la propria esistenza, ai giovani che con rabbia calciano indietro la sfrontatezza dell’ingiustizia, oggi grazie alla chiamata allo sciopero generale indetto dall’Unione Sindacale di Base, si sono uniti i lavoratori e le lavoratrici che non hanno nessuna garanzia di vedere riconosciuto il proprio lavoro. Ma precarietà e sfruttamento non sono più un orizzonte accettato. Gli agricoltori e gli autotrasportatori che al Sud hanno bloccato le merci lo dicono da settimane, insieme a studenti, famiglie e a chiunque individua la causa di questa situazione alle scelte politiche dall’alto, sottomesse ai diktat europei e trumpiani: non c’è più disponibilità.


Il governo Meloni deve fare i conti con il fatto che in piazza c’è il paese che porta avanti l’ingranaggio di questo sistema e che se decide di fermarsi non ci sarà alcuna prova di forza in grado di reggere il confronto. Le briciole di una finanziaria che tenta di mascherare in ogni modo che l’unico interesse governativo è trovare i soldi per il riarmo non hanno alcuna possibilità di convincere la popolazione.


A Bologna, Pisa, Livorno, Roma, Torino, Treviso, Milano, Reggio Calabria, Palermo, Bari, Trieste, Pavia, Vicenza, Modena, Padova, Mestre, Cosenza, Napoli, Genova sono state bloccate le arterie principali delle città, gli snodi delle tangenziali e i porti.


Livorno: la mattinata parte con il blocco del porto, prosegue poi con un corteo di oltre 20 mila persone e continua con il blocco della circolazione al varco Zara.


Bologna: 50 mila persone nonostante i blocchi della polizia aprono un varco e arrivano a inondare l’autostrada.


Modena: giovani e famiglie in corteo contro guerra e carovita.


Torino: un corteo diramato in tutta la città, dal centro alla tangenziale, raggiunge quota 100 mila persone, viene rilanciato l’appuntamento alle 18 per un altro corteo cittadino.


Cosenza: corteo di massa di 7mila persone ha invaso le strade della città e bloccato autostrada e superstrada.


Pisa: un corteo di 20 mila persone si conclude con l’occupazione del Palazzo della Sapienza, nel pomeriggio appuntamento per una grande assemblea.


Brescia: 10 mila persone in corteo hanno tentato di raggiungere l’autostrada, cariche della polizia.


Milano: 80 mila persone raggiungono la tangenziale.


Pavia: grande manifestazione contro guerra e carovita.


Qui le dirette di

Radio Blackout

 e di

Radio Onda d’Urto

 con i collegamenti dalle piazze in tutta Italia.

author: paradox-a
title: Die falsche Welt des Gute-Laune-Faschismus
content:
Zum Posterboy des Gute-Laune-Faschismus wurde Ulrich Siegmund gekürt, der AfD-Ministerpräsident in spe aus Sachsen-Anhalt. Die AfD fuhr hier mit 43,8% ihr bislang bestes Ergebnis ein. Je strukturschwächer, gottverlassener und migrationsärmer die Gegenden sind, desto stärker ist der Zuspruch zum nationalistischen Autoritarismus. So bereisen die ewig grinsenden Rattenfänger das Land und punkten unter Deutschen, die die Überwindung ihrer eigenen bürgerlichen Existenz herbeisehnen und hoffen dies auf dem Weg der Zerstörung der liberalen Demokratie zu erreichen.


Der Wohlfühl-Faschismus ist ein Phänomen, das vor zwanzigdreißig Jahren noch völlig unvorstellbar gewesen wäre. Und in zweidrei Jahrzehnten werden wir uns ebenfalls fragen, was in dieser Phase eigentlich passiert ist. Wer sie verstehen will, muss sich dazu nicht nur die Wahlkampf-Strategien der AfD anschauen, sondern auch kultur- und medienwissenschaftlich vorgehen. So ist es kein Zufall, das seit Anfang des Jahres 2026 massenhaft KI-generierte Songs bei Youtube erscheinen. Aufgrund ihrer hohen Klickzahlen landen diese wiederum durch die Algorithmen sehr schnell in der Vorschlagleiste.


Die extrem rechte Propaganda-Maschinerie bedient sich somit nahezu perfekt abgestimmt der Mittel, die der Plattform-Kapitalismus entwickelt hat. Und sie greift auf eine künstlich-sentimentale Popkultur zurück, die unterm Strich meistens schon sehr schlicht und beschränkt war. Ob volkstümelnd wie Heino, oder neu-deutsch-hart wie Rammstein, sülzig wie Julia Juls, Runa&Rebellin oder pop-rockig wie Weimar, Sleipnir und andere – Vorbilder für die extrem rechte Computermusik gibt es genug…


Sicher könnte man auch dagegen halten und sagen, dass die Generierung von Musik und Video-Material durch technische Sprechapparate von allen möglichen Leute mit kommerziellen Absichten, um Aufmerksamkeit zu erhalten oder einfach nur aus Langeweile generiert wird. Und das stimmt auch. Bedenkt man, wie durchproduziert und geglättet kommerziell erfolgreiche Musik heute ist, scheint der Schritt zur sogenannten KI klein zu sein. Dennoch gibt es eine spezielle Affinität von faschistischem Denken zur offensichtlich künstlichen Kultur, die den Anschein von menschlicher Kreativität verlässt und damit post-human ist. Laut Jason Stanley wird damit auf die Herstellung von „Unwirklichkeit“ abgezielt.


Um ein paar Beispiele von viralen KI-generierten Songs und „Künstler“ zu nennen, sind da beispielsweise:


– „Spätestens HIER wacht jeder auf! Der Sound des Wandels“ („Aufbruch Deutschland“, 501.537 Aufrufe)


– „Steh auf, wenn du Deutscher bist | Stolz auf Heimat und Kultur“ („Ottilie“, 339.081 Aufrufe)


– „Was ist aus unserem Land geworden? | Ein Lied über den Verlust der Heimat“ („Fenja“, 338.697 Aufrufe)


– „Dorfmarie – So war es, so soll es wieder sein“ („Dorfmarie“, 160.534 Aufrufe)


– „DIE WACHT AM RHEIN (LIVE) | Rock-Version eines historischen Gedichts“ („Julia im Exil“; 113.198 Aufrufe)


– „Kein schöner Land… WO DIE EICHEN STEH’N“ („Freya“; 18.974 Aufrufe)


– „Thüringen Ein Land Eine Geschichte Ein Herz“ („Der Heimatklang“, 4334 Aufrufe)


– „Heimweh nach Deutschland“ („Liv Eisen“, 2067 Aufrufe)


Die Titel verraten schon das Wesentliche. Wenn man die Textzeilen hört oder liest, wird deutlich, dass die immer gleichen Narrative, endlos wiederholt werden. Stets geht es um den Verlust einer imaginären „Heimat“ oder glorreichen „Nation“, um eine angebliche „Überfremdung“, anknüpfend an den Verschwörungsmythos eines „großen Austauschs“. Der Gute-Laune-Faschismus lebt in der ewigen Wiederholung von Mustern immer gleicher Opfer-Inszenierungen, dem Streicheln narzisstischer Kränkungen, sowie der Vorstellung einer zukünftigen Größe, die nur durch die Erniedrigung der ausgemachten Feinde erreicht werden kann. All dies sind Produkte einer staatlich-kapitalistischen Gesellschaftsform, die mit Patriarchat, Rassismus und Naturbeherrschung verknüpft ist. Zusammengefasst ist die Computer-produzierte Lyrik in ihrem billigen Abklatsch armselig – und faschistisch.


Dabei darf man nicht vergessen, dass auch der historische Nationalismus keine naturwüchsige Volksbewegung war, sondern ein Elitenprojekt, das eine Nation und eine darin angeblich ursprünglich vorhandene Kultur verordnete, anerzog und drillte.


Hört man die künstlich erzeugten Lieder und ihre Texte an, greifen Form und Inhalt ineinander. Bekanntlich ist den Fans derartiger wohlfühlfaschistischer Erzeugnisse vollkommen egal, ob sie ein KI-generiertes Lied …

author: daniel
title: Der lange Atem zählt
content:
Rückblick: Geschichte der UAA Gronau

Seit 1985 wird in der bundesweit einzigen Urananreicherungsanlage Uran angereichert. Nach mehreren Erweiterungen kann inzwischen in der Anlage jährlich nuklearer Uran-Brennstoff für den Betrieb von ca. 30 Atomkraftwerken in aller Welt produziert werden. Betrieben wird die UAA Gronau vom Urenco-Konzern, der international verschachtelt ist. Urenco betreibt u. a. auch die niederländische Schwesteranlage in Almelo. Der deutsche Zweig des Urenco-Konzerns ist jeweils zu 50 % im Besitz der Energiekonzerne E.ON und RWE.

Während am Standort Gronau, neben der Produktion von angereichertem Uran, inzwischen auch an neuen „Brennstoffen“ für neue AKW-Typen geforscht wird, erfolgt am Urenco-Standort Jülich (auch in NRW) über die Enrichment Technology Company (ETC) die für die Urananreicherung erforderliche Zentrifugenforschung bzw. Zentrifugenproduktion.

Gegen den Bau der UAA Gronau wurden Ende der 1970er Jahre rund 7000 Einsprüche gesammelt und eingereicht. Im Mai 1981 fand in Gronau der Erörterungstermin für die erste Ausbaustufe statt und Silvester 1981 wurde die erste Genehmigung zum Bau einer Anlage mit 1000 Tonnen Urantrennarbeit pro Jahr (UTA/a) erteilt. Es folgten weitere Genehmigungsverfahren und jetzt sind 4500t UTA/a genehmigt.

Nach dem Baubeginn 1982 begann im ersten Teil der UAA Gronau am 15. August 1985 erstmals die Produktion von angereichertem Uran, das nach der Weiterverarbeitung in Brennelementefabriken (z. B. in Lingen oder in Schweden) die Grundlage für den Betrieb zahlreicher Atomkraftwerke in aller Welt ist. Die offizielle Einweihung der Anlage erfolgte Monate später unter Protest am 12. Juni 1986, wenige Wochen nach dem Super-GAU in Tschernobyl. Vor der Anlage demonstrierten rund 300 Bürger*innen gegen die UAA und die mit ihr verbundenen Gefahren.

Anlässlich des 40. Jahrestages der offiziellen Inbetriebnahme der UAA (12. Juni 1986 / 2026) bekräftigten Umweltverbände und Bürgerinitiativen (darunter der BBU und der AKU Gronau) ihre Forderung nach Aufhebung der UAA-Betriebsgenehmigungen und nach der sofortigen Stilllegung der bundesweit einzigen Urananreicherungsanlage.

Gefahren der Urananreicherung, der Urantransporte und der atomwaffentauglichen Zentrifugentechnik

Umstritten ist die Gronauer Atomfabrik wegen zahlreicher Gefahren, aber auch, weil die in ihr genutzte Zentrifugentechnik nach Umbauarbeiten auch zur Produktion von Uran für Atomwaffen genutzt werden könnte. Die Anlage in Gronau ist weder gegen Flugzeugabstürze noch gegen militärische Angriffe oder Drohnenbeschuss gesichert.

Wiederholt gab es in der UAA Störfälle. 2010 wurde ein Arbeiter in der Anlage verstrahlt. Erhebliche Gefahren gehen auch von den zahlreichen Urantransporten mit LKW und Sonderzügen von und zur Urananreicherungsanlage aus, die ganz NRW, aber auch weitere Bundesländer, durchqueren. Oft werden sie auch international durchgeführt. Hilfs- und Rettungskräfte an den Transportstrecken werden im Vorfeld nicht über die gefährlichen Transporte informiert. Bei einem Transportunfall könnte es zu weitreichenden Verseuchungen kommen. Wissen muss man dabei, dass in der UAA Uranhexafluorid (UF6) verarbeitet wird, und dieser Stoff wird auch in verschiedenen Isotopenzusammensetzungen transportiert. UF6 ist radioaktiv und reagiert bei Freisetzungen u. a. zur aggressiven Flusssäure. Wiederholt gab es Proteste gegen diese Transporte sowie Schienenblockaden. Schwachaktiver Atommüll aus Gronau wurde auch bereits in das Fasslager in Gorleben gebracht.

Auch aus den Reihen der Friedensbewegung wird immer wieder die Stilllegung der Gronauer Urananreicherungsanlage gefordert. Die UAA Gronau könnte im Konfliktfall ein militärisch wichtiges Angriffsziel sein, denn die Zentrifugentechnik, die in der Anlage zum Einsatz kommt, kann auch zur Produktion von Uran für Atomwaffen genutzt werden. Dieser Umstand diente dem Trump-Regime als Vorwand, um die Urananreicherungsstandorte im Iran zu bombardieren.

Um auf die militärische Brisanz der Urananreicherung hinzuweisen, fanden und finden immer wieder Ostermärsche zur Gronauer Urananreicherungsanlage statt. An dem bisher größten Ostermarsch in Gronau beteiligten sich 2011, kurz nach der Atomkatastrophe in Fukushima, rund 15.000 Menschen.

Aktuelle Militarisierung der Urananreicherung und des Urenco-Konzerns

author: infolibre
title: Παγχανιώτικο συλλαλητήριο για την υγεία, Παρασκευή 30/10, στις 18.00, στη πλατέια Αγοράς
content:
Την Παρασκευή 30/10, στις 18.00, στη πλατεία Αγοράς, στα Χανιά, εργατικά σωματεία, φοιτητικοί σύλλογοι, μαζικοί φορείς και οργανώσεις του Νομού καλούν σε συγκέντρωση ενάντια στην διάλυση της δημόσιας υγείας και του Νοσοκομείου Χανίων απαιτώντας δημόσια, δωρεάν υγεία, ενίσχυση του ΕΣΥ με προσλήψεις μόνιμων γιατρών και εργαζομένων και στελέχωση των νοσοκομείων.


Η υγεία είναι κοινωνικό αγαθό ,όχι εμπόρευμα.


Αφίσες/Καλέσματα:


ΣΥΛΛΟΓΟΣ ΕΡΓΑΖΟΜΕΝΩΝ ΓΕΝΙΚΟΥ ΝΟΣΟΚΟΜΕΙΟΥ ΧΑΝΙΩΝ // ΕΝΩΣΗ ΓΙΑΤΡΩΝ ΕΣΥ ΧΑΝΙΩΝ // ΕΡΓΑΤΟΫΠΑΛΛΗΛΙΚΟ ΚΕΝΤΡΟ Ν. ΧΑΝΙΩΝ


Tην έντονη αντίδραση του Συλλόγου Εργαζομένων του Νοσοκομείου Χανίων, προκάλεσε η πρόσφατη ανακοίνωση που εξέδωσε η διοίκηση του Νοσηλευτικού Ιδρύματος, μέσα από την οποία ανακοίνωσε την μονιμοποίηση εργαζομένων με προσωπικό καθώς και την πρόσληψη επικουρικού προσωπικού.

Ο Σύλλογος Εργαζομένων του Γενικού Νοσοκομείου Χανίων, κάνει λόγο για «ωραιοποίηση της κατάστασης» από τη διοίκηση του Νοσοκομείου, τονίζοντας πως «επέλεξε να απαντήσει στα

υπαρκτά προβλήματα με «δημιουργική λογιστική» αριθμών και επικοινωνιακά τεχνάσματα».

Παράλληλα, η ο Σύλλογος καλεί σε συγκέντρωση διαμαρτυρίας στις 30 Οκτωβρίου στις 6 το απόγευμα στην Πλατεία Δημοτικής Αγοράς.

Με έκπληξη αλλά και αγανάκτηση διαβάσαμε την πρόσφατη δημόσια τοποθέτηση της Διοίκησης του Γενικού Νοσοκομείου Χανίων. Σε μια προσπάθεια να ωραιοποιηθεί η δραματική κατάσταση που βιώνουμε καθημερινά εργαζόμενοι και ασθενείς, η διοίκηση επέλεξε να απαντήσει στα υπαρκτά προβλήματα με «δημιουργική λογιστική» αριθμών και επικοινωνιακά τεχνάσματα.

Η σκληρή πραγματικότητα εντός του νοσοκομείου, όμως, διαψεύδει τους πανηγυρισμούς:

• Η «ενίσχυση» με το σταγονόμετρο: Οι 37 προσλήψεις που επικαλείται η διοίκηση αποτελούν «σταγόνα στον ωκεανό» των εκατοντάδων οργανικών κενών. Στην πλειονότητά τους αφορούν συμβασιούχους (επικουρικό προσωπικό) με ημερομηνία λήξης, οι οποίοι απλώς αναπληρώνουν ένα μικρό μέρος των παραιτήσεων.

• Η κατάρρευση των Πυλώνων του ΕΣΥ: Η ίδια η διοίκηση ομολογεί ότι η Παθολογική Κλινική λειτουργεί με μόλις 4 γιατρούς (από 12 γιατρούς το 2019) και το ΤΕΠ με 2 γιατρούς για 8 οργανικές θέσεις. Αυτό που βαφτίζει «συστημικό πρόβλημα» για εμάς σημαίνει εξουθένωση του προσωπικού, επισφαλείς εφημερίες και σοβαρότατο κίνδυνο για την ασφάλεια των χιλιάδων πολιτών που μας επισκέπτονται.

• Χειρουργεία: Η αποχώρηση Αναιθησιολόγων έχει ως αποτέλεσμα την μείωση των χειρουργικών τραπεζιών σε 2 και την τραγική αύξηση αναμονής των ασθενών που περιμένουν να χειρουργηθούν.

• Νοσηλευτική υποστελέχωση: Η σύγκριση με το 2019 είναι τουλάχιστον ατυχής. Η τραγική υποστελέχωση σε νοσηλευτικό προσωπικό ανά κλίνη, την οποία η διοίκηση προσπερνά στα γρήγορα, μεταφράζεται σε διπλοβάρδιες, χρωστούμενα ρεπό και άδειες, και εργασιακή εξουθένωση (burnout).

• Συγκάλυψη με «βιτρίνες»: Η αναφορά σε «καλά στελεχωμένα τμήματα» γίνεται αποκλειστικά για να αποσπάσει την προσοχή από τα τμήματα πρώτης γραμμής που βρίσκονται σε λειτουργικό αδιέξοδο. Ένα νοσοκομείο δεν μπορεί να λειτουργήσει χωρίς ισχυρή Παθολογική κλινική και επαρκώς στελεχωμένα Επείγοντα.

Η ανάδειξη της αλήθειας δεν είναι «καταστροφολογία». Καταστροφή είναι η πολιτική που υποβαθμίζει τη δημόσια υγεία. Οι εργαζόμενοι του Νοσοκομείου Χανίων κρατάμε όρθιο το νοσοκομείο με την προσωπική μας θυσία και όχι με επικοινωνιακά δελτία τύπου.

Ο Σύλλογος Εργαζομένων του Νοσοκομείου, η ΕΓΕΣΥΧ και το Εργατικό Κέντρο από κοινού καλούν τον Χανιώτικο λαό την Παρασκευή 30 Οκτωβρίου 6 μμ στην Δημοτική Πλατεία της Αγοράς σε ένα κοινό αγώνα για το Νοσοκομείο και την Υγεία που αξίζει στον τόπο μας.

Το ΔΣ του Εργατικού Κέντρου Χανίων στην δια περιφοράς συνεδρίασή του στις 26/10 αποφάσισε ομόφωνα την κήρυξη στάσης εργασίας από τις 5.00′ μ.μ. έως τις 9.00′ μ.μ. την ημέρα του συλλαλητηρίου, για να διευκολυνθούν οι συνάδελφοι που εργάζονται.


Σωματείο Εργαζομένων ΕΚΑΒ Τομέα Χανίων


Το Σωματείο Εργαζομένων ΕΚΑΒ Τομέα Χανίων δηλώνει τη δυναμική και αμέριστη συμπαράστασή του στον δίκαιο αγώνα των εργαζομένων του Γενικού Νοσοκομείου Χανίων (ΕΓΕΣΥΧ, Σύλλογος Εργαζομένων Γ.Ν. Χανίων) και του Εργατικού Κέντρου Χανίων.


Ως διασώστες και πληρώματα ασθενοφόρων που βρισκόμαστε καθημερινά στην πρώτη γραμμή της επείγουσας προνοσοκομειακής φροντίδας, βιώνουμε από πρώτο χέρι την απαξίωση και τη σταδιακή διάλυση του Δημόσιου Συστήματος Υγείας.


Η υποστελέχωση του Γ.Ν. Χανίων μας αφορά όλους. Η έλλειψη προσωπικού στις κλινικές, το Τμήμα Επειγόντων Περιστατικών (ΤΕΠ) και τα χειρουργεία επηρεάζει άμεσα και τη δική μας εργασία …

author: PETA-Team
title: Ukraine: Freiwilliger Tierretter und Hund sterben nach Drohnenangriff
content:
Am 27. Oktober 2026 wurde ein Team von PETAs Partnerorganisation

Animal Rescue Kharkiv

 bei einer

Tierrettung in der Ukraine

 angegriffen: Zwei Drohnen trafen das Fahrzeug der Helfer:innen, zerschlugen die Windschutzscheibe und verletzten den 40-jährigen Helfer Jesse Adams und einen der geretteten Hunde tödlich. Wir von PETA Deutschland und unsere internationalen Partnerorganisationen betrauern den Verlust des engagierten Freiwilligen aus Kanada. 


Gleichzeitig zeigt der tödliche Angriff auf unser Partnerteam, wie gefährlich die Lage im ukrainischen Kriegsgebiet weiterhin für alle Lebewesen ist. Erfahren Sie hier mehr zu dem Angriff und wie Sie unseren Partnern und den Tieren vor Ort helfen können.

 

 


Schwerer Angriff auf Tierrettungsteam: Russische Drohnen töten Helfer bei der Rettung von Tieren und setzen Unterkunft in Brand 


Der tödliche Angriff ereignete sich, als Jesse Adams aus dem kanadischen Vancouver Island, und andere zivile Retter:innen unserer Partnerorganisation

Animal Rescue Kharkiv

 (ARK) Tiere in einen Transporter luden – einige von ihnen verletzt, alle vom Krieg tief verängstigt und evakuierungsbedürftig.  


Zwei Drohnen trafen das Fahrzeug, zerschlugen die Windschutzscheibe, verletzten Adams mit einer massiven Splitterexplosion und töteten einen

der geretteten Hunde

. Eine weitere Drohne traf das Haus, in dem die Tiere kurzfristig bis zur Abholung in das Projekt von ARK untergebracht waren, und setzte es in Brand.  


Rettungskräfte eilten herbei, um das Feuer zu löschen, Adams wurde sofort ins Krankenhaus transportiert – doch er verstarb während der Notoperation aufgrund seiner schweren Verletzungen. 


Weiterer Angriff auf vorübergehende Unterkunft der geretteten Tiere 


Währenddessen schlugen erneut zwei weitere Drohnen in das Haus ein, in dem die Tiere kurzfristig untergebracht waren. Die Unterkunft brannte lichterloh – doch alle Tiere konnten in Sicherheit gebracht werden. Dennoch sind alle Beteiligten schwer traumatisiert – das Einsatzteam und die

geretteten Tiere

. 


„Tiere führen keine Kriege, aber sie sind Opfer davon, müssen ohne Nahrung, Wasser oder tierärztliche Versorgung unter schweren Verletzungen leiden, es sei denn, jemand kommt ihnen zu Hilfe. PETA fordert alle auf, an die Tiere zu denken, die von Konflikten betroffen sind, und an die Helden, die ihr eigenes Leben riskieren, um ihnen zu helfen.“  

Ingrid Newkirk, PETA-Gründerin

 


PETA und ARK sind in tiefer Trauer um Jesse Adams  


Adams war Mitbegründer der

RainCoast Dog Rescue Society

 in Kanada und einer von zahlreichen Freiwilligen mit militärischer Grundausbildung und viel Erfahrung in gefährlichen Einsatzgebieten, die ARK-Teams vor Ort unterstützen.  


In einem seiner letzten Instagram-Beiträge vor einigen Tagen schrieb Adams darüber, wie er einer Familie geholfen hatte: Diese hatte sich geweigert, ihr Zuhause in einem Gebiet zu verlassen, das täglich von Drohnen, Bomben und Raketen getroffen wurde, bis sie wussten, dass ihre Tiere sicher evakuiert werden konnten. Adams und das ARK-Team halfen der Familie bei der Evakuierung ihrer mehr als ein Dutzend Tiere und schrieben dann über den Einsatz: 


„Wir sind die großen Risiken eingegangen, weil diese Menschen und Tiere dringend unsere Hilfe brauchten. Wir sind das Risiko eingegangen, weil wir wollten, dass jemand dasselbe für uns tut, wenn wir Hilfe brauchen. Wir sind das Risiko eingegangen, weil es nicht viele gibt, die es getan hätten.“ 


Lebensgefahr für Menschen und Tiere: Angriff zeigt erneut, wie wichtig die Hilfe vor Ort ist 


Seit Beginn des russischen Angriffskrieges im Februar 2022 unterstützen wir von PETA Deutschland gemeinsam mit unseren internationalen Partnerorganisationen durch unseren Global Compassion Fund die lebensrettende, aber auch lebensgefährliche Arbeit des ARK-Teams in der Ukraine. Denn die Retter:innen arbeiten unter der ständigen

Gefahr von Bomben

, Beschuss und Gewalt, um verängstigte, traumatisierte,

verletzte

 und oft stark unterernährte Tiere in der Ukraine zu retten.  


In den vergangenen Jahren wurde ein großes Projekt vor Ort aufgebaut, sodass bisher fast 40.000 Katzen, Hunde, Pferde und andere Tiere gerettet, medizinisch versorgt und liebevoll aufgepäppelt werden konnten.  


Immer wieder lebensgefährliche und tödliche Angriffe auf Helfer:innen

+


Adams‘ Tod ist die jüngste Tragödie, die Tierretter:innen getroffen hat, die mit PETA Deutschland und anderen Tierrettungsgruppen zusammenarbeiteten. Im Juni …

author: Carine Kaneza Nantulya
title: Kenya’s 2027 Election: Time to Address the Warning Signs
content:
On August 16, 2026, hundreds of people armed with machetes, guns, and sticks

attacked

 a convoy carrying opposition politicians and supporters of the Linda Mwananchi movement in Homa Bay county, western Kenya. The attackers killed at least three people and beat and robbed journalists covering the violence. Witnesses said police officers were present but failed to contain the attacks. The incident was among

a series of violent attacks targeting civil society events and opposition gatherings

 in the months leading up to Kenya’s August 10, 2027, general elections. At least six people have reportedly been killed and dozens injured in these attacks, raising serious concerns about the safety of political participation as the campaign season gathers pace.


I returned to Nairobi, Kenya’s capital, where my colleagues and I have been speaking with people from different walks of life to understand how they view the political and human rights environment ahead of the 2027 elections for president and the National Assembly. President William Ruto is expected to seek a second term, while opposition parties and candidates have already begun mobilizing supporters at rallies across the country.


One conversation, with a 28-year-old woman, stayed with me.


“I will not vote in next year’s elections.”


Her words were clear and definitive. I asked her why.


“It is always the same. Our votes do not change anything.”


Another young woman sitting nearby offered a different perspective. We need to look beyond elections, she said, and ask what elections are supposed to achieve: ensuring that every vote counts, that people can participate freely, and that everyone—including women—can participate without fear.


Our conversations revealed a growing sense of anxiety about the elections, and a troubling lack of confidence that the institutions responsible for protecting people’s rights will be able to prevent violence and ensure accountability.


First, there is a palpable fear that the 2027 elections could be violent. Several people we met—including civil society actors, opposition members, grassroots organizers, and youth mobilizers—pointed

to recent violence at political rallies

 as early warning signs.


The violence in Homa Bay was repeatedly described as a turning point. For many, it signaled a deterioration in the political environment and raised concerns about what could lie ahead as campaigning intensifies.


Then there are the so-called “goons”—gangs, allegedly

mobilized or paid

 by politicians to disrupt political rallies, intimidate opponents, and engage in violence. I repeatedly asked interlocutors how best to describe this phenomenon.


Some drew parallels with the

Mungiki,

 an ethnic-based militia and criminal gang that has historically been mobilized for political violence and was entangled in Kenya’s electoral cycles. Opposition and civil society members described young people being mobilized or allegedly paid to disrupt rallies, intimidate political opponents, and influence political gatherings. Some alleged links to senior officials but provided no evidence. The consistency with which these allegations were raised points to a serious concern: the blurring of the lines between political violence, organized criminality, and the government security apparatus, underscoring the need for independent, impartial, and transparent investigations.


At the heart of these concerns is impunity. The

lack of accountability for past abuses

 has left many questioning whether state institutions will protect them or hold those responsible for the abuse accountable.


Some people we met questioned the role of the Kenya National Commission on Human Rights. Young people expressed doubts about the effectiveness of its statements and said it should do more. When we raised these concerns with commissioners, they cited constraints including inadequate funding and other significant capacity and resource limitations.


People also raised concerns about the

independence and effectiveness

 of other institutions responsible for protecting rights and ensuring electoral integrity, including the judiciary, the electoral commission and the Independent Policing Oversight Authority.


A young Gen Z leader described the contradiction between increased youth political engagement and growing fear. Despite young people mobilizing through protests and registering to vote, she told us: “We are all scared

.”

author: Ahmed Ismat Ahmed
title: El Fasher, a year later
content:
Nasr City, October 26, 2026

Today is the anniversary, and I still don’t know what that word is supposed to do for anyone.

I was in Cairo when the city fell. I disappeared there — not in any way a person standing outside me could have seen — and I am not leaving that out, as if the one doing the remembering were a pane of glass. But El Fasher sits on an older arithmetic, and the arithmetic is where I have to start.

The old arithmetic

I was in the street in Omdurman on International Women’s Day in 2019, a month before they finally put Omar al-Bashir out of the palace he had occupied for 30 years. Three out of every four people in that crowd were women. The proportion mattered because NISS — the National Intelligence and Security Service, Sudan’s secret police, who have spent decades learning exactly where a society keeps its weight — knew where to look. They find it. Then they go after it.

So they started arresting the women.

There was nothing accidental in this, and nothing hidden. They were not ashamed, because shame requires believing someone is watching who matters, and they did not believe that. If the police took a man that day, it cost almost nothing to get him back: a friend, a cousin, anyone his age from his own street could walk into that station the same afternoon and walk him out again, because a man’s word, in that system, was still worth something on its own. A woman could not do this. A woman arrested had to produce a man — a father, a brother, a husband, some uncle twice removed — because the state had built itself, brick by brick, on the conviction that a woman’s name, standing alone, was not collateral enough to release a woman’s body.

I watched it work. I watched women I knew go quiet in the weeks after, not because they themselves had been taken, but because they understood, suddenly and completely, that the price had changed shape under their feet. It was no longer only her own body in the cell. It was her family’s name, dragged into a police station because she had been standing in a square where the government had decided women should not stand.

That is the oldest trick this state has ever run. I have come to call the thing that runs it a machine — not a government with occasional failures, but an arrangement built to find whatever a population has left, and take it. The war now being fought in Darfur did not invent the trick. The Rapid Support Forces (RSF), the paramilitary formed from the Janjaweed — the militias the state itself armed in Darfur two decades ago — inherited it, and scaled it, until a tactic became the way a siege was built.

The city

The siege had an address. Most people who will read this have only ever met it as a dateline, and a dateline doesn’t let you feel what was emptied.

Darfur is the west of Sudan. It is about the size of Spain, pressed up against Chad, Libya, and the Central African Republic, far enough from the Nile and from Khartoum that the center has always been able to treat the distance as a kind of ownership. Farmers and herders live there — Fur, Zaghawa, Masalit, Berti, Borgo, Rizeigat, and more peoples than a briefing ever bothers to list — Arab and non-Arab, in categories the last century hardened and this one found useful. They have shared land, and they have fought over land, and since 2003 they have done both inside a counterinsurgency. The rebellion started the way rebellions in that region usually start. The center took men for its wars and sent almost nothing back. Bashir’s government answered by arming militias, the ones the world learned to call the Janjaweed, and aiming them at the communities the rebels came from. Hundreds of thousands died. The world said genocide, and then largely changed the channel. The militias were not disbanded. They were paid, given rank, and renamed. The Rapid Support Forces are that renaming. Their commander is Mohamed Hamdan Dagalo, Hemedti, and he is at war with the army that made the renaming official. El Fasher is where that arrangement came back to the ground it was built on.

The city is older than any of these men. It was the capital of the Fur sultanate, the place Darfur governed itself from, until that was broken from the outside in 1874. Ali Dinar put a sultanate back together in what was left and held it until 1916, when the British killed him and took Darfur into Sudan. After that El Fasher was no longer a capital in the old sense. It was the town where the new state proved it could still reach the …

author: Alf Gunvald Nilsen
title: Southern Authoritarian Populism
content:
The early twenty-first century is a time of monsters in the Global South. 


What do these monsters look like? 


Let me begin with those at work closest to home, namely in post-apartheid South Africa, where I live and work. 


On 30 June 2026, the country’s streets were awash with hate. In cities like Johannesburg, Durban, and Pretoria, as well as in smaller towns, tens of thousands of people – mostly poor and working-class Black South Africans – marched behind slogans blaming undocumented migrants from other African countries for unemployment, crime, failing public services, and drug addiction. Their rallying cry was simple:

Abahambe!

 – They Must Go! The day itself – 30 June – was the “deadline” that xenophobic organizations had set for undocumented migrants to leave the country. In the months leading up to this date, these organizations mobilized popular support for the idea of expulsion across the country. As the deadline approached, thousands of African foreigners flocked to their diplomatic missions to seek emergency repatriation. At least four people were killed before the marches took place, and countless others lost their livelihoods or fled their communities in fear.


Much about this moment was uniquely South African. Above all, the fact that the targets of hate, violence, and murder are Black African migrants, not White migrants from the Global North like me, has been a constant across similar upsurges in 2008, 2015, and 2019. This has led the Cameroonian scholar Achille Mbembe to speak of Afrophobia – a fear and hatred specifically of the Black African Other – as a distinctive predicament of South Africa’s post-apartheid order.  


Yet it was also something more. Across the Global South, we have witnessed the rise of a monstrous far-right politics that rallies majoritarian people-nations against ominous Others while normalizing increasingly authoritarian political orders. This far right takes multiple forms: in some cases, such as Erdogan’s Turkey or Narendra Modi’s India, it manifests as

entrenched

 far-right regimes with a firm grip on political power; in other cases, such as Brazil and the Philippines, it has found expression in

emergent

 formations that have won power electorally without succeeding in consolidating durable regimes but still maintain a strong presence in politics and society. In yet other cases, such as South Africa, the far right is present in more embryonic forms, as reactionary social movements and parties that have begun to make their sway felt in the political domain and throughout the social fabric.


I refer to these political monstrosities as Southern authoritarian populism, and the purpose of this essay is to provide a politically enabling diagnosis of it. My argument is not simply that authoritarian populism has appeared in different countries across the Global South. It is that these diverse trajectories are part of an interconnected turn toward the far right across the Global South. Rather than looking at these regimes, parties, and movements in ways that make despair convincing, I want to present a reading that makes hope possible.


This begs an obvious question: where do we find the critical intellectual resources that enable us to untangle the politics of the new far right in the Global South? My search for an answer to this question has led me to two major conclusions. The first of these is that standard academic perspectives on autocratization and far-right populism have little to offer us. Studies of autocratization show us how strongman leaders eviscerate democratic institutions, procedures, and norms. Populism studies have painted vivid portraits of how these leaders perform far-right politics as a distinctive political style. However, neither of these perspectives can tell us much about the real questions we should be asking if we want to understand Southern authoritarian populism from a progressive and radical perspective and in a way that allows us to counteract it. 


So what are the questions that we have to ask? They are questions about the political economy that has generated the precarious working classes that align with the far right; about the structures of feeling, simultaneously aspirational and anxious, that the far right has been capable of harnessing within this political economy; and they are questions about the ideological work that articulates diverse social forces into revanchist people-nations and produces consent from below to projects …

author: Abahlali_3
title: We mourn the loss of Des D’sa
content:
30 October 2026 Abahlali baseMjondolo press statement

We mourn the loss of Des D’Sa, father, uncle, grandfather, and a comrade to many

The death of Desmond D’Sa has plunged many people on the left in Durban and beyond, across numerous organisations, into shock and despair. Siyakhala ngo Des.

Comrade Des was a stalwart in the struggle against apartheid and was a well-known organiser who formed the South Durban Community Environmental Alliance (SDCEA), an environmental organisation that raised the concerns of families living in the oil- and gas-affected areas of Wentworth and the Bluff.

His activism and the fight against injustices did not end with environmental issues and it definitely did not end in Wentworth and the Bluff. Comrade Des fought against all forms of oppression and injustice, including gangsterism and the mining companies in rural areas, and supported everyone from fisherfolk to migrants and poor people, whether living in flats, hostels or shacks. He did not back down when struggle became dangerous. Comrade Des spoke fluent isiZulu and engaged everyone with the same respect.

He joined the first march against ANC councillor Yacoob Baig organised from Kennedy Road in 2005, which became part of the process towards the formation of our movement. He stood with our movement from the beginning, and was one of the few who never wavered in his support even when we were under severe attack and isolated.

Comrade Des was one of the founders of the Right to Know Campaign that fought fought against secrecy while promoting the right to information. He was also one of the founders of The Durban Coalition, which was first formed in response to the devastating floods of 2022. The Coalition, which unites community organisations across the city in a united front, is thriving today and is an important formation in the city.

We will miss Comrade Des so much. He was always on the side of the people. He was always so warm and kind. We always laughed when he was around.

We wish to thank his family for him. And wish to express our heartfelt condolences to his family, friends and comrades.

It is so sad and devastating that you have left us. Till we meet again.

Hamba kahle Comrade Des D’Sa. Ubuyiqhawe.
