author: Wini Omer
title: It’s not the refugees, it’s the austerity measures!
content:
A Sudanese journalist, with whom I worked for two years at the same newspaper, told me when I contacted him to check on his situation after the last wave of attacks against refugees in Libya: “We are trapped in our homes. We can’t leave. I didn’t send my kids to school since the beginning of this wave of violence. The situation is difficult beyond imagination.”

The Sudanese who left Sudan seeking refuge in Libya, amid very violent clashes that started in April 2023 and continue to this moment, are facing violence, danger, and hatred in what was supposed to be a safe refuge. But this reality is not exclusive to Sudanese refugees, and the violence is indifferent to other nationalities who are fleeing conflicts, war, and instability at home: Ethiopians, Eritreans, and refugees from the Central African Republic.

In Libya, African refugees faced waves of violence, the latest in June this year. Despite competing for power, Libya’s rival authorities in the east and west have united in stoking anti-migrant rhetoric and launching a violent campaign of mass detention and expulsions against migrants and refugees, as a recent

Human Rights Watch report

 has indicated.

In Egypt, a

crackdown campaign

 led by security forces, accompanied by social media hate speech against Sudanese and Syrian refugees, intensified on the ground, blaming them for the rise in living costs, mainly rents, groceries, and basic life needs. As a result of systematic brutality, between January and June 2026,

12 Sudanese passed away in Egyptian detention centers

 and police cells, including a child of 17. Refugees processed for deportation are forced to sign voluntary return declarations.

Sudan hosts one of the largest refugee and asylum-seeker populations in Africa, mainly South Sudanese, Ethiopians, and Eritreans, who currently face detention and

forced deportation

 from the capital, Khartoum, to refugee camps close to the borders with their countries of origin, after the Sudanese Armed Forces (SAF) regained control of the capital. This step was taken following a growing political rhetoric that profiled them as criminals and blamed them for the Rapid Support Forces (RSF) controlling Khartoum. Accordingly, they were deported to refugee camps in White Nile State, Al-Gadarif State, and Kassala State, camps that lack all basic human needs and restrict freedom of movement and the right to work. Many South Sudanese mothers were deported while their children were not allowed to accompany them, leaving them in limbo.

Such rhetoric, mainly produced and shared by pro-SAF individuals and platforms, provides the military establishment with a popular cover to reproduce its symbolic authority. It is also used by some actors within the army as a tool to bolster its legitimacy against the Rapid Support Forces, portraying it as the guardian of national sovereignty and the representative of the “authentic Sudanese” against the “foreign threat.” This reflects a deeper attempt to regain control over the state and society at a moment of total collapse of political and legal frameworks.

For many of these refugees, especially the Eritreans, returning is not an option, considering the human rights situation in Eritrea. But according to media reports, both Eritrea and Sudan are

complicit in the repatriation of civilians from Sudan

 back to Eritrea.

Whether it is the systematic violence against Sudanese refugees on the continent, or the deliberate violence against African refugees in Sudan, these incidents reflect one broader reality in which violence is used and reproduced either by state actors or by the citizens of the host countries to whom the refugees sought safety within the African continent. This reality raises a critical question about how to understand such incidents, the politics behind them, and why we are seeing them now.

Shifting the blame

Have the refugees led to the economic crises in Egypt, Libya, or Tunisia? Or are these crises a direct result of the state’s social and economic policies?

In Egypt, the last ten years have witnessed a high level of dependence on debt; Egypt has become one of the IMF’s largest borrowers, while social expenditure, including social protection, health, and education, has shrunk, accompanied by political oppression. Those debts have been invested in projects lacking a developmental dimension, such as

the new administrative capital

 project, which is expected to cost up to $300 billion by the time it’s finalized …

author: Amina Khan
title: EU transforms Frontex into a high-tech deportation command centre
content:
Yesterday, 27 October 2026, the European Commission tabled a new Regulation for Frontex, the EU’s border agency, expanding its powers and refocusing its mandate on deportations, preventing arrivals, and surveillance beyond EU territories and into social media. This would effectively turn Frontex into the EU’s deportation agency, equivalent of ICE in the United States.

At the centre of this reform is a budget that would almost double to nearly €12 billion for 2028–2034, leading to a massive expansion of the EU security and surveillance industrial complex. Frontex will test and deploy new technology to repress migrants, funnelling billions of taxpayer money to surveillance, security and defence contractors. EU’s hostile border security regime has for years produced systemic and massive human rights violations of migrants, refugees and racialised people, and those who stand in solidarity with them. This proposal will accelerate that.

Frontex as an ICE-style deportation enforcement agency

The proposal operationalises the recently adopted Deportations Regulation and deepens Frontex’s position as the central actor of a Europe-wide deportation machine. This will make the agency responsible for collecting and analysing data from Member States in order to “predict” deportation needs, and allocating resources to them. Frontex will now have a “Deportation Coordination Centre” that is expected to act at all stages of the deportation procedure, from detecting and identifying people that may be expulsed, booking or arranging flights and escorts, to monitoring their “reintegration” in the destination country.

Alarmingly, it expands Frontex’s powers to deport outside of the EU’s borders. Based on a simple status agreement, Frontex will be able to deport people from one third country to another, with the aim of preventing people from even reaching the EU. This will likely mean sharing sensitive data with third countries and countries of origin, where individuals may be at risk of persecution or harm.

The Frontex mandate reform comes in a package with a proposal to digitalise the management of deportation cases. The border control agency is given a key role in the harmonised technical design of EU and national digital systems, to exchange data on deportations, including sensitive data transfers to third countries (biometric data, travel documents and history, grounds for deportation, health data, etc.), and automate certain steps of the procedure, such as adding deportation orders in the Schengen Information System (SIS) to detect people.

Increased data processing and content policing

With this reform, Frontex’s practice of “debriefing interviews” is codified, particularly during the screening procedure introduced by the Migration Pact. The agency conducts these covert “voluntary” interrogations of people immediately after they disembark or cross the border. During these interviews, the agency extracts data from migrants deemed to be “suspects” of “cross-border crime”, without the possibility for migrants to seek legal counsel. Debriefing interviews have been rightfully criticised for their absence of fundamental rights monitoring and their unfairness as they take place when a person is detained and lacks privacy.

A new “Online Monitoring and Response Centre” will also surveil social media platforms to identify “suspicious behaviours or trends” in people’s movements at the EU borders, and before that, in the countries of origin and transit. Aggregated data collected online will be fed into Frontex’s “risk analysis” to guide border forces’ deployment and reaction. Social media monitoring was already declared as carrying high-risk for violating the fundamental rights of people affected, and was banned by the European Data Protection Supervisor in 2019 when first implemented by the EU Agency for Asylum.

Frontex will also seek designation as a trusted flagger under the Digital Services Act (DSA), allowing the agency to report pieces of online content to platforms for removal, effectively giving the agency extrajudicial powers to police the internet. It may also recommend national authorities to issue binding take-down notices. Frontex depriving people from finding legal support, sharing their stories or expressing solidarity is undoubtedly a serious infringement of freedom of expression.

All information collected during debriefings and online monitoring activities will contribute to Frontex’s border surveillance intelligence …

author: TGEU
title: Join the HIV Awareness Week in Berlin to establish the Emergency Support Network
content:
We are organising two free-of-charge parallel training programmes for queer and trans people that will come together on Friday, 20 November, to establish the Emergency Support Network.


This network should help people navigate services, identify realistic pathways to HIV prevention and care, and receive support without having to navigate complex systems alone. We also want to recognise that Ballroom houses, queer and trans collectives, and migrant communities already provide essential care infrastructure. We intend to strengthen these existing relationships, rather than create a parallel system disconnected from the communities themselves.


The initiative is particularly focused on two target audience groups:


Queer and trans people living with HIV who face barriers to accessing healthcare, especially those without health insurance, appropriate documentation, or access to HIV treatment and other essential services.


Queer and trans people on the move, including migrants, refugees, asylum seekers and undocumented people, who face difficulties accessing healthcare, HIV prevention, testing, PrEP, PEP and treatment.


Community HIV Training — 16, 18 and 20 November


This programme is intended for queer and trans adults, particularly queer and trans youth aged 18 and over, migrants, refugees, asylum seekers, undocumented people and other people on the move.


It is especially relevant to queer and trans people who are living with HIV and face difficulties accessing treatment or healthcare, as well as those who need access to HIV prevention, testing, PrEP, PEP and other sexual health services.


The sessions will be interactive and community-led, covering HIV prevention and care, PrEP, PEP, testing, treatment, U=U, sexual health, pleasure, harm reduction and navigating healthcare systems.


An important feature is that registration for this programme is anonymous.

 Participants are not asked to provide their names, email addresses or HIV status. Anyone who wants to receive practical information or reminders can voluntarily register their email address through a separate form, which is not linked to their anonymous demographic responses.


This distinction is particularly important for people who may be reluctant to engage with services or activities because of concerns about confidentiality, stigma or their migration status.


register here


Health Champions Training — 17, 19 and 20 November


This programme is designed for trans and queer community leaders, particularly people involved in Ballroom houses, collectives and grassroots networks.


The training follows a train-the-trainer approach and will cover HIV, STIs and other infectious diseases prevention, treatment and sexual and reproductive health knowledge, and other topics like U=U, harm reduction, structural barriers to healthcare, peer education and safe healthcare navigation.


Participants will work through practical exercises such as community mapping, HIV knowledge games, real-life scenarios, role-play and referral mapping. The objective is to equip them to become trusted points of connection between their communities and healthcare services, while recognising that Health Champions are not expected to act as clinicians, legal experts or crisis responders.


On the final day, Health Champions will meet healthcare professionals, service providers and participants from the other training programme to help establish practical referral pathways and community-based support structures.


register here


Building the Emergency Support Network

—


20 November


On Friday, participants from both programmes will come together with healthcare professionals, community organisations and service providers.


The aim is to establish direct connections between people who need support, trusted community leaders and organisations capable of providing services. Participants will learn what support is available, who can access it, what barriers remain and how to make safe referrals.


The week will culminate in

Under the Jellicle Moon Kiki Ball on Saturday, 21 November

, celebrating Ballroom culture, community leadership and the relationships developed throughout the initiative.


Note:

All workshop participants must be 18 or older and attend all three days of their respective training. Snacks and dinner will be provided each day.

author: CMI Argentina
title: Denunciaron ante la CIDH la política migratoria de Milei: restricciones para pobres y privilegios para el poder económico
content:
La Comisión Argentina para personas Refugiadas y Migrantes (CAREF), la Red Nacional de Migrantes y Refugiados, el Movimiento de Trabajadores Excluidos (MTE/UTEP) y el Centro de Estudios Legales y Sociales (CELS) expusieron ante la la Comisión Interamericana de Derechos Humanos (CIDH) sobre las reformas migratorias impulsadas por el gobierno argentino de ultraderecha, que dificultan la regularización, aumentan las restricciones y estigmatizan a migrantes pobres, mientras habilita mecanismos extraordinarios de naturalización para el poder económico buscando facilitar la extranjerización de la tierra y los bienes comunes.


Compartimos el comunicado del CELS:


Política migratoria: la Argentina ante la CIDH


CAREF, la Red Nacional de Migrantes y Refugiados, el MTE/UTEP y el CELS expusimos ante la CIDH sobre las reformas migratorias impulsadas por el gobierno argentino. Advertimos sobre las dificultades para la regularización, las restricciones para acceder a la salud -mujeres embarazadas sin atención, niñas, niños y adolescentes con atención discontinua- y una política de control migratorio estigmatizante.


Hoy participamos del 197° Período de Sesiones de la Comisión Interamericana de Derechos Humanos (CIDH) en una audiencia sobre el impacto de las reformas en las políticas de regularización, acceso a la salud y control migratorio en la Argentina. CAREF, la Red Nacional de Migrantes y Refugiados, el MTE/UTEP y el CELS expusimos sobre las consecuencias de una serie de reformas que están desarticulando una política migratoria construida durante más de veinte años basada en el reconocimiento de la migración como un derecho humano. Desde 2024, y especialmente a partir del DNU 366/2025, el Gobierno dificultó el acceso a la residencia regular, restringió derechos, modificó las condiciones de expulsión y trasladó la gestión migratoria y de protección de refugiados a la órbita del Ministerio de Seguridad. Estas medidas fueron adoptadas sin debate en el Congreso y acompañadas por un discurso oficial que asocia la migración con la inseguridad y la criminalidad.


Uno de los principales efectos de las reformas que denunciamos ante las y los comisionados es que la regularización se volvió más difícil para quienes tienen menos recursos. El DNU 366 incorporó como requisito para acceder a la residencia permanente -y renovar la temporaria- la acreditación de medios económicos suficientes, mediante formas de prueba vinculadas fundamentalmente al trabajo registrado. Desde su entrada en vigencia, las residencias permanentes otorgadas cayeron de 24 mil a 8 mil por semestre. Al mismo tiempo, se eliminó el acceso a la residencia permanente que correspondía por tener hijos, hijas o cónyuges argentinos. El resultado es que miles de personas con trabajo, familia y años de arraigo en el país pueden ser empujadas a la irregularidad. Mientras se endurecen estas condiciones, el Gobierno habilita mecanismos extraordinarios de naturalización para quienes realizan grandes inversiones: una política migratoria cada vez más restrictiva para los sectores de menores ingresos y privilegiada para quienes tienen recursos económicos.


Las organizaciones también advertimos sobre las consecuencias que este proceso ya tiene en el acceso a la salud, al trabajo y a otros derechos básicos. El DNU 366 dejó de garantizar el acceso gratuito al sistema público nacional de salud -excepto en emergencias- para quienes no tengan residencia permanente. Pudimos registrar interrupciones de tratamientos y estudios, solicitantes de asilo que no fueron atendidos, mujeres embarazadas sin atención oportuna y niñas, niños y adolescentes con atención discontinua. La irregularidad migratoria repercute además sobre el trabajo: quienes integran la economía popular difícilmente pueden acreditar ingresos mediante un recibo de sueldo y, sin DNI, encuentran todavía más obstáculos para ingresar al trabajo registrado y ejercer otros derechos.


Este retroceso se combina con una política de control y hostigamiento sobre la población migrante. La Red Nacional de Migrantes y Refugiados denunció controles de identidad, requisas y demoras arbitrarias que afectan especialmente a personas de piel morena, con rasgos indígenas o afrodescendientes. Desde la UTEP se señaló que los llamados operativos de “control poblacional”, realizados junto con fuerzas federales y la Dirección Nacional de Migraciones, se concentran en espacios del comercio informal donde trabajan numerosos vendedores ambulantes …

author: Ben Smoke
title: Home Secretary Refuses to Meet Worker Affected by Her ‘Nasty’ Immigration Plans
content:
Home secretary Shabana Mahmood has refused to meet with a migrant care worker who will be affected by her rightwing immigration reforms.


Mahmood was asked to meet the worker as part of a discussion with Unison boss Andrea Egan about plans to make migrants wait up to 15 years to apply for indefinite leave to remain,

the i Paper reported

. 


But the home secretary refused Egan’s request and the meeting, which is part of

a charm offensive by Mahmood

 to stave off a growing rebellion against her reforms, was cancelled.


Unison is officially affiliated with the Labour party and has been at the forefront of opposition to Mahmood’s plans. Egan, who was expelled from Labour amid a purge of leftwing members in 2022, has described the reforms as “dehumanising”. 


Egan

said on X

 on Wednesday: “Shabana Mahmood’s failure to engage with the migrant workers whose lives her nasty proposals will devastate is totally unacceptable. These are brilliant, committed workers who hold our public services together. Unison won’t tolerate them being attacked and ignored.” 


The Home Office

told the i Paper

 the meeting was a private one-on-one talk between Mahmood and Egan that Unison had chosen to cancel.


Former shadow chancellor John McDonnell urged Mahmood to “think again on this decision not to meet” the worker. Writing on

X

, he said “the work visa issue is causing totally unnecessary division in the Labour party.”


In an interview with

 Sky News

 on Thursday, energy secretary Miatta Fahnbulleh refused five times to back Mahmood’s policy of making people wait 15 years for permanent residency. 


In a now deleted social media post earlier this week,

Fahnbulleh hit out

 at “any attempt to prolong the time people have to wait for settlement.”


In March this year whilst not a member of cabinet, Angela Rayner referred to the reforms as

“un-British”

. She

has since

 attempted to downplay reports of a cabinet split over the policy. 


The government

has delayed

 its official announcement of the policy, the Critic reported, and says it is “considering responses” to a public consultation that closed in February.

EU-Türkei-Deal in der Flüchtlingsfrage

Elend statt sicherer Zuflucht: Griechenland fordert weitere Ausnahmen vom EU-Asylrecht. Schutzsuchende werden nach gescheiterten Registrierungsversuchen festgenommen


„Griechenlands Migrationsminister Athanasios Plevris forderte Anfang Oktober beim EU-Innenministertreffen in Luxemburg, Asylanträge in sogenannten »Migrationskrisen« zeitweise aussetzen und Abschiebungen beschleunigen zu können. Das begründet er mit steigenden Ankunftszahlen und einer angeblichen »Instrumentalisierung« von Migration. Auch die Bundesregierung positioniert sich im Einklang mit der bisherigen Abschottungspolitik Europas offen für weitere Einschränkungen. Der zuvor bereits praktizierte Abbau des Schutzes geflüchteter Menschen durch beschleunigte Grenzverfahren und erweiterte Haftmöglichkeiten wird seit Juni 2026 durch das EU-Asylsystem GEAS geregelt. Griechenlands Vorstoß geht noch einen Schritt weiter: Er zielt darauf, bislang rechtswidrige kollektive Zurückweisungen ohne individuelle Asylprüfung rechtlich abzusichern. Wie sich der erschwerte Zugang zu Asylverfahren auswirkt, zeigt sich in Malakasa, rund 40 Kilometer nördlich von Athen. Dort befinden sich ein Aufnahme- und Identifizierungszentrum und ein Flüchtlingslager. Für einen Registrierungstermin auf dem Festland muss eine Onlineplattform genutzt werden, die nach Angaben der griechischen Rechtsorganisation Refugee Support Aegean (RSA) seit Juni 2026 außer Betrieb ist. In einer Stellungnahme vom 7. Oktober 2026 berichtet RSA von Menschen, die beim Versuch, persönlich Asyl zu beantragen, festgenommen und strafrechtlich verfolgt worden seien. Flucht und Schutzbegehren würden dadurch faktisch als Straftat behandelt. So dokumentierte die Organisation unter anderem Fälle, in denen afghanischen Frauen die Registrierung verweigert und sie von den Behörden kriminalisiert wurden: Ohne dass ihr Asylgesuch überhaupt registriert wurde, verurteilten Gerichte sie wegen angeblich illegalen Aufenthalts zu zweijährigen Haft- und hohen Geldstrafen. Die Vollstreckung wurde unter der Auflage der umgehenden Rückkehr nach Afghanistan ausgesetzt. Damit wird die Rückreise zur Bedingung für Straffreiheit in Griechenland. Nicht nur Frauen und queere Menschen sind danach den Taliban und deren systematischen Menschenrechtsverletzungen ausgesetzt. Auch wer sich erfolgreich als asylsuchend registriert hat, nicht in haftähnlichen Bedingungen festgehalten wird und einen Platz in einer offenen Unterkunft erhält, ist nicht ausreichend versorgt. (…) Was in Brüssel als notwendige Verschärfung des Asylrechts verhandelt wird, trifft in Malakasa auf ein Aufnahmesystem, in dem bestehende Rechte trotz regem Aktivismus in- und außerhalb der Lagerstrukturen schwer durchzusetzen sind. Während europäische Regierungen über zusätzliche Möglichkeiten beraten, Menschen vom Asylverfahren auszuschließen, kämpfen Schutzsuchende darum, ihre geltenden Rechte überhaupt durchzusetzen.“

Zwölf Menschen haben bislang bei zwei neuen tödlichen Vorfällen auf Lesbos und Samos ihr Leben verloren. Eine weitere Person wird auf der Intensivstation von Mytilini mit schwersten Schädel-Hirn-Traumata behandelt, während sich unter den Überlebenden Verletzte mit Knochenbrüchen befinden. Insbesondere der Vorfall auf Lesbos weist besorgniserregende Ähnlichkeiten mit dem tödlichen Vorfall auf Chios im Februar 2026 auf. title: Liberté pour Jülide, Non à son extradition !
content:
Depuis le 4 août, Jülide Yazıcı, notre camarade communiste, militante, autrice pour la revue turque Teori ve Politika et réfugiée politique en France depuis 10 ans, est détenue en Albanie à la suite d'une demande d'extradition émise par les autorités turques par le biais d'une utilisation abusive des notices rouges d'

INTERPOL

.


Depuis plus de dix ans, Jülide milite pour des causes justes en Turquie et en Europe. 


En France, et plus précisément à Tours, Jülide participe à différents cadres militants : le collectif Solidarité Palestine 37, les ateliers populaires anti-impérialiste et l'Union pour la Reconstruction Communiste.


En Turquie, Jülide fait l'objet de poursuites dans un contexte de répression du mouvement kurde et de ses soutiens. Les faits qui lui sont reprochés sont qualifiés de «

 

soutien logistique

 

» au

PKK

 par les autorités turques, qui les inscrivent dans le cadre de la lutte antiterroriste. Nous dénonçons le recours routinier à cette qualification pour criminaliser les engagements politiques et réprimer les solidarités avec le peuple kurde. Nous exprimons notre entière solidarité avec Jülide.


Après deux mois d'incertitude, la décision en première instance a été prise ce mercredi 21 octobre : l'Albanie acte l'extradition de Jülide vers la Turquie. Cette décision de première instance n'est pas définitive dans la mesure où Jülide va faire appel, faire valoir ses droits les plus fondamentaux. Néanmoins, cette décision profondément politique a été prise dans un contexte où le juge prétendait refuser toute considération politique. Ce dernier arguant à l'avocat de Jülide que son argumentaire basé sur le droit d'asile européen n'était pas à appliquer en Albanie, État qui prétend adhérer à l'Union Européenne, État signataire de la convention de Genève de 1951 sur le droit d'asile. 


Malgré ces dispositions juridiques, la justice albanaise a acté, en première instance, l'extradition de notre camarade. 


Nous ne pouvons pas accepter les faits tels qu'ils nous sont présentés. Invoquant son refus de traiter politiquement l'affaire, le juge a pourtant émis une décision profondément politique : il a admis lui-même «

 

s'en remettre au ministère de la justice albanais

 

» qui, ici, n'est que le porte parole de la volonté de l'État turc, et ce, au mépris du droit européen auquel l'Albanie prétend adhérer. 


La France, dans ce contexte, joue un rôle majeur, et jusqu'ici, insuffisant. Quand le juge et le ministère de la justice albanais reçoivent des pressions de l'état turc, la France se contente du minimum : la protection consulaire, c'est-à-dire rendre visite à Jülide en prison et être présent lors des séances devant le juge. Or, la France est le pays qui a accordé le statut de réfugiée à Jülide, et, par la même, lui a fourni les documents nécessaires pour voyager. Le statut de réfugiée politique de Jülide oblige la France. Il apparaît aberrant que l'État français accorde aux réfugiés les documents nécessaires pour voyager hors de l'Union européenne sans leur garantir sa protection

 

!


À l'heure où le pouvoir autoritaire d'Erdoğan fait clairement pression sur la justice albanaise pour qu'elle aille dans son sens, nous, militants progressistes en France, appelons notre État à assumer le rôle qu'il a choisi de porter en accordant le statut de réfugiée à Jülide. Nous continuerons ainsi la lutte afin d'intensifier le rapport de force, jusqu'à ce que l'État français assume véritablement son rôle. Actuellement, une personne bénéficiant du statut de réfugiée politique, et donc de la protection de l'état français, en procédure de naturalisation, est détenue illégitimement en Albanie. 


Notre camarade n'est pas seule, nous continuerons de nous mobiliser, partout, jusqu'à sa libération. Nous appelons les autorités françaises a assurer la protection qui lui est due, à agir diplomatiquement, politiquement, pour permettre la libération de Jülide et enrayer ce simulacre de procédure judiciaire initié par l'État turc. 


Nous lutterons et nous obtiendrons sa libération

 

!


Liberté pour Jülide, Non à son extradition

 

!


yulide

author: Sam Wainwright
title: Reject the AUKUS death machine, join the fight for the future
content:
The nuclear powered submarine USS Colorado docked at the HMAS Stirling naval base on Menadup/Garden Island, five kilometres from Rockingham in Perth’s southern suburbs, on October 27.

The vessel is in port for a month of maintenance exercises in preparation for the Submarine Rotational Force — West program which will start in September next year, being the first of four United States’ and one British nuclear powered submarines based at HMAS Stirling.

Its arrival was an opportunity for Labor to insist that AUKUS is “on track”, without resolving any of the significant cost and time blow-outs associated with the plan to build the SSN-AUKUS class submarines.

It also means that HMAS Stirling has become a de facto US navy base, with its submarines and crew not just visiting, but stationed in Western Australia, allowing the US to qualitatively step up its presence in the Indian Ocean.

When AUKUS was announced five years ago, in the shadow of Russia’s invasion of Ukraine, we were told it was necessary in order to uphold a mythical “rules based order”. Since then, Israel has gone on a genocidal rampage with the support of western governments.

Any hope that US President Donald Trump’s violent rejection of international law, in both word and deed, might lead the Anthony Albanese government to have second thoughts about integrating Australia ever more tightly with US military strategy, through AUKUS and the Force Posture Agreement, has been smashed on the rocks.

The opposite is true. Neither Albanese, foreign minister Penny Wong or defence minister Richard Marles have spoken against Trump’s rampage across the world; be it the kidnapping of the Venezuelan president, threats against Greenland and Canada, the criminal blockade of Cuba, bombing of Iran or the the cruelly misnamed "Board of Peace” foisted on Gaza.

When Wong was directly asked by a journalist whether she agreed that the war on Iran was a breach of the United Nations Charter, the best she could manage was this mealy-mouthed response — “It’s up to the US and Israel to explain the legality of their actions”.

While the Albanese government might still cloak its domestic neoliberal economic agenda in some token progressive rhetoric and gestures to mark out some space between it and the Coalition, its foreign policy is now completely subordinate to Trump’s.

Reinforcing this orientation is the long established ambition of both Labor and Liberal to make Australia one of the world's top ten weapons exporters, further tightening integration with both US and Israeli weapons manufacturers.

Trump’s decision to boost US military spending by 50% on 2025 levels by 2027 has turned this push into a stampede as Australian governments, businesses and universities fall over themselves to try to get a slice of the action.

Meanwhile, urgent action to address the real existential threat to humanity posed by runaway global warming is stalled, demonstrated by the approval of new and expanded fossil fuel projects and Labor’s lowering of expectations ahead of the COP31 climate summit.

Capitalism, based on the endless search for profits and growth, is incapable of solving the climate crisis.

Since the industrial revolution, every new source of energy — biomass, coal, oil, nuclear and renewables — has added to energy production, not replaced it. In other words capitalism welcomes renewables, but in addition to fossil fuels, not instead of them.

Both the federal government and senior military strategists are perfectly well aware of this, just as they know that this will lead to climate breakdown, social crisis and war.

Consequently the real long term climate plan of the Albanese government is increased repression at home and war abroad. It’s not an exaggeration to say that militarism is their deadly serious response to the climate crisis.

Confronting and dismantling AUKUS, the Force Posture Agreement and the weapons industry is central to the fight for a safe climate.

A certain amount of catastrophic warming is already baked into the system. Even if we do everything materially possible to halt and reverse warming starting today, we still face massive ecological disruption. But this is no excuse for giving up.

Replacing a society based on greed, that is pushing us to ecological collapse and war, with a society based on human solidarity is necessary to face the climate crisis. But we face serious obstacles in the fight to pull humanity back from the brink.

Modern day capitalists …

author: Monthly Review Press
title: LIVE Oct 30, in DC! See Aymeric Monville, Jennifer Ponce de León and Gabriel Rockhill, speaking on “Requiem for French Theory”
content:
NYC, on October 29th, at CUNY (25 Broadway) * DC, on October 30th at Busboys and Poets (235 Carol St NW) * (And a couple of days ago in Philly’s Free Library)


APPEARANCES


Coming from Left Field

 (Episode 152)


In this episode of Coming From Left Field, philosopher and cultural critic Gabriel Rockhill joins

Greg Godels & Pat Cummings

 to explore the Ford Foundation, the 1966 Johns Hopkins conference often cited as a launching point for French Theory in the United States, Cold War cultural politics, and the wider political economy of academic knowledge production. Rockhill argues for rebuilding a class-centered, internationalist Marxism and joins a thoughtful exchange on China, Vietnam, socialism, imperialism, inequality, and the challenges of assessing existing socialist projects without demonization or uncritical celebration….


Marx Memorial Library

in London hosted a dual book launch for

Requiem for French Theory

 and

Who Paid the Pipers of Western Marxism?

with Gabriel Rockhill, Aymeric Monville, and Jennifer Ponce de León, who engaged in a discussion regarding the effects of imperialism on the production and dissemination of knowledge.

Watch here

or below


Far from simply engaging in a critique of the faux radicalism of the prominent discourses within the imperial theory industry, the discussion was grounded in a reasoned defense of the vibrant international tradition of anti-imperialist Marxism. Topics included the imperial promotion of Western Marxism and postmodern French Theory, the international war of ideas, the failed efforts to discredit anti-imperialist Marxism, culturalism and identity politics vs. a materialist analysis of the colonial question, fascism past and present, the dialectics of actually existing socialism, and the current state of global class struggle in theory and practice.


REVIEWS


Marxism-Leninism Today,

 by

Greg Godels

:


“During the 1960s and 1970s, it was an oft-repeated quip that the European left was long on theory and short on practice, while the North American left was strong on action, but allergic to theory. In West Germany, Italy, and France, young leftists would often passionately debate theoretical questions deep into the night, while seldom coming to a common commitment to action the next day. Their youthful U.S. counterparts—revived after the retreat from High McCarthyism–counted on spontaneous action and a firm commitment to common, inherited political values rather than the ideas buried in deep theoretical tracts. But those observations were far from completely true. The often student-driven U.S. New Left developed a thirst for a broader, deeper explanation of the injustices that they were rejecting. Many of those committed to action turned to left classics–quite often a reconsidered Marx–and others favored a wave of West European radical-oriented thinkers….”

Read more…


ZZ’s Blog

, as reviewed by Zigedy:


“During the 1960s and 1970s, it was an oft-repeated quip that the European left was long on theory and short on practice, while the North American left was strong on action, but allergic to theory. In West Germany, Italy, and France, young leftists would often passionately debate theoretical questions deep into the night, while seldom coming to a common commitment to action the next day. Their youthful US counterparts–revived after the retreat from High McCarthyism– counted on spontaneous action and a firm commitment to common, inherited political values rather than the ideas buried in deep theoretical tracts. But those observations were far from completely true. The often student-driven US New Left developed a thirst for a broader, deeper explanation of the injustices that they were rejecting. Many of those committed to action turned to left classics– quite often a reconsidered Marx– and others favored a wave of West European radical-oriented thinkers. It is the rise and importation to the US of one particularly influential “brand” of European theory to which Aymeric Monville and Gabriel Rockhill’s new book is devoted.


In

 Requiem for French Theory: Transatlantic Funeral Dirge in a Marxist Key

 (New York,

Monthly Review Press

, 2026, $22.00, 168 pp.), Monville and Rockhill show that what became known as “French Theory” in the US was both a calculated interruption of the rediscovery and study of Marxism and an intellectual trend hostile to anti-capitalist and socialist currents….”

author: Jonathan Rosenblum
title: Vancouver Is the Next Battleground for Municipal Socialism in North America
content:
Vancouver socialists won big. What comes next?

Truthout is an indispensable resource for activists, movement leaders and workers everywhere. Please make this work possible with a quick donation.

Vancouver, British Columbia, is the next battleground for municipal socialism in North America.

On October 17, Vancouver voters decisively evicted their right-wing mayor, replacing him with the Green Party’s candidate. But more consequentially, they also tossed nearly all of the pro-corporate incumbents from all three municipal legislative bodies — city council, the school board, and the parks board — and replaced them with a combination of insurgents from the left-wing party Coalition of Progressive Electors (COPE), the Greens, and an establishment center-left party, OneCity.

A broadly democratic socialist organization, COPE ran on a bold platform demanding full rent control, an end to data center construction, and taxing the rich to fund social housing, schools, parks, and libraries. All 12 COPE candidates swept into office, constituting the single largest party bloc. Now with those dozen seats on the three boards — out of 27 total seats — COPE is poised to advance a bold, socialist-inspired agenda for one of Canada’s major cities.

This is a massive political sea-change from the last municipal election. In 2022, A Better City Vancouver (ABC Vancouver) swept to power, placing businessman Ken Sim in the mayor’s office and winning 7 out of 10 seats on city council; six out of seven on the parks board; and five out of nine on the school board.

Over the following four years, Sim and his allies advanced an unabashedly pro-developer agenda. They froze the city’s Empty Homes Tax; waived developer fees; eliminated the city’s Renters Office; and canceled climate justice programs. The ABC Party-majority school board starved programs for vulnerable students, tried to sell off school properties, and severely restricted public participation at board meetings. Sim also pushed to make Vancouver a bitcoin-friendly city, led a failed effort to abolish the parks board, and rankled many when he set up a private gym for himself in city hall.

Sim embraced the ruling class, collecting maximum individual donations of $1,250 from the likes of Lululemon founder and billionaire Chip Wilson; leaders within major real estate development companies, including Polygon Homes, Westbank, and Onni; and venture capital firm Canaccord Genuity. Sim repaid those favors, declaring October 3 to be “Chip Wilson Day” and honoring Canaccord’s founding chairman with his own day on October 18.

Featuring a huge seaport and international airport, Vancouver is Canada’s Pacific trade gateway. Big tech firms — like Amazon, Microsoft, and Telus — have a prominent presence in the city. Tourism and film production also are big economic drivers. But property development and investment have come to dominate the city’s downtown, with gleaming glass skyscrapers towering over the water and the city’s iconic Stanley Park. In the last 40 years, both domestic and foreign capital have rushed in to snap up Vancouver’s luxury condominiums and business centers. For many owners, these are not places to live or do business in, but rather serve as lucrative tax shelters and investments.

A city of almost 700,000, Vancouver is home to no fewer than seven billionaires, and the contrast between the uber-wealthy and the rest of the population is profound. A majority of Vancouver residents are renters. Rent control — set by provincial authorities — hasn’t stopped Vancouver from clocking median rents of $2,600 per month ($1,850 in U.S. dollars). Rents are 37 percent above the national average in Vancouver, making it the most expensive rental market in Canada. Some 40 percent of Vancouver tenants are rent-burdened — spending more than 30 percent of their income on housing costs and scrimping on other necessities. Nearly three-quarters of the city’s beloved community centers have been deemed to be in poor or very poor condition. School classrooms are overcrowded and understaffed.

Housing, however, is the most animating issue. Talk to any renter in Vancouver and inevitably the problem of “renovictions” and “demovictions” will come up. British Columbia limits how much landlords can raise rents annually. But there’s no prohibition on evicting tenants by claiming that renovations are needed, and then jacking up the rent for the new tenants. Landlords have grabbed onto this statutory loophole …

title: İspanya’da can kaybı 69’a yükseldi, makinistler grevde: Demir yolu işçilerinin sesi duyulmadı, özelleştirme çarptı
content:
İspanya’nın Toledo bölgesinde iki hızlı trenin çarpışması sonucu hayatını kaybedenlerin sayısı 69 yükseldi. Kaza, özelleştirme tartışmalarını yeniden gündeme taşıdı. Geçtiğimiz 18 Ocak’ta bir başka tren kazasında 46 kişi ölmüş, demir yolu işçileri özelleştirmeyi ve yarattığı güvenlik risklerini protesto etmek için grev yapmıştı. Hükümetin taahhütleri üzerine grev tamamlanmamış ancak vaatler yerine getirilmediği için makinist sendikası Semaf, “demir yollarında güvenlik” koşullarının sağlanması talebiyle 29 Ekim için yeni grev kararı açıklamıştı. Kaza, grevden bir gün önce gerçekleşti. Sanchez Hükümeti kazanın hemen ardından “insan hatası” diyerek demir yolu işçilerini hedef gösterirken, Samef grevi iptal etmedi ve makinistler dün 24 saat iş bıraktı.

Toledo’nın Urda bölgesindeki kazada devlete ait Renfe şirketine ait bir AVE treni (hızlı tren), Madrid-Endülüs yüksek hızlı demir yolu hattının 118. kilometresinde durmakta olan Iryo şirketine ait trene arkadan çarptı. Çarpışmanın etkisiyle Iryo treninin en arkadaki iki vagonu raydan çıkarak yuvarlandı.

Kazadan birkaç saat sonra İspanya Ulaştırma Bakanlığı “insan hatası” açıklaması yaparak suçu işçileri yıkmanın yolunu açtı. Sendikalar ise özelleştirme sonrası arızalı sistemler, azaltılmış personel ve taşeronlara devredilmiş, finansmanı kesilmiş bakım hizmetleriyle ayakta durmaya çalışan demir yolu sistemine dikkat çekiyor.

18 Ocak 2026’da da Adamuz bölgesinde de yine bir Iryo treni raydan çıkarak yan hattın üzerine girmiş ve bu hattaki bir trenle çarpışmıştı. Iryo, kasım 2022’de hizmet vermeye başlayan İspanya’nın ilk özel hızlı tren operatörü. Bu kazada 46 kişi hayatını kaybetti, 126 kişi yaralandı. İspanyol Lokomotif Makinistleri ve Demiryolu Yardımcıları Sendikasının (Semaf), ağustos 2025’te demir yolu altyapısından sorumlu devlet kurumu Adif’e, daha sonra raydan çıkma olayının meydana geldiği bölgedeki rayların aşırı aşınması konusunda uyarıda bulunduğu, ancak herhangi bir önlem alınmadığı ortaya çıktı. Adamuz kazasından iki gün sonra, Barselona’da bir setin çökmesi sonucu stajyer bir makinist hayatını kaybetti.

Demir yolu işçileri o dönemde de taşeron şirketlere devredilen ve kaynak ayrılmayan bakım hizmetleri sorununa dikkat çekmiş ve 9, 10 ve 11 Şubat tarihlerinde grev ilan etmişti. İlk gününde greve, ülke genelinde 34 binden fazla demir yolu işçisi katıldı ve 350 trenin seferleri durduruldu. Grev çağrısını yapan CCOO, UGT, CGT ve Semaf sendikaları, hükümetin “sektörün yapısal sorunlarını” ele almasını talep etti. Bu dört sendikadan üçü olan CCOO, UGT ve Semaf, Ulaştırma Bakanlığı ile bakım harcamalarının artırılması konusunda anlaşmaya vardıktan sonra grevin diğer günlerini iptal etti.

Ancak bu taahhütler yerine getirilmediği gerekçesiyle İspanya’daki tren makinistlerinin yüzde 85’inin örgütlü olduğu Semaf sendikası 16 Ekim’de yaptığı açıklama ile 29 Ekim için 24 saatlik grev ilan etmişti. Grevin talepleri arasında “Raylar üzerindeki risklere karşı önlemlerin alınması” ve “Demir yolu araçlarında süregelen güvenlik ve güvenilirlik sorunlarına yönelik gerçek ve kalıcı teknik çözümler” yer alıyordu.

Semaf, Toledo’da meydana gelen kazadan sonra yaptığı açıklamada da, güvenlik konusunda yapısal iyileştirmeler ve verilen taahhütlerin yerine getirilmesi talebiyle çağrısını yaptıkları 24 saatlik grevden geri adım atmadıklarını duyurdu. Grev gece yarısı başladı ve dün gerçekleştirildi.

Ayrıca, önümüzdeki cuma gününden itibaren Ouigo’da altı günlük grev çağrısını da sürdürme kararı alındı. Ouigo, Fransa Devlet Demiryolları (SNCF) bünyesinde faaliyet gösteren, 2021’den itibaren İspanya’da da düşük maliyetli hızlı tren hizmeti sunan bir ulaşım şirketi.

Bu arada Genel Emek Sendikası (CGT) da Toledo kazasında bağımsız bir inceleme yapılmadan makinistlerin suçlanmasına tepki gösterdi. CGT Konfederasyon Komitesi Daimi Sekreterliği, “Demir yolu güvenliği için yatırım, bakım ve yeterli personel gereklidir. Bu on yıllardır talep ettiğimiz bir konudur” açıklaması yaptı.

Demir yollarının özelleştirilmesi sadece bir hükümet politikası değil, Avrupa Birliği’nin de üyelerine bir dayatması.

İspanya basınında demir yollarındaki güvenlik sorununun başlangıcı olarak 1991 yılı gösteriliyor. O yıl 91/440/CEE sayılı Avrupa Direktifi, demir yolu altyapısı ve tren işletmeciliğinin birbirinden ayrılmasını zorunlu kıldı. İspanyol demir yolu sistemi Adif ve Renfe olarak iki şirkete ayrıldı. author: Stelinsky
title: Τοποθέτηση για τη ληστεία τράπεζας στην Κάτω Τιθωρέα (Γιάννης Τζ.)
content:
«Ο άνθρωπος είναι για τον άνθρωπο λύκος», σε έναν κόσμο που γίνεται αντιληπτός ως πεδίο απόλυτου ανταγωνισμού και αντικείμενο προς ολοκληρωτική εκμετάλλευση από τους κυρίαρχους.

«Η φύση δημιούργησε με τέτοιο τρόπο τον άνθρωπο, ώστε να μπορεί όλα να τα επιθυμεί, να μην μπορεί όμως να τα αποκτήσει όλα. Συνεπώς, καθώς η επιθυμία είναι πάντοτε ανώτερη από την ικανότητα απόκτησης, ο άνθρωπος δεν ευχαριστιέται με αυτά που κατέχει και μένει ανικανοποίητος από τον εαυτό του».

Με αυτήν τη διορατική και διατρητική παραδοχή της κοσμοαντίληψης των διαχρονικά κυρίαρχων, θα ήθελα να προσπεράσω τις χιλιετίες της ανθρώπινης ιστορίας που παρουσίασαν πλειάδα εκμεταλλευτικών καθεστώτων ανισότητας και δυστυχίας, και να σταθώ μόνο στο καπιταλιστικό σύστημα από τον 18 αιώνα και έπειτα. Η μακιαβελική και χομπσιανή σύλληψη του κόσμου ως ένα πεδίο απολύτως ανταγωνιστικών και βάρβαρων όντων, που συγκρούονται συνεχώς για να αποκτήσουν περισσότερο πλούτο και ισχύ το ένα έναντι του άλλου, δεν αποτελεί κάποιου είδους «ανθρωπολογική απαισιοδοξία», αλλά αντικατοπτρίζει πλήρως το πώς οι απολογητές της καπιταλιστικής βαρβαρότητας θωρούν τις ζωές τους και τις ζωές μας: Όλα είναι αναλώσιμα, πλούτος που έχει ή δεν έχει κατακτηθεί, όντα και συνειδήσεις που έχουν ή δεν έχουν υποταχθεί.

Κατασκεύασαν ένα φιλοσοφικό δόγμα, με διαφορετικές μορφές και προσεγγίσεις, αλλά άτεγκτο και απαράλλαχτο στη βαθύτατη ουσία του. Πασχίζοντας να δικαιολογήσουν την αθλιότητα και την χυδαιότητά τους υπό τη φθηνή λεζάντα της «φυσικής επιλογής και αναγκαιότητας». Λογικό: Πώς άλλωστε θα φαινόταν αν εξέφραζαν αφτιασίδωτα την πραγματική τους ιστορία; Αν ξεκινούσαν από την πρωταρχική συσσώρευση πόρων και μέσων παραγωγής από την ακμάζουσα αστική τάξη του 18 αιώνα; Αν συνέχιζαν με τις αρπαγές γαιών, των εκτοπισμό πληθυσμών και την ερήμωση της υπαίθρου, τη βίαιη αστικοποίηση μέσω συσσώρευσης εργατικού δυναμικού και μέσων παραγωγής στα αστικά κέντρα, καθώς και τη συνολική απόσπαση του κοινωνικού πλούτου από τα χέρια αυτών που τον παράγουν, αναδύοντάς τους ως πάμφτωχο βιομηχανικό προλεταριάτο; Πολλές «όμορφες» επιστημονικοφανείς λέξεις περιγράφουν τη διαδικασία της «ανάπτυξης» του καπιταλιστικού καθεστώτος. Καμία δεν εκφράζει στη ρίζα της την κατάσταση: Πρόκειται για μία πρωταρχική ένοπλη ληστεία, για συστηματική αφαίμαξη, για ωμή επιβολή δια της βίας και μέσω ισχυρότερων όπλων και στρατιωτικών μορφών έναντι των αδύναμων που οι ίδιοι δημιούργησαν. Έπλασαν τους όρους, κατασκεύασαν αφηγήματα-καθρέπτες της δυσώδους σαπίλας τους. Μέσα σε ένα πεδίο διαρκώς εκτυλισσόμενων κοινωνικών ανταγωνισμών, πολλοί υποστήριξαν την ανάπτυξη εθνών-κρατών ως διαμεσολαβητές-διαιτητές που διατηρούν σε «ισορροπία» τα κανιβαλικά και αντικρουόμενα συμφέροντα, εφόσον «ο άνθρωπος αποτελεί κίνδυνο για τον άνθρωπο».

Θεωρούν πως όλοι οι άνθρωποι είναι πλασμένοι κατ΄εικόνα και καθ΄ομοίωσή τους, πως φαντασιώνουν τον εαυτό τους ως εν δυνάμει πλούσιο και αδηφάγο τύραννο. Πώς θα συνυπάρξουν όλοι αυτοί οι μονίμως αντιμαχόμενοι και αχόρταγοι τυραννίσκοι χωρίς να αλληλοεξοντωθούν ολοκληρωτικά; Μα φυσικά με την οριστική επικράτηση ενός ή λίγων τυράννων που, αναλαμβάνοντας τον ρόλο του «θεϊκού διαμεσολαβητή», θα επωμιστούν το μονοπώλιο επί της βίας και τη δυνατότητα να ξεπερνούν το κατώφλι της επίπλαστης νομιμότητας σε καταστάσεις εξαίρεσης/ έκτακτης ανάγκης, τιθασεύοντας τη «φυσική ανθρώπινη ροπή» προς αλληλοσπαραγμό. Με απλά λόγια, οι πιο ικανοί στο να κατασπαράσσουν θα μετριάσουν τον αλληλοσπαραγμό, γιατί «μόνον έτσι» μπορούν να συνεχίσουν να υπάρχουν και οι «αδύναμοι», τους οποίους οι ίδιοι –επαναλαμβάνω– βίαια κατασκεύασαν ως τέτοιους. Χαρακτηριστική είναι η αυτο-δικαιοδότησή τους να βρίσκονται υπεράνω νόμου και κοινωνικού-πολιτικού corpus, καθώς, όπως ήδη από τον μεσαίωνα είχε συλλάβει ο Θωμάς ο Ακινάτης: «Necessitous non habet/ Η αναγκαιότητα δεν έχει νόμο».

Πάνω από δύο αιώνες επικράτησης της αστικής τάξης επί των ανθρώπων που έχουν μόνο την εργατική τους δύναμη στην «ιδιοκτησία» τους, η ρίζα της καπιταλιστικής εκμετάλλευσης παραμένει ακλόνητη, ειρωνικά ασάλευτη μέσα στη δομική της αστάθεια και την αναγκαιότητα παραγωγής κρίσεων συσσώρευσης κέρδους. Πάνω από δύο αιώνες απόσπασης υπεραξίας για τους καπιταλιστές, αντικειμενοποίησης και αστείρευτης αξιοποίησης των πάντων, κοινωνικής ανισότητας και εξάρτησης των καταπιεσμένων από την ευημερία των καταπιεστών τους. Πάνω από δυο αιώνες σφαγών, πολέμων, μιλιταριστικών αισχροτήτων και βίας για χάρη της συνέχισης της αιώνιας καταλήστευσης της συντριπτικής πλειοψηφίας των …

author: ROAPE
title: The sports commercializers are in town
content:
Two recent stories from Kenya reflect the rapid growth, rising ambitions, and increasing commercialization and professionalization of East Africa’s sports sector.


In the first, Helios Sports and Entertainment Group, a private equity firm focused on the continent, teamed up with Zaria Group, fronted by former NBA executive

Masai Ujiri

, to build a $294 million sports and entertainment hub in Nairobi. Then, Oscar-winning actress Lupita Nyong’o

announced

 she was investing in Nairobi City Thunder, which plays in the Basketball Africa League (BAL).


A few days later, reports said Nyong’o’s investment in Nairobi City Thunder may kickstart further investment in the BAL and sports in Kenya. This was followed by

more bullish coverage

 of

further investment

. What do we make of all this? What analytical language and tools do we have to observe and account for these significant on-ground events and dynamics?


One thing is clear: sports and commerce in East Africa are forming ever closer ties in countries such as Kenya and Uganda, across sectors, from rugby, boxing, basketball, and football to athletics, golf, badminton, and motocross, and, lately, e-sports. Major companies, often foreign, attach their brand assets to

competitions

,

leagues

, events, teams, and

sports


champions

, with a wide range of promotional messages, causes, and sector representation (banking, insurance, telecommunications,

betting

 and real estate, food and beverages, and tires).


The media in these two countries run numerous pieces every month about sports sponsorship partnerships that are signed, announced,

renewed

, and upgraded (for example, in financial commitment). Weekends in Kampala and Nairobi during sports season are packed with competitions and events (including community and charity events), and the media again

reports

 on them, naming the sponsors prominently.


TV live coverage is increasing; viewers can join in for free or pay a fee (for example, to follow

boxing

 in Kampala or

rugby

 in Nairobi). Ugandan newspapers Daily Monitor and New Vision, or sports news website

Kawowo Sports

, for example, are full of articles, week after week, with headlines, pictures and stories about sport aspirations, achievement, triumphs, records, trophies, medals and rewards,

players’

 pride,

moves

 and

signings

, or various aspects of

fandom

. Thus, there is not just sports buzz (including participation among viewers/fans) but also commercial and media (including social media) interest.


Political

, including diplomatic, buzz also exists, with the governments of

Kenya

 and

Uganda

 regularly joining initiatives and events in varying roles and capacities, including supporting the hosting of major sports 

events

, national teams and champions competing at international events, and so on. Officially launching sports events and welcoming home athletes from competition elsewhere also get solid

media


coverage

, with officials, sponsors, national flags, and fans joining in. Representatives of international sports federations; prominent, popular, or small but growing international sports competitions; or well-known global sports leagues, clubs, and personalities visit their counterparts to talk, inspect, plan,

announce

, and so on.


Relatedly, both countries are also undertaking significant 

venue 

construction 

and repair. This is related especially to football (the upcoming AFCON 2027, hosted with Tanzania) but also to other sports (such as paddle), or other formats and purposes, such as

multi-function

 sports facilities for rent for leisure or competitive activity (non-professional competitions, for example), or sports venues in the

education

 sector for schoolchildren and students’ recreational and competitive activities.

Hamz

 Stadium in downtown Kampala is one

example

.


Significantly, the facilities upgrade and sport events, participation, commerce, and fandom buzz are also evident in viewing venues: the entertainment

bars

 and

clubs

 (even a

cinema

 venue) that

broadcast

 sports events, especially football (from the EPL to the World Cup and AFCON), some of them almost throughout the entire week; say, from Tuesday in EPL-heavy weeks; or the

venues

 (clubs, bars, shopping malls) that host live sports such as

boxing

 (professional and

celebrity

 fights) or

martial arts

.

author: infolibre
title: Τριήμερο μνήμης για τον αναρχικό Κυριάκο Ξυμητήρη, Παρασκευή 30/10 – Κυριακή 1/11
content:
>Παρασκευή 30.10 Εκδήλωση ” Η επιλογή της συνέχειας της ένοπλης πάλης μετά τη δικτατορία”


>Σάββατο 31.10 Πορεία μνήμης για τον αναρχικό αγωνιστή Κυριάκο Ξυμητήρη


>Κυριακή 01.11 Συγκέντρωση αλληλεγγύης στις Φυλακές Θήβας, σε αλληλεγγύη με τις αναρχικές Μαριάννα Μανουρά και Δήμητρα Ζαραφέτα


Τριήμερο μνήμης για τον αναρχικό σύντροφο Κυριάκο Ξυμητήρη


ΟΣΟΙ ΧΑΝΟΝΤΑΙ ΣΤΗ ΦΩΤΙΑ ΤΟΥ ΑΓΩΝΑ, ΔΕΝ ΠΕΘΑΙΝΟΥΝ ΠΟΤΕ


Στις 31/10/24, μέρα που θα μείνει για πάντα χαραγμένη στην καρδιά κάθε αγωνιστή/-στριας, ύστερα από έκρηξη σε διαμέρισμα στους Αμπελόκηπους, έπεσε στην μάχη για την κοινωνική και ταξική απελευθέρωση ο αναρχικός ένοπλος αγωνιστής Κυριάκος Ξυμητήρης. Η αναρχική συντρόφισσα Μαριάννα Μανουρά, που επίσης βρισκόταν στο διαμέρισμα, κατέληξε πολυτραυματίας στη ΜΕΘ του «Ευαγγελισμού» και 15 μέρες μετά – και παρά το ότι η κατάσταση της υγείας της εξακολουθούσε να είναι κρίσιμη- μεταφέρθηκε στις γυναικείες φυλακές Κορυδαλλού. Η κρατική προπαγάνδα και τα πληρωμένα φερέφωνά της στα ΜΜΕ επιχείρησαν, ως συνήθως, την αποπολιτικοποίηση της επαναστατικής δράσης και την απονοηματοδότηση των περιεχομένων της, παρουσιάζοντας τους συλληφθέντες για την υπόθεση και τον ίδιο τον Κυριάκο ως «επικίνδυνους για το κοινωνικό σύνολο». Από την πρώτη στιγμή, το ριζοσπαστικό κίνημα, ο αναρχικός χώρος έθεσαν ως στόχο να υπερασπιστούν τη μνήμη του και τις επιλογές αναρχικού συντρόφου Ξυμητήρη και στο πρόσωπό του την βαθιά ριζωμένη παράδοση του αγώνα με όλα τα μέσα ενάντια σε κράτος και κεφάλαιο. Το ίδιο -και με κόστος τις πολυετείς ποινές που τους επιβλήθηκαν- έκαναν οι συντρόφισσες Μαριάνα Μανουρά και Δήμητρα Ζαραφέτα από την πρώτη στιγμή αλλά και κατά διάρκεια της ιστορικής δίκης για την «υπόθεση των Αμπελοκήπων», ενάμιση χρόνο μετά. Εν τελεί, η ιστορία και η παρακαταθήκη του Κυριάκου γράφτηκαν και εξακολουθούν να γράφονται μέχρι σήμερα από αυτούς και αυτές που τον γνώρισαν και αγωνίστηκαν στο πλάι του, από ανθρώπους σε όλον τον κόσμο που στο πρόσωπό του αναγνώρισαν τα αγωνιστικά ιδανικά, το ήθος και την αφοσίωση που χαρακτηρίζουν εκείνους και εκείνες που αποφασίζουν να κάνουν το επαναστατικό όραμα, πράξη.


Ο σύντροφος Κυριάκος αποτέλεσε την πραγματική ενσάρκωση του πολύμορφου αγώνα. Ήταν για χρόνια αδιάλειπτα παρών σε εγχειρήματα αλληλεγγύης κρατουμένων, στο αντιπολεμικό-διεθνιστικό κίνημα, στον αγώνα για την παλαιστινιακή αντίσταση, σε δράσεις για την υπεράσπιση της γειτονιάς των Εξαρχείων, στους αγώνες εντός των πανεπιστημίων, στην υπεράσπιση των απελευθερωμένων χώρων, των καταλήψεων και σε κάθε κοινωνικό και ταξικό αγώνα. Εναπόθεσε την ψηφίδα του εμπλουτίζοντας το πολύπλοκο μωσαϊκό της αντίστασης, αμφισβήτησε εμπράκτως το αφήγημα του τέλους της ιστορίας αγκαλιάζοντας επαναστατικές πρακτικές που διασαλεύουν την ένοπλη “ειρήνη” των κυριάρχων. Την “ειρήνη” των αλλεπάλληλων κρίσεων και της μονιμοποιημένης κατάστασης έκτακτης ανάγκης, της στρατιωτικοποίησης της καθημερινότητας, του δόγματος “νόμος και τάξη”, της στρατηγικής της μηδενικής ανοχής, της αστικής δικαιοσύνης που ενταφιάζει φτωχοδιαβόλους σε σωφρονιστικά κολαστήρια-νεκροταφεία ψυχών ενώ στρουθοκαμηλίζει μπροστά στα οικονομικά και πολιτικά σκάνδαλα, των νεκρών εργατών στα κάτεργα της μισθωτής σκλαβιάς ως θυσία στο βωμό του κέρδους. Την “ειρήνη” της αιματοβαμμένης Μεσογείου από τα κορμιά μεταναστ(-ρι)ών που δέχονται τις σφαίρες του λιμενικού στο όνομα της Ευρώπης-Φρούριο και της λευκής υπεροχής, των ρατσιστικών πογκρόμ και της ανόδου της ακροδεξιάς σε παγκόσμιο επίπεδο, των ιμπεριαλιστικών πολέμων και των γενοκτονιών.


Ο Κυριάκος, την περίοδο της οπισθοχώρησης και αποριζοσπαστικοποίησης των κοινωνικών κινημάτων, της εσωτερίκευσης του φόβου που ενσταλάζει η καταστολή μέσα από το αίσθημα της παντοδυναμίας του κράτους, της διάχυτης ηττοπάθειας και της αδράνειας, επέλεξε να στρατευτεί στις πιο προωθημένες γραμμές του αναρχικού αγώνα τοποθετώντας τον εαυτό του στο προσκήνιο της σύγκρουσης μέσα από την ένοπλη προπαγάνδα. Αφοσοιώθηκε στην επαναστατική Υπόθεση με το αγνό όραμα μιας αδούλωτης ζωής, ενός κόσμου ελευθερίας, ισότητας και αλληλεγγύης. Οπλίστηκε με θάρρος, αποφασιστικότητα και επαναστατική συνείδηση και επέλεξε να διατρέξει το δύσβατο μονοπάτι της ένοπλης σύγκρουσης με τους γδάρτες των ονείρων μας, τους δεσμώτες των ζωών μας, μέχρι τέλους. Και πέθανε μαχόμενος για την κοινωνική και ταξική απελευθέρωση, κυοφορώντας την ελπίδα για την καταστροφή αυτού του αδηφάγου συστήματος, διατηρώντας ζωντανό το στοίχημα της ένοπλης αμφισβήτησης του κρατικού μονοπωλίου στη βία και ανασύροντας στην …

author: winter oak
title: Rallying the real anarchists!
content:
by Paul Cudenec, who reads the article

here


The anarchist movement of which I became part in the 1990s was very much to my liking.


It took to the streets against the globalists and their summits, it fiercely defended nature against roadbuilding and other “development” and it was defiantly opposed to the plutocratic ruling class with all its exploitation, repression and warmongering.


Anarchists expressed themselves freely, clearly, angrily and often with a sharp sense of humour.


But, progressively, all of that changed.


Opposing globalist gatherings was deemed retrograde by many, nature was increasingly regarded as a suspect reactionary construct and the emphasis shifted to “critical whiteness” and “trans rights”.


Worst of all, the joy and humour seemed to drain completely away from the movement, being replaced by the dead-eyed and narrow-minded robotic dogmatism which I had always associated with the Marxist “left”.


I began to suspect that the anarchist scene had been deliberately infiltrated and corrupted by the ruling mafia in order to disarm it as a potential source of resistance.


This was confirmed for me six or seven years ago, initially by a general anarchist failure to call out the obvious

fakery

 of the “climate” movement and then, of course, by the appalling collaboration with the Covid manoeuvre.


I first confronted this issue in an article entitled ‘Anarchists and the Coronavirus’, published on April 3 2020, which analysed a wide range of anarchist responses to the scamdemic.


I

wrote

: “It seems that most fellow anarchists feel obliged to respect the prevalent social taboo. They insist that they are ‘not downplaying the seriousness of the COVID-19 pandemic’ and are anxious to distance themselves from the dreaded ‘conspiracy theorists'”.


I and others had already been accused of spreading “dangerous misinformation” by anarchists who nevertheless, at this stage anyway, continued to regard us as “comrades”.


By April 26 2020 the ongoing venom directed at me by so-called “anarchists” had totally confirmed what had been a somewhat tentative conclusion.


In ‘Anarchists against freedom’, I

warned

: “People are attaching the anarchist label, and a sort of shallow parody of anarchist ideology, to something which is not anarchism at all.


“This pseudo-anarchist thinking has not grown from anarchist philosophy and therefore can never be anything but a replica anarchism, a zombie anarchism which appears to be the real thing but lacks the anarchist soul.


“This fake anarchism is the sworn enemy of true anarchism. By stealing the body of anarchism, it banishes real anarchism from the world”.


Following this revelation, I dug deeper and in February 2021 published a

very detailed exposé

 showing exactly how the anarchist scene had been funded and thus manipulated by globalist “philanthropists” and their

impact investment

 industry.


I remarked: “The sterile, divisive mindset they have been spreading on behalf of their corporate paymasters should be thrown on the scrapheap of ideological history, where it belongs”.


In recent years I have often referred to my position as being

organic radicalism

, which is a broader philosophical concept than anarchism in that it includes non-anarchist thinkers.


But I also think it is important to maintain an understanding of


authentic anarchism and for that purpose I have set up a new Substack called

Real Anarchists

.


Although some of my own posts will be shared on that site, the idea is not to present my particular philosophical vision – paradoxically, real anarchism could also be regarded as broader than organic radicalism!


Instead, the goal is to restore the notion of an anarchism that can embrace a wide range of perspectives while retaining an overall fundamental coherence.


This

openness

 is central to the very character of true anarchism, which is not a set dogma but more like an

existential attitude

 and it is this

essence

 of anarchism which I seek to uphold.


I know full well that, historically, anarchism has not always reflected all my own beliefs – a blind faith in “science” and “progress” was very prevalent for a long time, for instance, and my interest in cultural rootedness is no doubt not shared by those anarchists who champion an internationalism that is hardly distinguishable from globalism.


But I would counter that anarchism is necessarily a call for decentralisation, not just down from the national-state level …

author: Black Freighter
title: The Melbourne Anarchist Club 1886-1891
content:
Image: Flag carried by JW 'Chummy' Fleming at May Day marches in the late 19th and early 20th centuries. In the collection of the State Library of Victoria.

This article by Samuel Merrifield appeared in the Bulletin of the Australian Society for the Study of Labour History, No. 3 (Nov., 1962), pp. 32-43.

2026 marks 140 years since the formation of the Melbourne Anarchist Club. As the first anarchist organisation in Australia, it could in fact be claimed that this year also marks the 140th year of Australian anarchist organising.

Samuel Merrifield (1904-1982) was a surveyor, Labor politician, and labour historian whose experience of unemployment during the Great Depression was the basis of his entry into politics. He was elected as an ALP member to the Victorian parliament in 1943, serving as minister for public works and later deputy leader of the Opposition in the Legislative Council. He helped found the Melbourne branch of the Australian Society for the Study of Labour History and became a leading collector and preserver of Australian labour history.

The influence of the Club is briefly touched upon by Dr R.A. Gollan (1) but a fuller examination of the members' endeavours appears to be worthwhile and, in spite of the critics, these endeavours similarly appear worthwhile and to have contributed to the development of working class history in Victoria.

During the 1880s there was great activity in the formation of industrial and quasi-political organisation and a not inconsiderable amount of industrial dispute. Of political activity there was little.

The re-forming of the National Political League on 20 January 1886 and the change of name to the National Liberal League, reconstituted the liberal organisations of 1865 and 1877. On 8 December 1885 the Working Mens Political Reform Association was established but only lasted four months during which time its greatest activity was to sabotage the National Liberal League. Half of the W.M.P.R.A. members were to join the Anarchist Club.

The Social Democratic League of S.A. Rosa did not appear until 1889 and the Progressive Political League (the Labor Party) in 1891. The Anarchist Club filled the gap.

In Melbourne the Anarchists were brought together within the Australian Secular Association which had been founded on 1 August 1882. The A.S.A. propagated Rationalism or Atheism, Charles Bradlaugh being greatly esteemed, but Bradlaugh and Jos. Symes, the President and Chief Lecturer of the A.S.A., were anti-socialist and opposed to anarchist philosophy.

The A.S.A. Journal, The Liberator, edited by Symes, provided the means of propaganda and the A.S.A. also the audience, the members coming from small businesses or thoughtful workers, with minds free from the influence of the churches which were mostly conservative in those days.

On 19 October 1884 "D" had written that "all Governments are necessary evils -- all classes should be represented and both sexes. Anarchy begins where the State does not understand its true position and meddles in matters of private concern". (2)

Sixteen months later David A. Andrade and James Donovan had a running debate. Said Andrade: "The ends of the industrial stage can only be achieved by joining the Anarchists and refusing aid to State Socialists. Republicans and Anarchists are all in combination to protect individuals against State interferences." (3)

Donovan replied: "Anarchists like Christians and Socialists are of varying degree and of widely diverse characteristics." (4)

How true this was to be shown later.

From Andrade's quotations it is obvious he was an admirer and part believer of Herbert Spencer's who had been dismayed by Beatrice Webb's marriage to the socialist Sydney Webb.

Notwithstanding Donovan's feeling the Melbourne Anarchist Club was formed on 1 May 1886, after word of mouth had been the means to circularise notice to Anarchists, Communists, State Socialists, Republicans, Democrats, Conservatives, Liberals, Radicals, Nihilists and Royalists, all warmly welcomed.

Nothing narrow-minded about that!

The day of the meeting, 1 May, was interesting as it was the day of the year selected the previous year by the Federation of Organised Trades and Labor Unions (of U.S.A.) to be later recommended and adopted as the day for International Sympathy and the Brotherhood of the Working Classes. This day was specially selected in 1888 as the date of Annual Meeting of the Club and two years later again was selected by the Social …

title: Incendie de la mairie de Limoges
content:
point de vue anarchiste


Communiqué anarchiste


Réaction après l'incendie de la mairie de Limoges


À travers ce communiqué, voici un point de vue anarchiste sur l'incendie de la mairie de Limoges.


Mr Guérin est une personne d'extrême droite, proche des réseaux de l'action française.


Le 17 octobre, c'est un mouvement révolutionnaire qui s'est formé.


Cependant il ne s'est pas formé du jour au lendemain, mais à travers des dizaines d'années de luttes.


L'anarchie n'est pas un parti mais un outil de réflexion autour de la société, avec notamment l'absence de pouvoir, de commandement et d'autorité. L'anarchie est un but à atteindre désirable et pratique. L'anarchie refait surface avec notamment un mouvement de jeunesse à l'international acquis à la cause, et souvent réprimé par les forces de l'ordre notamment à travers les Free Party.


Si la droite et ses idées extrêmes accompagnés par les renseignements territoriaux n'ont rien vu venir c'est qu'iels sont ignorantes, idiotes et qu'iels ne pensent qu'à leur confort et carrière au mépris des classes discriminées.


Abus de pouvoir, harcèlement, détournements d'argents publics, favoritisme, pantouflage, etc. sont légions dans les instances des collectivités territoriales.


À Limoges, Mr Guérin a gagné les récentes élections. L'attaque subie par la mairie est aussi une réponse au refus d'une société gouvernée par des personnes autoritaires, bercées par des idées de haines extrémistes envers certains groupes ethniques ou politiques.


Mr Guérin parle de maison commune, mais refuse toutes concertations avec Mr Maudet, élu et députée Haute-Vienne de la France Insoumise qu'il déqualifie sans cesse par mépris de classe.


Drôle d'ambiance pour une maison commune


Cette personne n'est en aucun cas digne de diriger une mairie comme Limoges.


Si cet édifice a brûler ce 17 octobre, c'est aussi le fascisme qui a brûlé.


Face à la volonté de Mr Guérin de démissionner, n'est-il pas temps de profiter de cet instant, pour instaurer une société anarchiste à Limoges et expérimenter cet outil.


Pour terminer, les revendications, les recours administratifs et les actions menées depuis des années par les militant.e.s des droits humains et environnementaux n'ont eu pour réponse que la violence d'un État en faillite de sa propre devise.


La réponse collective à travers la France, (face à l'État totalitaire pour ne pas dire fasciste, du système libéral, mis en place Macron et ses sbires), en ce 17 octobre est une victoire politique. Et un premier avertissement.


La démission de la présidence et de l'ensemble de ce gouvernement est la seule et unique réponse possible et plausible.

title: Федерация Анархо-Коммунистов Болгарии - Платформа Федерации Анархо-Коммунистов Болгарии 1945 года
content:
Автор

: Федерация Анархо-Коммунистов Болгарии

Название

: Платформа Федерации Анархо-Коммунистов Болгарии 1945 года

Дата

: 10 марта 1945

Источник

: https://www.anarchy.bg/articles/platformata-na-fakb-ot-1945-g/


10 марта 1945 года в Княжево под Софией созвана национальная конференция ФАКБ, которая должна была принять проект программы организации. Подготовка и сама конференция проходили нелегально, но её открытие объявлено публично. Прошло ровно шесть месяцев после переворота 9 сентября. Болгарские анархисты — активные участники антифашистского сопротивления — возвращаются из тюрем и концлагерей, из эмиграции, из нелегального положения. Уцелевшие после репрессий разбросаны по городам и сёлам. Ещё к середине сентября они устанавливают связи между собой. В более крупных центрах созываются встречи, а к концу месяца — местные конференции (в Радомире, Казанлыке, Пловдиве, Килифарево и других местах), на которых все участники выражают нетерпение, готовность, волю к активной деятельности. Определена дата общенациональной конференции по восстановлению ФАКБ (Федерации анархо-коммунистов Болгарии), а также по объединению с ФАСБ (анархо-синдикалистами). В Софии начинает выходить газета «Работническа мисъл» («Рабочая мысль»).


Уже на втором выступлении на конференцию врывается вооружённая милиция. Все делегаты под конвоем доставлены в милицейский участок в Княжево. Они остаются там, пока не приезжают тюремные машины, которые выгружают их в Доме слепых, недавно превращённом во временную следственную тюрьму. Это начало большевистских преследований против безвластнического движения в Болгарии, которое продолжится и в последующие десятилетия.


«Партии ясно, что если мы дадим вам свободу агитации и пропаганды, вы станете силой, с которой мы никогда не сможем справиться. Это определяет отношение к вам», — откровенно делится перед лагерниками-анархистами Руси Христозов, крупнейший милицейский начальник в Болгарии того времени.


На партийном пленуме Цола Драгойчева заявляет: «Если мы дадим анархистам свободу организации, пропаганды и печати, все наши революционные кадры уйдут к ним».


Всё же товарищам удаётся опубликовать Платформу ФАКБ в «Работническа мисъл» в 1945 году. Её содержание отнюдь не только исторический документ. Это свидетельство как о времени, так и о нестареющих идеях анархизма. Более того — и поэтому мы её публикуем — она является хорошей основой для дискуссии о том, что изменилось, а что нет за прошедшие 70 лет.


***


ОСНОВЫ


 Мы отвергаем нынешнюю социальную систему государственности, капитализма и централизма, потому что она основана на власти, которая противоречит народным инициативам и свободе. Всякая власть означает политические, экономические или духовные привилегии. В экономическом отношении она представлена частной собственностью, в политическом — государством, а в духовном — религией.


 Эти три формы власти взаимосвязаны — если какая-либо из них сохранится, она восстановит и остальные. Поэтому мы отвергаем сам принцип власти. Мы сторонники упразднения частной собственности, государства и религии и выступаем за полную ликвидацию всех форм и институтов принуждения и насилия.


 Мы отвергаем всякое учение и всякое социальное, политическое и экономическое движение, целью которого является поддержание государства, частной собственности и церкви, принуждения и насилия в общественных отношениях.


 Мы отвергаем фашизм, который является исторической попыткой восстановления абсолютизма, самодержавия и могущества политической формы власти с целью защиты экономического и духовного господства привилегированных классов.


 Мы отвергаем политическую демократию, потому что она не предусматривает упразднения принципа власти, ведёт к дезориентации масс, втягивая их обманом и иллюзиями в битвы против их собственных интересов, и развращает их через осуществление власти и поддержание стремления к господству.


 Кроме того, политическая демократия совершенно неспособна решить великие социальные проблемы. Она поддерживает хаос, противоречия и преступления, проистекающие из социальных основ централизованного государства и капитализма.


 Мы отрицаем государственный социализм, потому что он ведёт к государственному капитализму: к самой чудовищной форме экономической эксплуатации и угнетения и к полному упразднению общественных и индивидуальных свобод.


 Мы за анархо-коммунизм, или свободный коммунизм, который заменит частную собственность полной социализацией земли, фабрик, шахт, всех средств производства и продукции …
