title: Republicans’ Final Pitch to Midterm Voters: Outright Christian Nationalism
content:
Republicans are invoking Christianity to mobilize voters and attack the legitimacy of Muslim candidates.

Support justice-driven, accurate and transparent news — make a quick donation to Truthout today!

Speaker of the House Mike Johnson (R-Louisiana) and other Republicans are including Christian nationalist themes in their messaging and campaign rhetoric in the final days before the midterm elections.

This past weekend, Johnson appeared on “The Week on Capitol Hill,” a right-wing Christian program hosted by Tony Perkins. Perkins asked Johnson what advice he’d give to conservatives “who are considering sitting this election out.”

Johnson responded by chiding such individuals, saying they’d be “derelict in [their] duty” if they didn’t participate in the elections.

“God calls us to be engaged, to be salt and light in our culture, to advance and stand for his principles, and they are under assault right now,” he claimed.

Johnson then said that conservatives should only vote for candidates that share his and other far right leaders’ Christian nationalist vision.

“We have to be engaged in that process to make sure that the righteous are ruling. … To put it bluntly, you cannot allow these radical elements to take over your country,” Johnson said.

Christian nationalism is a white supremacist political ideology that asserts that the country should only be run by lawmakers who champion right-wing “Christian values.” Adherents of the idea wrongly claim that the U.S. was founded as a Christian nation, and that it was God’s intention to have Christians govern.

Johnson has frequently cited his Christian nationalist beliefs to justify his support of the U.S.’s war on Iran, claiming it is in part a fight against Islam, which he described as a “misguided religion” earlier this year.

Johnson’s backing of Christian nationalist principles has been well-documented. According to a 2024 report from the Congressional Freethought Caucus, Johnson has spent much of his career “working to deny, reject, and undermine the constitutional separation of church and state, including trafficking in fake histories about our nation’s founding.” He also worked alongside groups aligned with the New Apostolic Reformation movement, which aims for Christians to “conquer” and “take dominion” over “key mountains of society,” such as business realms, local and national governments, and more.

Other Republicans have targeted non-Christian Democratic candidates by claiming their beliefs are inherently un-American, another tenet of Christian nationalism. During a political rally this week in Ohio, Sen. Bernie Moreno (R) told his audience that Michigan Senate candidate Abdul El-Sayed (D) should be disqualified from running due to his Muslim faith.

“This character, Abdul El-Sayed, can be nowhere near Washington, D.C.,” Moreno said. “Do you think he understands that concept, that our rights come from God Almighty? That Jesus came here for our salvation?”

Notably, Moreno made the remark at a rally in support of Republican candidate for Ohio governor Vivek Ramaswamy, who is a practicing Hindu.

Moreno’s statements contradict the country’s founding documents. According to Article VI of the U.S. Constitution, “no religious test shall ever be required as a qualification to any office or public trust under the United States.” The Declaration of Independence does make mention of “Nature’s God” entitling freedom and equality to the people, but that phrase is largely understood by scholars to be a term deists, like the document’s author Thomas Jefferson, used at the time to refer to whatever force created the universe, not necessarily a specific deity.

title: Historic win: CLC votes for hot cargo on Israel (Labour for Palestine-Canada)
content:
A post shared by Labour for Palestine (@labourforpalestine)

📣Historic win: CLC votes for hot cargo on Israel

Labour for Palestine – Canada celebrates the Canadian Labour Congress — Canadian Council’s endorsement of General Resolution ‘061’.

October 28th, 2026 the Canadian Council of the CLC passed a resolution declaring trade, services and relationship with Israel “hot cargo”, endorsed the Arms Embargo Now campaign and vowed to work with unions to make weapons and military equipment destined to Israel “hot cargo,” not to be touched by workers of conscience in line with the resolution and hot cargo declaration. Earlier this year, delegates at the CLC 2026 convention voted to cut ties with the Histadrut, a key component of our Hot Cargo Kills campaign

These measures reflect the demand of Palestinian trade unions, the growing position of the labour movement, and the wide support of the Canadian public for sanctions against the state of Israel.

We call on CLC affiliates and local unions to put the hot cargo declaration into practice: support workers who refuse to handle military cargo, pressure Ottawa to end all arms exports to Israel, and build direct ties with Palestinian unions.

We vow to continue our work until a full Hot Cargo declaration is realized, and no Israeli goods, services, or institutional relationships are moved, worked or maintained by Canadian workers.

title: Суд в Финляндии утвердил отказ Миграционной службы предоставить убежище 44-летнему анархисту из Петербурга Михаилу Луньковскому
content:
Об этом написала «Медиазона». Фотографию Луньковского также публикует издание.

Его постановили депортировать в Россию.

Луньковский рассказал «Медиазоне», что в самом начале войны он отправлял деньги в украинские фонды вроде «Повернись живим» с российских карт. Он открыто выступал против вторжения и оставлял антивоенные комментарии в различных чатах в телеграме.

С 2017-2018 годов, по словам Луньковского, и по настоящее время он занимается модерацией в чате преследуемого в РФ и жёстко критикующего Путина публициста Аркадия Бабченко. В последние годы несколько человек получили большие сроки за донаты Бабченко.

По версии финского суда, «деятельность заявителя в социальных сетях носила весьма незначительный характер». Суд не нашел подтверждений, что «заявитель представляет особый интерес для российских властей».

По данным Автономного Действия, Луньковский был активен в питерских либертарных инициативах в 2000-х годов. Решение суда в Финляндии попытаются оспорить.

title: Pisa: IL 30 OTTOBRE SCIOPERO GENERALE – Insieme possiamo bloccare tutto
content:
Lo sciopero generale del 30 ottobre, proclamato da USB e sostenuto da tanti sindacati di base, è l’occasione per reagire a una crisi che pesa ogni giorno sulle nostre vite.


Di seguito ripubblichiamo l’indizione di

MULTI – Sindacato Sociale

 che aderisce allo sciopero e sarà

 

nei luoghi di lavoro, di studio e nei quartieri per costruire questa

 

giornata.

 In allegato l’adesione allo sciopero da parte dei lavoratori di Amazon.


Non possiamo andare avanti così: lavorare costa sempre di più, gli stipendi non bastano e gli affitti sono impossibili. Imprese e istituzioni scaricano i costi della crisi su chi lavora, attraverso part-time involontari, ore non pagate e contratti precari. Gli ospedali non garantiscono cure adeguate, scuole e servizi si impoveriscono, mentre aumentano le risorse destinate al riarmo.


Scioperare è un sacrificio, soprattutto per chi ha già pochi soldi. Ma dobbiamo

 

ribellarci a una normalità che ci impoverisce e ci toglie autonomia e

 

futuro. Fermarci insieme significa trasformare la fatica e la rabbia individuali in

 una forza capace di cambiare i rapporti di potere.


In tutta Europa crescono le proteste. Autotrasportatori e agricoltori si mobilitano contro l’aumento dei costi e l’indebitamento; giovani delle periferie e studenti occupano scuole e piazze, stanchi di essere criminalizzati e privati di 

opportunità. Conflitti diversi, una domanda comune: perché dobbiamo

 

essere sempre noi a pagare?


Dalla Palestina all’Ucraina, le guerre devastano popolazioni e territori mentre si spendono soldi pubblici per produrre e acquistare armi. Banche, industrie militari, imprese energetiche, grandi supermercati, case farmaceutiche, multinazionali della logistica e fondi immobiliari continuano ad accumulare 

profitti. Noi, invece, veniamo derubati della ricchezza che produciamo:

 

con salari insufficienti, affitti insostenibili, prezzi sempre più alti e

 

servizi pubblici impoveriti. Il nostro lavoro fa ricco lo Stato e le grandi

 

aziende, ma a noi restano sacrifici e rinunce. Ora basta.


Da Amazon a Carrefour, da Dussmann agli appalti pubblici, fino alla Scuola Superiore Sant’Anna, alla Scuola Normale e alle scuole, dobbiamo far sentire la voce di chi manda avanti la società con il proprio lavoro e la propria cura. Vogliamo salari più alti, contratti stabili, la fine del lavoro gratuito e del part-

time imposto, case accessibili e servizi pubblici funzionanti. Le risorse

 

collettive devono servire la vita, non la guerra e i profitti di pochi.


Per questo dobbiamo portare lo sciopero ovunque, collegare le vertenze e fermare i flussi di lavoro e di ricchezza che noi stessi produciamo. Non basta indignarsi: 

dobbiamo organizzarci e ribellarci insieme per conquistare

 

ciò che ci viene negato.


Il 30 ottobre, dalla mattina presto, saremo con 

picchetti nei luoghi di

 

lavoro, di studio e nei quartieri per promuovere lo sciopero

. Dalle ore 9 ci muoveremo in corteo verso il Comune di Pisa.


Per aderire, segnalare la partecipazione o costruire iniziative, contattate MULTI – Sindacato Sociale:

info@multisindacatosociale.org

author: Sharon Zhang
title: Senator Briefed on Trump’s Iran War Plans Warns of “Devastating Escalation”
content:
Sen. Chris Murphy said the plans would lead to the “destruction of our commitment to the rule of law” if carried out.

Honest, paywall-free news is rare. Please support our boldly independent journalism with a donation of any size.

A senator who was briefed on President Donald Trump’s plans to launch intense strikes on Iran after the midterm elections has warned that the attacks are slated to be so horrific that they will lead to the “destruction” of the U.S.’s “commitment to the rule of law.”

At an event hosted by the Middle East Institute on Wednesday, Sen. Chris Murphy (D-Connecticut), a member of the Senate Foreign Relations Committee, said that he was recently in a “fairly detailed” briefing with Pentagon officials about the war plan.

“I will just say this: Their plan … will lead to devastating escalation and the likely destruction of our commitment to the rule of law,” Murphy said.

“The plan that they have developed will lead, in my view, to a prolonged escalation of this war that will be devastating for our security interests,” he went on, adding that it would also put the lives of U.S. soldiers at risk when Iran retaliates.

Murphy said that he couldn’t share details of the plan, but, when asked to elaborate, he pointed to recent reporting on the campaigns that the Pentagon has drawn up on behalf of President Donald Trump and Secretary of Defense Pete Hegseth.

On Tuesday, The Wall Street Journal reported that the U.S. has informed Gulf countries that it is prepared for a “short, intense military campaign” after the election next week. The Pentagon has created plans to strike a wide variety of targets, reports have said, including Iran’s nuclear energy facilities.

Trump has reportedly explicitly ordered the military to target a large amount of energy infrastructure — largely considered to be civilian in nature. One plan prepared by the military, CNN reported, is for the U.S. to drop the “Mother of All Bombs,” the largest conventional weapon by weight in existence, a 21,000-pound bomb with the ability to destroy everything within its massive blast radius.

The plans, if carried out, may “use tactics that are even more provocative and dangerous, and potentially violative of international law,” Murphy said — worsening tactics that the senator acknowledged have already violated the international war guardrails.

“Every first year law student could tell you that this war is illegal” in the domestic sense, Murphy said. “But it is also clearly in contravention of international law and commitments that we have made to the rule of law to deliberately target civilians and to use the harm or potential harm of civilians as leverage in war.”

Murphy’s comments suggest that Trump is slated to go even further in the illegal war that has already had devastating consequences for Iran’s civilians and economy.

According to an analysis by the National Iranian American Council, U.S.-Israeli strikes have already destroyed or damaged nearly 1,300 schools, 80 energy facilities, and scores of transportation facilities and sites like airports and bridges. The harsh sanctions regime has also ravaged the economy, with over 1 million jobs lost and massive inflation for basic goods like food, even as the value of the rial hits record lows.

The opening strikes of this war also involved the U.S. bombing an elementary school in Minab, Iran, killing over 160 people, including 123 children under 13 years old.

Trump and his cabinet have repeatedly stoked concerns that they may commit even more heinous war crimes against civilians with the president’s repeated genocidal threats to “annihilate” Iran. In his speech to the UN general assembly last month, Trump mused about whether he should “drive [Iran] into hell with no chance of survival and no hope of future greatness or generations.”

Adding to concerns of the administration’s wanton disregard for military procedures and briefings to Congress is the Pentagon’s secrecy regarding its ever-shifting operations.

Murphy noted that, on top of never having sought congressional approval for the war, Pentagon officials have been guarded in private briefings about the war. He said that he gets the sense that, internally, Pentagon officials believe more strikes won’t be effective in achieving the U.S.’s goals — as previous reports have said — but that they have become more reluctant to voice their disagreements with the military’s top brass under Hegseth when speaking with Congress.

title: Torino verso lo sciopero generale
content:
Riprendiamo indizione della mobilitazione da parte dei coordinamenti cittadini di

Torino per Gaza

 e

Torino contro il riarmo

 in vista della mobilitazione dello sciopero del 30 ottobre. In allegato anche un registrato delle voci del 24 ottobre a cura di

Radio Blackout

.


BLOCCHIAMO L’ITALIA SCIOPERO GENERALE

Domani scendiamo in piazza ancora una volta per ribadire che siamo contro il riarmo, contro il carovita e contro ogni forma di guerra.

Sono settimane che vediamo l’Italia intera scendere in piazza per dire che non ce la fa più, che arrivare alla fine del mese è diventato un lusso sempre più riservato a pochi, che non è più possibile accettare un presente fatto di precarietà e impoverimento. Di fronte a tutto questo, le risposte del governo italiano sono sempre più orientate alla repressione. Attraverso abusi di polizia e limitazioni al diritto di manifestare, si tenta di restringere sempre di più gli spazi del dissenso, obbligando le persone a lasciare il centro delle città e relegando le proteste nelle periferie, lontano dagli occhi di chi governa e di chi vorrebbe continuare a fare finta di niente. Ci chiediamo allora: queste fantomatiche vetrine valgono forse più della vita di milioni di persone che non riescono ad arrivare alla fine del mese? Vale più la tutela delle vetrine del diritto di esprimere il proprio dissenso, di protestare contro le guerre e di rivendicare condizioni di vita dignitose?

Ancora una volta, la domanda non dovrebbe essere perché le persone scendano in piazza, perché giovani e studenti si mobilitino collettivamente, perché un’intera generazione rifiuti di accettare le condizioni che le vengono imposte. La vera domanda è perché, di fronte a queste rivendicazioni, la risposta delle istituzioni continui a tradursi nella violenza e nella repressione.

Scendere in piazza è quindi sempre di più una necessità, un dovere collettivo. Perché non possiamo accettare che la guerra diventi normalità mentre le nostre condizioni di vita peggiorano, che miliardi vengano destinati al riarmo mentre milioni di persone sono costrette a scegliere tra pagare le bollette, fare la spesa e arrivare alla fine del mese. Vediamo un vento di rivolta e rivoluzione arrivare dal mondo intero, da paesi molto vicini al nostro; Francia, Spagna, Albania, paesi nei quali le settimane di mobilitazione hanno messo in crisi i propri governi. Un solo grido ci attraversa tutti: No alla guerra e sì per una vita dignitosa.

Come Coordinamento Torino per Gaza, sappiamo bene, guardando alla resistenza palestinese, cosa significhi lottare, cosa significhi resistere e cosa significhi non arrendersi di fronte alla violenza. Sappiamo che le lotte non sono separate, che ciò che accade in Palestina non è distante da ciò che viviamo qui. La guerra e il genocidio in Palestina si inseriscono in un sistema di dominio e di violenza che si alimenta anche attraverso il riarmo, l’economia di guerra e politiche che scaricano il costo delle proprie scelte sulle vite di chi lavora, studia e vive in condizioni di crescente precarietà.

Con la stessa forza e determinazione che abbiamo mostrato lo scorso anno con Blocchiamo tutto, vogliamo tornare a bloccare. Bloccare questo sistema, fermare la macchina della guerra, opporci a un modello politico ed economico che ci vuole sempre più sfruttati, sempre più impoveriti, sempre più disposti a chinare la testa.

Vogliamo bloccare l’Italia per l’Italia stessa, per la nostra liberazione, per costruire un futuro in cui le risorse siano destinate alla vita e non alla guerra, ai diritti e non al riarmo, alla dignità delle persone e non ai profitti di pochi.

Domani scendiamo in piazza per scioperare, per bloccare, per opporci alla repressione e per mettere un punto a tutto questo.

Contro il riarmo. Contro il carovita. Contro ogni guerra. Per la Palestina, per la nostra liberazione.


Alcune voci dal corteo del 24 ottobre a Torino contro guerra, riarmo e carovita.

title: Karayılan commemorates fallen guerrillas from Shengal
content:
Murat Karayılan, a member of the Central Headquarters of the People’s Defense Forces (HPG), has issued a statement commemorating seven fallen Kurdish guerrilla fighters from Shengal. He paid tribute to their contribution to defending the Yazidi population against the terrorist organization Islamic State (ISIS) and to establishing independent self-defense structures in Shengal. Karayılan also commented on the talks between the Iraqi government and the leadership of the Shengal Resistance Units (YBŞ). He welcomed the prospect of integrating the YBŞ into the Iraqi army, provided that the units retain their local character and remain permanently responsible for protecting the population.


In his statement, Karayılan recalled the genocide perpetrated by ISIS against the Yazidis in August 2014, which the Yazidi community refers to as the 74th Ferman, as well as the role of the Kurdish guerrillas in defending Shengal. He regards the YBŞ and YJŞ forces established during that period as a crucial achievement in the struggle to prevent another genocide.

Our Yazidi people have been subjected to 74 fermans throughout their history. Each of these campaigns of extermination involved massacres and genocide. Yet not a single one was ever brought to justice. Whoever committed these crimes went unpunished.

As soon as they learned of the attacks, they decided to intervene and immediately mobilized.

title: Bar associations file criminal complaint against deforestation in Gabar and Besta
content:
The bar associations of Siirt and Şırnak have filed criminal complaints over the ongoing deforestation in the Gabar and Besta regions. They are demanding an immediate halt to the tree felling and criminal investigations into those responsible. The complaints target both individuals involved in the deforestation and public officials suspected of bearing responsibility.


According to the environmental and urban development commissions of both bar associations, the relevant complaints were submitted to the public prosecutors’ offices in Siirt and Şırnak. They concern tree felling carried out between April 20 and July 29, 2025, which reportedly continued beyond that period.


The lawyers are calling for investigations into suspected illegal tree felling, the unlawful transportation of timber and other forest products, and possible complicity in these activities. They are demanding that prosecutors identify those responsible, initiate criminal proceedings, and order examinations of the affected logging and storage sites to secure evidence.


At the same time, the bar associations are demanding full disclosure of the official permits and environmental decisions authorizing the logging operations. These include any environmental impact assessments, information on the number and species of trees felled, transportation documents, and reports on environmental inspections conducted by the authorities.


The bar associations are calling on the relevant authorities to halt the logging immediately. They have pledged to continue their efforts to protect the forests and the wildlife inhabiting them, as well as the population’s right to a healthy environment.

title: Broad support for resistance against solar project in Arzoxlî
content:
Resistance against the controversial Zenkar-2 solar energy project in the Arzoxlî village of Amed (Turkish: Diyarbakır), is gaining further support. On the eighth day of the vigil against the development of communal grazing lands, a delegation from the Democratic Institutions Platform visited the protest camp in the village. Following a joint march from the village square to the vigil tent, representatives of political parties and environmental organizations called for the complete cancellation of the project.


Ruçem Vefa Elyakut, co-chair of the DBP’s provincial branch in Amed, praised the local community’s struggle. “The people of Arzoxlî have been putting up dignified resistance for days,” she said. She placed the conflict within a long history of displacement and economic exploitation of Kurdish lands. “The mentality that sought to dominate this land has tried to drive its people away. Today, it wants to plunder this land using the same methods. We will never accept that.”


Construction work resumes despite ongoing court proceedings


At the center of the dispute is the “ZENKAR-2 Solar Power Plant and Energy Storage Facility” project developed by the company Zenkar. The company was granted a 49-year electricity generation license for two planned solar power plants equipped with energy storage systems. The facilities are to be built on land that is essential to the local population’s agricultural and livestock activities. Legal proceedings are ongoing against the reclassification of communal grazing lands, the zoning plans, and the favorable environmental impact assessment decision for Zenkar-2. A court-appointed panel of experts concluded that implementing the project in its current form would be unsuitable.


Violent clashes had erupted in March when the company first attempted to enter the site. Five villagers were injured, one of them seriously, during an operation by Turkish police and gendarmerie forces. Fifteen people were temporarily detained. On October 21, the company once again entered the disputed land under the escort of security forces. Since then, residents have been holding a vigil to protest the continuation of construction work and restrictions on their access to communal grazing lands.


“Thousands of years of natural habitats are being sacrificed for profit”


During the solidarity visit, Sabri Kılıç, co-spokesperson of the Amed Ecology Council, criticized the increasing commercialization of natural resources essential to sustaining life. He argued that solar and hydroelectric power plants, mining projects, and oil extraction were part of a broader development trend that increasingly disregarded the needs of local communities. “Land, water, mineral resources, sunlight, and wind are being turned into commodities in the process of capital accumulation,” Kılıç explained. “Mining, oil, hydroelectric, and solar energy projects in our valleys, mountains, and plains are destroying our habitats, which have existed for thousands of years, through policies aimed at maximizing profits.”


Kılıç particularly criticized the role played by the police and military. During the assault in March, he said, they had been deployed not to protect the population but to enforce the company’s interests. “The security forces, whose duty is to protect the people, attacked them as though they were the company’s private security personnel.”


Kılıç pointed out that the planned solar park threatens the agricultural use of the land and, with it, a vital source of livelihood for the village community. He warned of the potential displacement of residents and long-term ecological damage. He also emphasized the historical significance of the area, arguing that it should be officially recognized as a protected cultural heritage site.


Resistance to be expanded


Ruçem Vefa Elyakut stressed that preserving the grazing lands is inseparable from the population’s right to live in their homeland and have a say in its future. “This is our land, our life. We inherited it from our ancestors. We will never allow profiteers and those in power to plunder this land and this heritage,” the DBP politician declared. title: Environmentalists demand projects in Zîlan Valley to be halted immediately’
content:
The Van Ecology Association, the Mesopotamia Ecology Movement, the Van Bar Association, and the DEM Party’s Erciş (Erdîş) district organisation issued a joint press statement opposing work being carried out on the Zîlan Stream under the pretext of an irrigation canal project.


Reading the statement, Rojhat Özgökçe, a representative of the Mesopotamia Ecology Movement, said the works threatened agricultural land, water resources, and biodiversity.


Özgökçe said that disrupting the natural flow of the Zîlan Stream could have irreversible consequences for the Erciş Plain, the Çelebibağ Wetlands, and the habitats of endemic species.


Stating that environmental impact assessment procedures had not been carried out adequately, Özgökçe said: “This ecological siege, stretching from Zilan Valley to the plain and the lake, threatens the living environments not only of today’s generations but also of future generations. Under Article 56 of the Constitution, which guarantees the right to live in a healthy and balanced environment, as well as under relevant international conventions and environmental legislation, we demand that all these projects be halted immediately, that their permits be revoked, and that the existing damage be remedied.”


Gülderen Varlı, a DEM Party MP representing Wan, also stated that the activities in the valley were affecting not only nature but also the region’s collective social memory.


Varlı said: “The valley is home to wildlife such as otters, salamander species, and the Erciş barbel. Blocking the flow of water affects not only aquatic life but also the entire interconnected ecological system. We will not accept this, and we will continue to monitor and challenge the destruction. Our struggle will continue until you take your machinery, your dirty mentality, and your mentality of war away from here.”

title: Criminal complaint filed against tree felling in Gabar and Besta
content:
In a statement issued by the bar associations’ Environment and Urban Affairs Commissions, it was reported that applications had been submitted to the chief public prosecutor’s offices in Siirt (Sêrt) and Şirnak (Şirnex) over tree felling said to have taken place between 20 April and 29 July 2025, and to have continued thereafter.


The complaint called for investigations to be opened and criminal proceedings to be brought against the relevant public officials and those carrying out the felling, over allegations of unlawful tree cutting, the transportation of illegally obtained forest products, and aiding these activities. It also requested on-site inspections of the felling and storage areas to identify and document evidence.


The bar associations called on the authorities to disclose the administrative permits authorising the felling, environmental impact assessment (EIA) decisions, information on the quantities and species of trees cut down, transport documents, and environmental inspection reports. They also urged the authorities to halt the activities.


The statement emphasised that the bar associations would continue to defend forests, wildlife, and citizens’ right to live in a healthy environment.

 με την είσοδό τους στην Θεσσαλονίκη, μετά από σκληρές μάχες στον περίγυρό της κατά των Γερμανών και με την επέμβασή τους απέτρεψαν την ανατίναξη των βασικών υποδομών της πόλης που είχαν υπονομεύσει με εκρηκτικά οι κατακτητές- όπως τα δύο εργοστάσια ηλεκτρισμού, το υδραγωγείο, ο σιδηροδρομικός σταθμός, ο λιμενοβραχιόνας, οι αλευρόμυλοι «Αλατίνι», κ.ά.

καθιερώθηκε ως ‘

δημόσια εορτή τοπικής σημασίας για τον Δήμο Θεσσαλονίκης’.


Συγκέντρωση: Επέτειος της Απελευθέρωσης της Θεσσαλονίκης από τον ΕΛΑΣ


 Στις 30 Οκτώβρη του 1944, ο ΕΛΑΣ μπαίνει στη Θεσσαλονίκη και η πόλη απελευθερώνεται από τη ναζιστική κατοχή.


Ήταν η κατάληξη ενός σκληρού αγώνα, στον οποίο πρωταγωνίστησε ο ίδιος ο λαός, με το ΕΑΜ και τον ΕΛΑΣ να αποτελούν βασικούς πυλώνες της Εθνικής Αντίστασης. Οι αντάρτες με την ένοπλη δράση τους, οι εργάτες με τις αιματοβαμμένες απεργίες, η νεολαία από τα ξυπόλυτα τάγματα μέχρι τους σπουδαστικους λόχους της ΕΠΟΝ, οι δομές λαϊκής αλληλεγγύης που εσωσαν τον κόσμο από την πείνα, απέδειξαν πως κανένας αντίπαλος δεν είναι ανίκητος όταν βρίσκεται απέναντί του ο οργανωμένος λαός.


 Η απελευθέρωση όμως της πόλης, όπως και του μεγαλύτερου μέρους της χώρας, από τις δυνάμεις του ΕΛΑΣ δεν σήμανε και την δικαίωση όσων και για όσα αγωνίστηκαν. Οι συνεργάτες των ναζί και οι μηχανισμοί της κατοχικής εξουσίας δεν έφυγαν μαζί με τα γερμανικά στρατεύματα. Αντίθετα σημαντικό μέρος τους μαζί με το πολιτικό προσωπικό που είχε εγκαταλείψει την χώρα, συγκρότησαν το μεταπολεμικό αστικό κράτος. Ενώ από την άλλη αυτοί και αυτές που πολέμησαν και ελευθέρωσαν την χώρα ήρθαν αντιμέτωποι με διώξεις, φυλακίσεις, εξορίες και εκτελέσεις. Η πορεία προς τα Δεκεμβριανά και τον Εμφύλιο φανέρωσε πως ο αγώνας για μια ελεύθερη Ελλάδα χωρίς φτώχεια, φασισμό και με τον λαό κυρίαρχο, δεν μπορούσε να αφορά μόνο την σύγκρουση και απελευθέρωση από τον κατακτητή, αλλά και το ποιος θα καθόριζε την επόμενη μέρα.


 Δεν είναι λοιπόν τυχαίο ότι η επέτειος της 30ής Οκτώβρη παραμένει σχετικά άγνωστη, σε αντίθεση με άλλες επετείους που τιμώνται κάθε χρόνο στην πόλη. Η υποβάθμιση της απελευθέρωσης και η αποσιώπηση του ρόλου της Εθνικής Αντίστασης και τον πρωτοπόρο ρόλο των κομμουνιστών σε αυτή, εξυπηρετούν μια ιστορική αφήγηση που θέλει να εξισώσει τα θύματα με τους θύτες και τους προδοτες με τους αντιστασιακούς. Αφηγησεις που δεν μπορούν να δεχτούν τον λαό ως πρωταγωνιστη και όχι απλό θεατή των εξελίξεων.


 Σήμερα 82 χρόνια μετά, η μάχη για την ιστορική μνήμη συναντά τις μάχες του σήμερα. Τον αγώνα ενάντια στον σημερινό πόλεμο, την φτώχεια, τον φασισμό και τον εθνικισμό. Σε μια περίοδο που οι ανταγωνισμοί των ιμπεριαλιστών οξύνονται, οι πολεμικές δαπάνες αυξάνονται και οι λαοί καλούνται να πληρώσουν το κόστος με την εξαθλίωση των ζώων τους και το αίμα τους. Η ιστορική μνήμη δεν είναι απλώς μια μάχη για την αλήθεια του χθες, αλλά μια ζωντανή απόδειξη του τι μπορεί να καταφέρει ο λαός όταν οργανώνεται, αγωνίζεται και παίρνει την υπόθεση της ζωής του στα χέρια του.

title: “Δεν υπήρχε σπιθαμή στο σώμα του που να μην ήταν χτυπημένη” – Πώς η δικαιοσύνη επιβραβεύει την αστυνομική βία
content:
“Δεν υπήρχε σπιθαμή στο σώμα του που να μην ήταν χτυπημένη” – Πώς η δικαιοσύνη επιβραβεύει την αστυνομική βία


Στις 21 Σεπτεμβρίου 2024, ο Μοχάμεντ

Καμράν

 Ασίκ δολοφονήθηκε από αστυνομικούς στο Α.Τ. Αγίου Παντελεήμονα. Τον Ιανουάριο του 2026, ο εισαγγελέας Σωτήρης Μπουγιούκος αποφάσισε να αρχειοθετήσει την υπόθεση, ισχυριζόμενος ότι δεν υπήρχαν επαρκή στοιχεία για να παραπεμφθεί σε δίκη. Ως αποτέλεσμα, δεν υπάρχουν πλέον νομικά μέσα για τη συνέχιση της υπόθεσης στα ελληνικά δικαστήρια. Οι αστυνομικοί που τον ξυλοκόπησαν μέχρι θανάτου συνεχίζουν τη ζωή τους χωρίς καμία συνέπεια.


Ο Μοχάμεντ Καμράν Ασίκ, εργάτης από το Πακιστάν, συνελήφθη, μεταφέρθηκε και κρατήθηκε σε πέντε διαδοχικά αστυνομικά τμήματα, όπου υπέστη επανειλημμένη σωματική βία, χωρίς ουσιαστική επικοινωνία με την οικογένειά του ή πρόσβαση σε νομική υποστήριξη. Στις 21 Σεπτεμβρίου 2024 βρέθηκε νεκρός μέσα στο Αστυνομικό Τμήμα Αγίου Παντελεήμονα, στον μοναδικό χώρο που δεν είχε κάλυψη από κάμερες. Ακόμα και η ίδια η κρατική ιατροδικαστική πραγματογνωμοσύνη κατέληξε στο συμπέρασμα ότι ο θάνατός του προκλήθηκε από ισχαιμία του μυοκαρδίου, ως αποτέλεσμα έντονου σωματικού και ψυχικού στρες που συνδέεται με τον συνεχή ξυλοδαρμό κατά την κράτησή του.


Τη δολοφονία του Μοχάμεντ Καμράν ακολούθησε εκτεταμένη συγκάλυψη της υπόθεσης (όπως τέτοια ακολούθησε και το κρατικό έγκλημα στην Πύλο). Οι αστυνομικοί του Α.Τ. Αγίου Παντελεήμονα ισχυρίστηκαν ότι «αυτοτραυματίστηκε λόγω στερητικού συνδρόμου αλκοόλ». Ο εισαγγελέας Σωτήρης Μπουγιούκος πολύ στοχευμένα παρέλειψε στην επίσημη αναφορά το ιατρικό συμπέρασμα που ξεκάθαρα αποδίδει την καρδιακή αποτυχία του Μοχάμεντ Καμράν ως αποτέλεσμα του εκτεταμένου και άγριου ξυλοδαρμού του. Αυτή η απόφαση είναι ξεδιάντροπη συγκάλυψη του βασανισμού και της δολοφονίας του Μοχάμεντ Καμράν από την ελληνική αστυνομία.


(Ενημερωτικό απόσπασμα από το κάλεσμα της Ανοιχτής Συνέλευση Ενάντια στην Κρατική Δολοφονία του Μοχάμεντ Καμράν σε πορεία για τα 2 χρόνια από τη δολοφονία του Καμράν)


Οι ζωές μας στις γειτονιές της Αθήνας γίνονται καθημερινά όλο και πιο ασφυκτικές μέσα σε ένα κλίμα κρατικής βίας, εκφοβισμού και πρακτικών συνεχούς επιτήρησης.


Η κρατική εξουσία μέσω νεοφιλελεύθερων πολιτικών πασχίζει να εδραιώσει και να φυσικοποιήσει πρακτικέςπεριθωριοποίησης και εκτοπισμού αυτών των ομάδων που αντιστέκονται καιεναντιώνονται στην απαξίωση των ζωών τους. Η καπιταλιστική πολιτική «ανάπτυξης» στη συνέχεια στοχεύει στην διάλυση και στον αφανισμό κάθε είδους κοινότητας και συλλογικοποίησης. Προσπαθεί να δημιουργήσει γειτονιές απονέκρωσης, φόβου, αποσιώπησης και υποταγής χτυπώντας στους κατεξοχήν τόπους συγκέντρωσης, μοιράσματος και ζύμωσης: τις πλατείες.


Η πλατεία Βικτωρίας αποτελεί εδώ και πολλά χρόνια ένα πεδίο μάχης και συλλογικών αγώνων. Οι γειτονιές κάτω από την Πατησίων είναι ο επόμενος στόχος της λεγόμενης “ανάπλασης”, ενός σχεδίου που υπόσχεται “αναβάθμιση των ζωών”, αλλά στην πράξη συχνά μεταφράζεται σε αποκλεισμό, εμπορευματοποίηση και έλεγχο του δημόσιου χώρου. Από τα pushbacks και τα στρατόπεδα συγκέντρωσης, από τη θάλασσα και τα χερσαία σύνορα μέχρι τις φυλακές και το δημόσιο χώρο, το κράτος δείχνει το ρατσιστικό του πρόσωπο. Μέσα σε ένα σκηνικό συνεχών ελέγχων, τραμπουκισμού, ξυλοδαρμών, συλλήψεων και βασανισμών, τα περιστατικά αστυνομικής βίας και κρατικών δολοφονιών μόνο αυξάνονται. Θοδωρής Ζαβραδινός, Κώστας Μανιουδάκης, Ζάκι, Βασίλης Μάγγος, Σαμπάνης, Κώστας Φραγκούλης , Μία Χαριζούλ , Εμπουκά Μαμάν Σούμπεκ, Μοχάμεντ Καμράν, βιασμός 19χρονης στο Α.Τ Ομονοίας και τόσα ακόμα περιστατικά κρατικής τρομοκρατίας που δεν έχουν καταγραφεί.


Η Βικτώρια είναι μια γειτονιά μεταναστευτική, ζωντανή, γεμάτη ιστορίες και πολιτισμούς. Οι άνθρωποι της προσπαθούν καθημερινά να πάρουν ανάσες ελευθερίας, μέσα σε ένα κλίμα αυξανόμενης και ασφυκτικής αστυνομικής παρουσίας.


Δεν είναι δύσκολο να θυμηθούμε κάποιες από τις εικόνες των προηγούμενων χρόνων: τις σκηνές των προσφύγων στην πλατεία, το κύμα αλληλεγγύης που απλώθηκε αυθόρμητα, τα ξηλωμένα παγκάκια και τα κάγκελα που τοποθετήθηκαν για να μην κοιμούνται προσφύγισσες, πρόσφυγες και μετανάστες, τις ρατσιστικές επιχειρήσεις-σκούπα, τους ελέγχους για χαρτιά. Μέσα σε αυτό το κλίμα όμως άνθισαν παρεμβάσεις απέναντι στην καταστολή, το ρατσισμό, την ομοφοβία και την κρατική βία. Μικροφωνικές επανοικειοποίησης, πορείες, παρουσία κοινωνικών ιατρείων, κινήσεις γειτονιάς που αντιστάθηκαν στη σιωπή. author: Chris Walker
title: “Our Democracy Is in Danger” — Judge Rejects Trump Bid to Block 20K Votes in CA
content:
Washington State officials also found several errors in a list of voters the White House has deemed ineligible.

Did you know that Truthout is a nonprofit and independently funded by readers like you? If you value what we do, please support our work with a donation.

The Trump administration’s attempts to discount the votes of tens of thousands of voters it has dubiously deemed ineligible to participate in this year’s midterm elections hit two major roadblocks on Wednesday, as officials in Washington state and a judge’s ruling in California challenged the White House’s reasoning.

In August, the administration issued a report claiming that 24,000 people who took part in the 2020 election were noncitizens. Though many observers noted major flaws in the report, the White House has continued to push its disenfranchisement campaign, sending lists of residents’ names to several states and demanding that officials segregate their ballots.

After the administration sent Washington Secretary of State Steve Hobbs a list of people in his state that they said should be deemed ineligible to vote, a preliminary review of the list by Hobbs’s staff found that many of its claims were erroneous. The list included several names of U.S. citizens, for example.

The list is “not reliable,” Hobbs wrote on Wednesday in an open letter to the administration. “Without individualized proof of ineligibility, it would be both irresponsible and illegal for election officials to decline to process a registered voter’s ballot.”

A “significant number” of the names on the list are people who are simply “not currently registered to vote or are on inactive status,” he said.

Hobbs was emphatic in his refusal to comply with the White House’s demands to segregate ballots.

“State and local election officials in Washington work tirelessly to administer free and fair elections,” Hobbs wrote. “They are truly heroes of democracy. … Rather than distract these dedicated public servants from their important work at this late hour with a meritless lawsuit, I strongly encourage you to revisit the deeply flawed data you provided earlier this week, identify any actual proof, and work collaboratively with my office in the weeks or months to come.”

Also on Wednesday, a federal judge ruled against the administration in a lawsuit it had filed against California. The suit seeks to segregate 20,000 ballots belonging to supposed noncitizens in that state’s upcoming elections. Notably, in paperwork filed with the court earlier this week from Los Angeles, officials discovered that a “high percentage” of the names belong to people born in the United States.

Judge David O. Carter did not mince words in his decision.

“This case is about the right of every American citizen to vote in a free and fair election,” the federal judge wrote. “Never before in American history has the federal government, on the eve of an election, sought to coerce a state and local government to abandon their own Constitutional elections procedures and bend to the will of the Executive Branch.”

“In bringing this lawsuit, the Executive would have this Court believe that it reigns as a sole sovereign. But California and its people are sovereign, too,” Carter added.

The request by the administration to segregate ballots “violates longstanding constitutional principles mandating that states have control over their elections” that could have long-term precedential consequences, Carter said.

Constitutional rights and our democracy are at stake. The public interest favors their protection. Individuals who have met the requirements of California’s voter registration laws must not be deprived of a core right merely because of unfounded allegations stemming from a procedure rife with uncertainty and errors.

“Eroded trust in our democracy is irreparable,” Carter wrote in the conclusion of his ruling. “Once a vote is segregated, lasting harm has occurred. If the Executive can discount votes and threaten an ongoing election due to unproven allegations, then our democracy is in danger. This Court declines to be a party to such process.”

The refusal by Washington state officials to comply with the administration’s demands, as well as the legal ruling from a federal judge, could be challenged by the White House. But with only a few days left before the midterms, it’s unlikely that any action — short of one that is drastic and potentially unlawful — could occur in time for an appeal.

author: Nehaa Bimal
title: Ottawa police seek public’s help finding 14-year-old girl
content:
Ottawa police are asking the public to be on the lookout for a 14-year-old girl who has been reported missing in the city.


Lydia Oyukuluk was last seen at 6 p.m. on Wednesday in the 1000 block of Gladstone Avenue, according to a release Thursday from the Ottawa Police Service.


She was last seen wearing baggy black sweatpants, a black camouflage hoodie and socks of an unknown colour. She was not wearing shoes, the release said.


Police described her as Indigenous, four-foot-nine, with a petite build. She has long black hair that is partially dyed red at the back.


The police asked anyone with information on her whereabouts to call 613-236-1222, extension 2355.

author: infolibre
title: Πανεκπαιδευτική πορεία, την Παρασκευή 30/10, στις 10.30, στη πλατεία Βασ. Γεωργίου, Πάτρα
content:
Αφίσα/Κάλεσμα από το

Ελευθεριακό Σχήμα Πανεπιστημίου Πατρών

:


Η επίθεση που εξαπολύουν το κράτος και το κεφάλαιο απέναντι στο σύνολο των πτυχών της κοινωνικής ζωής είναι εξαιρετικά εντεταμένη και διαμορφώνει μία βάρβαρη καθημερινότητα για τα κατώτερα ταξικά στρώματα. Οι διαγραφές που είδαμε να εφαρμόζονται σε πρώτη φάση ξεπέρασαν τις 300.000 πανελλαδικά, ενώ στο πανεπιστήμιο Πατρών οι φοιτητές που διαγράφησαν έφτασαν σχεδόν τους 20.000. Σε συνέχεια αυτού, έρχονται να προστεθούν και αυτές των πενταετών σχολών, με τις λίστες να αναμένεται να ανακοινωθούν μέχρι το τέλος της χρονιάς. Επιπλέον στην φαρέτρα των νομοσχεδίων του πανεπιστήμιου, έρχεται να προστεθεί το νέο νομοσχέδιο για την ασφάλεια στα πανεπιστήμια, που περιλαμβάνει σχέδια εφαρμογής μέτρων όπως κάμερες και τουρνικέ στους πανεπιστημιακούς χώρους. Το νομοσχέδιο αυτό δεν έρχεται σε κενό χρόνο από το κράτος, έρχεται στοχευμένα να χτυπήσει την οργάνωση και συλλογική δράση των φοιτητών στα πανεπιστήμια και αποσκοπεί στην τρομοκράτηση των φοιτητών, την καταστολή οποιασδήποτε φωνής αντίστασης και ποινικοποίησης των πολιτικών και συνδικαλιστικών δράσεων σε αυτά.


Η αδιάκοπη εκπαιδευτική αναδιάρθρωση που συντελείται όλο και εντονότερα τα τελευταία χρόνια επιβεβαιώνει τον ρόλο που έχει το πανεπιστήμιο, να αναπαράγει δηλαδή το κεφάλαιο με υλικοτεχνικούς όρους και να νομιμοποιεί ιδεολογικά την εκμεταλλευτική φύση του καπιταλιστικού συστήματος στους φοιτητές/μελλοντικούς εργαζόμενους. Από τη μια τους εφοδιάζει με τις απαραίτητες γνώσεις για την αγορά εργασίας και από την άλλη λειτουργεί ως ιδεολογικός μηχανισμός τοποθετώντας τους μέσα σε ένα σκληρό πλαίσιο πειθάρχησης και εντατικοποίησης, σφυρηλατημένους με τις αξίες του ανταγωνισμού, της εξατομίκευσης και του κανιβαλισμού, ώστε να είναι έτοιμοι να πλαισιώσουν την παραγωγή μέσα σε αυτές τις συνθήκες του σύγχρονου εργασιακού μεσαίωνα, της ανασφάλιστης και μαύρης εργασίας και την περαιτέρω κατακρεούργηση των εργατικών κεκτημένων. Νόμοι κομβικής σημασίας για αυτόν τον σχεδιασμό αποτελούν ο νόμος Γαβρόγλου, ο νόμος Κεραμέως-Χρυσοχοΐδη, που περιλαμβάνει την ίδρυση της πανεπιστημιακής αστυνομίας, η ΕΒΕ, οι διαγραφές, τα πειθαρχικά, η εξίσωση πτυχίων μεταξύ ιδιωτικών κολλεγίων και δημοσίων πανεπιστημίων αλλά και ο νόμος Πιερρακάκη, που έχει ανοίξει τον δρόμο για την ίδρυση ιδιωτικών πανεπιστημίων.


Οι διαγραφές αποτελούν χαρακτηριστικό παράδειγμα του σχεδιασμού του κεφαλαίου για τα πανεπιστήμια. Το βασικό αφήγημα το οποίο αναπαράγεται, περί «οικονομικής επιβάρυνσης» των τμημάτων και των πανεπιστημιακών ιδρυμάτων από τους δήθεν «αιώνιους φοιτητές», αναιρείται από την ίδια την πραγματικότητα μιας και είναι ευρέως γνωστό πως μετά το πέρας των ν+2 ετών σπουδών παύουν να ισχύουν τα «προνόμια» των φοιτητών. Παρ’ όλες τις νέες τροποποιήσεις που εισήγαγε το Υπουργείο Παιδείας (παράταση 2 εξαμήνων σε όσους έχουν ολοκληρώσει το 70% των μαθημάτων ή των αντίστοιχων ECTS και αποτελούν ενεργοί φοιτητές ) είναι εμφανέστατη η στόχευση του νομοσχεδίου αυτού. Στην πραγματικότητα, αποσκοπείται η θετική αξιολόγηση του εκάστοτε τμήματος καθώς βασικό κριτήριο αυτής αποτελεί ο αριθμός των εγγεγραμμένων φοιτητών και με βάση αυτή καθορίζεται και η χρηματοδότησή του, μείωση της οποίας θα οδηγήσει είτε σε συγχώνευση ή ακόμα και σε οριστικό κλείσιμο του. Το νομοσχέδιο αυτό παράλληλα παρέχει τη δυνατότητα χορήγησης πιστοποιητικών των συγκεντρωμένων ECTS στους φοιτητές που διαγράφονται, ανοίγοντας έτσι διάπλατα τις πόρτες των δρομολογημένων ιδιωτικών πανεπιστημίων, για να ολοκληρώσουν το εναπομείναν κομμάτι των σπουδών τους, εάν βέβαια μπορούν να καλύψουν τα υπέρογκα κόστη των διδάκτρων. Δημιουργείται ουσιαστικά ένα νέο πελατολόγιο για τα επερχόμενα ιδιωτικά πανεπιστήμια τα οποία η κυβέρνηση επιχειρεί να νομιμοποιήσει με τη συνταγματική αναθεώρηση του άρθρου 16.


Το μέτρο των διαγραφών βλέπουμε επίσης να πηγαίνει χέρι-χέρι με αυτό των πειθαρχικών, σαν μέσο καταστολής των αγώνων που ξεδιπλώνονται μέσα στις σχολές ενάντια στις αντιεκπαιδευτικές πολιτικές κράτους-κεφαλαίου. Επίσης, το κράτος φαίνεται να «επενδύει» στην θωράκιση έναντι των επερχόμενων αγώνων, με ένα επιπλέον αντιδραστικό νομοσχέδιο που περιλαμβάνει μια σειρά αυταρχικών και κατασταλτικών μέτρων, με διατάξεις όπως η συγκρότηση Πειθαρχικών Συμβουλίων μέσα στα πανεπιστήμια, η ελεγχόμενη είσοδος, η άρση της φοιτητικής ιδιότητας όσων συλλαμβάνονται εντός πανεπιστημίων ακόμα και οριστική διαγραφή τους από τα τμήματα στα οποία φοιτούν.


Ταυτόχρονα, χαρακτηριστικό παράδειγμα της απόπειρας του …

author: Dominique Gené - Local Journalism Initiative Reporter
title: Nunavimmiut Futures Fair completes 3-year tour of Nunavik
content:
The Nunavimmiut Futures Fair has completed a three-year tour of Nunavik, bringing employers, educational institutions and other organizations into high schools across the region to introduce students to potential career paths.


This edition of the fair wrapped up in Kuujjuaq on Oct. 27 and 28 at Jaanimmarik School after visiting Puvirnituq, Inukjuak, Quaqtaq and Tasiujaq.


More than 10 organizations were on hand to give presentations to high school students. Evening sessions were also held in the school gym Oct. 28.


Participants included the FCNQ Co-op, Kativik Regional Government, Air Inuit, the Canadian Coast Guard, Ungava Tulattavik Health Center, Sanajiit, Kativik Ilisarniliriniq and Pijunnaqunga.


The goal of this initiative is to introduce the work of different organizations and the opportunities available to them, said Joëlle Fares, project development officer in adult education and vocational training.


“This will guide them in terms of what they can be in the future,” she said.


Fares has co-ordinated the fair, which

launched

 in 2016, for three years. She said students often become more engaged as they attend presentations and learn about the different opportunities available to them.


Some participating organizations also offer part-time employment to young people as young as 16, she said.


Among the organizations participating in the fair was Pijunnaqunga, a Kativik Regional Government employment-readiness program whose name means “I can do it” in Inuktitut.


The program supports Nunavik Inuit in developing workplace skills and gaining experience through office-skills training, professional development workshops, personalized employment advising and internships.


Emaly Saviakjuk, an employment adviser with Pijunnaqunga, said the program offers intensive, one-week training sessions in communities across Nunavik. 


Participants learn to use programs such as Microsoft Word, Excel and Outlook, with training adapted to local needs.


Those who complete the training can receive a certificate and may be connected with internships based on their skills. Some internships can lead to job placements.


Saviakjuk has experienced that pathway herself. She completed the training in 2024 before securing a job placement with the organization.


“It does really help,” Saviakjuk said.


While the Futures Fair focuses on secondary school students, Fares said she has also heard interest from adults who would like access to similar opportunities.


She said a separate event for adults could be considered, although no plan has been confirmed.


The Futures Fairs will continue next year. Organizers will begin planning soon to determine which communities will be visited and how the next edition will be organized.

author: CMI Argentina
title: El gobierno fue denunciado en la Justicia Federal por ayudar a Bolsonaro a fugarse de Brasil
content:
El gobierno nacional fue denunciado ante la Justicia Federal por su participación en un operativo para facilitar la salida de Flávio Bolsonaro hacia Estados Unidos y evitar que responda ante la Justicia de Brasil. Las presentaciones fueron realizadas por la diputada nacional Marcela Pagano en Puerto Iguazú y por el diputado Esteban Paulón y el dirigente del Frente de Izquierda Gabriel Solano en los tribunales de Comodoro Py, en Buenos Aires.


Según las denuncias, el operativo habría involucrado a funcionarios de distintas áreas del Estado, entre ellas seguridad, inteligencia y diplomacia. Buscan que se investigue cómo ingresó Flávio Bolsonaro a la Argentina y las circunstancias en las que un avión privado, con matrícula argentina, habría intentado trasladarlo a Estados Unidos.


La diputada nacional Marcela Pagano presentó una denuncia penal en la Justicia Federal de Puerto Iguazú y pidió preservar las cámaras de seguridad del puente internacional y del aeropuerto, los planes de vuelo, la lista de pasajeros y el contrato del vuelo chárter.


Presenté denuncia penal en la Justicia Federal de Puerto Iguazú. Flávio Bolsonaro tiene prohibido salir de Brasil por orden judicial. Los medios ubican su ingreso clandestino por Iguazú, un jet de matrícula argentina esperándolo para volar a EE.UU. y a la ANAC frenando ese despegue. Mientras tanto, el Gobierno dice que "nunca ingresó".


Si entró, alguien lo dejó entrar. Si lo quisieron sacar por un aeropuerto federal, alguien miró para otro lado.


Pedí preservar las cámaras del puente y del aeropuerto, los planes de vuelo, la lista de pasajeros y el contrato del chárter, e investigar por tráfico de personas en tránsito e incumplimiento de los deberes de funcionario público. La frontera argentina no es un pasillo VIP de nadie. La soberanía no se negocia ni se presta.


Fiel al compromiso de seguir dando testimonio en tiempos difíciles.


— Marcela Pagano (@Marcelampagano)

October 28, 2026


En sus redes sociales, Pagano recordó que Flávio Bolsonaro tenía prohibido salir de Brasil por orden judicial y señaló que distintos medios ubicaron su ingreso clandestino por Iguazú. También afirmó que un avión privado lo esperaba para viajar a Estados Unidos y que la Administración Nacional de Aviación Civil (ANAC) habría frenado el despegue.


“Si entró, alguien lo dejó entrar. Si lo quisieron sacar por un aeropuerto federal, alguien miró para otro lado”, expresó la legisladora, quien pidió investigar posibles delitos vinculados al tránsito de personas y al incumplimiento de los deberes de funcionario público. “La frontera argentina no es un pasillo VIP de nadie. La soberanía no se negocia ni se presta”, agregó.


Por su parte, Gabriel Solano denunció penalmente al presidente Javier Milei y a funcionarios de las áreas de inteligencia, seguridad y diplomacia por presunto encubrimiento agravado, abuso de autoridad, incumplimiento de los deberes de funcionario público y malversación de caudales públicos.


Denuncie penalmente a Milei y sus funcionarios de inteligencia, seguridad y diplomacia por la impunidad otorgada tras la huida de Bolsonaro a EE. UU.


Los acusó penalmente de encubrimiento agravado (Art. 277 CP), abuso de autoridad y violación de los deberes de funcionario público (Art. 248 CP) y peculado (Art. 261 CP), exigiendo el inicio inmediato de la investigación penal preparatoria.


El presidente Milei ha sido parte fundamental de una conspiración internacional dirigida por Trump para asegurarle a Flavio Bolsonaro eludir la investigación de la Justicia de Brasil, usando incluso para ello bienes del propio estado argentino. Ahora sabemos también que su máximo asesor Santiago Caputo, que tiene a su cargo en los hechos la SIDE, se trasladó hasta Puerto Iguazú para dirigir personalmente la fuga. Esta actuación clandestina constituye un hecho de gravedad inusitada.

“El presidente Milei ha sido parte fundamental de una conspiración internacional dirigida por Trump para asegurarle a Flávio Bolsonaro eludir la investigación de la Justicia de Brasil, usando incluso para ello bienes del propio Estado argentino”, sostuvo Solano en sus redes sociales.

author: Sharon Zhang
title: US Journalist Detained by Israeli Forces After Being Beaten by Israeli Settlers
content:
The incident came as a UN expert issued a report detailing Israel’s “mediacide” in Gaza and the occupied West Bank.

Honest, paywall-free news is rare. Please support our boldly independent journalism with a donation of any size.

A U.S. journalist was detained by Israeli forces after being beaten by Israeli settlers while documenting attacks on Palestinians amid the olive harvest in the occupied West Bank.

Independent journalist Jasper Nathaniel, along with journalist-activists Russian Adele Shoko and Russian-Israeli Andrey Khrzhanovskiy, were in the village of Umm al-Khair when they were beaten by Israeli settlers. Umm al-Khair, in Masafer Yatta, is one of the most heavily besieged areas in the West Bank by Israeli settlers, and the journalists have been documenting fierce settler raids against Palestinians as they conduct the olive harvest.

Video taken by Shoko shows armed settlers attacking Khzhanovskiy, shoving him to the ground as Nathaniel tries to protect him. According to Shoko, Khzhanovskiy “was severely beaten and lost consciousness several times in front of police,” suffering a concussion. Another video taken by a different activist shows Khzhanovskiy falling to the ground and losing consciousness as a policeman blocks a paramedic from reaching him.

Settlers initially blocked the ambulance from reaching the scene, and Israeli officials denied Khzhanovskiy hospital treatment, instead taking him to the police station.

Shoko says she and Nathaniel were also beaten, and that Nathaniel was pepper sprayed and arrested by Israeli authorities.

"This is what we are willing to die for as Palestinians", Hazem Jbara told us, showing us half a bag of olives—all he managed to harvest in 10 minutes before settlers attacked him. I watched from the rooftop as they came from two sides, trying to trap Hazem and @infinite_jaz… pic.twitter.com/CJo1EgdmbX

Both Nathaniel and Khzhanovskiy were released on Thursday afternoon local time, Shoko said. However, they were banned from the West Bank for 60 days. “This is a clear example of Israel trying to prevent us from covering the terror it commits in the West Bank,” Shoko said.

The incident comes less than two weeks after Israeli settlers threw Washington Post journalist Heidi Levine to the ground and beat her, sending her to the hospital. That attack was documented by Nathaniel and Khzhanovskiy, who accompanied her as she received medical care.

Wearing a cast on her wrist, Levine said in an interview with CNN’s Jake Tapper last week that the violence she faced at the hands of Israeli settlers is just a glimpse into what Palestinians have to deal with on a daily basis.

“I can now really understand what others have gone through, what Palestinian women, children, men have gone through,” she said. “I’ve covered funerals of young people that have been killed by these Jewish settlers. It was always very difficult to meet people — even a man that was sexually abused and tortured in front of his family.”

“I’m an American, I work for the Washington Post, my story is getting a lot of attention around the world, everyone wants to talk to me — but I can’t imagine what it’s like for all the victims that have gone through the same ordeal and are living with the threat of this violence on a daily basis,” Levine went on.

Last week, Democratic House candidate Brad Lander was also detained by the Israeli military during a visit to the West Bank with an international delegation to harvest olives with a Palestinian family.

The attack on Nathaniel and other journalists comes just after UN Special Rapporteur for the occupied Palestinian territories Francesca Albanese presented a report to the UN accusing Israel of “mediacide” in its continued targeting of journalists and media workers in Palestine, especially amid Israel’s genocide in Gaza.

In the report, Albanese notes that Israel has systematically targeted journalists and media workers, with hundreds of them “killed, injured, arbitrarily detained, tortured, intimidated and smeared as terrorists while documenting the destruction of their own society.”

This targeting has been essential to Israel’s genocide and assaults as it seeks to erase those who exposed it to the world.

title: Israel’s Election Still in Deadlock After Palestinian Parties’ Surprise Upset
content:
Netanyahu has claimed that the Palestinian parties have “stolen” the election.

Did you know that Truthout is a nonprofit and independently funded by readers like you? If you value what we do, please support our work with a donation.

With the results of Israel’s election on Tuesday finalized on Thursday, the right-wing bloc around current Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has won 53 seats out of the 120 in Israel’s parliament, the Knesset, while the opposition bloc around Gadi Eisenkot has won 48 seats. Both are short of the majority needed to create a ruling coalition government.

The real upset, however, is with the Palestinian parties, after Palestinian citizens of Israel came out in record numbers to vote Tuesday: The Joint List has won 11 seats, and the United Arab List eight seats. This gives the Palestinian parties 19 seats in the Knesset — more than their previous record of 15 — and makes the Joint List, a progressive alliance of three Palestinian-led parties, the third largest party in the Knesset.

Over the coming weeks, party leaders from Eisenkot and Netanyahu’s blocs will negotiate and work to form a ruling coalition. If they cannot form a ruling government, they will face another round of elections.

But in order for Eisenkot’s bloc to form a ruling coalition and oust Netanyahu, it would need to create an alliance with the Palestinian political parties. Eisenkot has stated that he will not work with Arab parties — but this means that his choice is either to hand the victory to Netanyahu, or create a larger opposition coalition with the Palestinian parties.

In 2021, Naftali Bennett and Yair Lapid briefly ousted Netanyahu by creating an alliance with the United Arab List. However, the Joint List, which won more seats than the Arab List in Tuesday’s election, is explicitly anti-Zionist and progressive — making it a scapegoat of the Zionist parties more than a likely coalition partner.

Netanyahu used the fact that the opposition will need to create alliances with Palestinian parties in his fearmongering around the election — his slogan, “Yamin o Falastin,” or “Right Wing or Palestine,” framed the election as a choice between his Likud party or handing power to Palestinians. The Likud Party and its far right allies had also attempted to ban the Palestinian-led parties from participating in the elections entirely — but only managed to force out candidate Sami Abu Shehadeh, chair of the Balad party within the Joint List.

Since Tuesday, Netanyahu has claimed that the Palestinian parties have “stolen” the election, saying there has been interference by “foreign entities” who aim to facilitate “a foreign takeover of the Knesset, [and] the Islamization of Israel.”

Balad’s Abu Shehadeh said the claims that Palestinian parties stole the election amount to a new phase of incitement against Palestinian citizens of Israel, who make up 20 percent of Israel’s citizen population.

Netanyahu has led the right-wing Likud Party for 19 years across six terms. In the course of his sixth term, he has overseen the three-year long genocide in Gaza, and launched calamitous wars on Lebanon and Iran. But while he is wanted by the International Criminal Court for war crimes, his political tenure was challenged inside Israel for different reasons — a longstanding corruption trial, his failures on and after October 7, and resentment over exemptions for Haredi Jews from military service.

The first Israeli election since October 7 and the start of the genocide in Gaza, this election saw former general Gadi Eisenkot position himself as an alternative to Netanyahu. This is because, as political analyst Daniel Levy told Truthout, Eisenkot is new to the political scene, and is “untainted by the corruption and failures of the [Israeli] government, in particular not having been in a leadership position on October 7.”

“In contrast to Netanyahu, who is considered to have put personal considerations over national interest, Eisenkot lost his son and two nephews in the war, and this personal sacrifice has been highlighted in staking out such a difference” in the eyes of the Israeli public, Levy added.

But this does not mean that there are significant policy differences between Eisenkot and Netanyahu. In fact, none of the Israeli “opposition” parties — save the Palestinian-led political parties — oppose Israel’s genocide in Gaza, or apartheid and ethnic cleansing policies across the occupied territories.

of lobbying and hasbara and normalizing ethnic cleansing and apartheid for them to get to the point where they’re openly doing a genocide, and they

still

author: Unknown
title: Bottom-Up Organizing: How We Got Clean Porta-Johns
content:
The first day I showed up on the Marriott construction site in downtown Detroit, everyone warned me about the state of our bathrooms.


You could smell them halfway across most floors. They were full in 24 hours, urinals were often clogged, and some people had taken to using buckets and hiding them in closets.


Every electrician already had the same idea: we wanted the cleaning schedule changed from twice a week to three times.


I had a long conversation with the steward about what had been tried. The first instinct of a construction worker is to “drag” (quit), drive over to the union hall, and pick up a new job. As expected, there was a steady trickle of drags, but no improvement to conditions.


OSHA had been called and walked the site, only to say that the number of bathrooms was up to their standard. The electrical contractor had been notified, but because the bathrooms were for all the trades, our bosses didn’t feel it was their responsibility to pay for additional cleaning.


Our Electrical Workers (IBEW) Local 58 contract only gestures vaguely to “sanitary facilities,” and protects us explicitly should we leave the site to find a “sanitary” facility. This clause was exercised regularly, but no one could say for sure whether the boss was even aware we were leaving.


A PLAN IS HATCHED


I was asked to fill in for the steward while he was out for a few days. When I walked the job to make sure everyone had my number, more than half the conversations touched on the bathrooms. I then introduced myself to the stewards from other trades, who were all hearing the same from their members.


We hatched the idea to take the issue above our bosses and straight to the general contractor (who hires out each trade and is responsible for the job site at large).


Together we wrote a letter titled “Unacceptable Bathroom Conditions,” which opened politely and assumed the boss was ignorant of the problem. The letter referenced the impact on our work and a widespread feeling that we were not being treated with respect.


We reminded him that many of us had decades of experience and were not new to the idea of using a plastic box as a bathroom, but these conditions were exceptionally bad.


We suggested that the person responsible for scheduling should use our bathrooms for a week to better assess the need for more cleanings, hand sanitizer, and a wash station. We gave one week for a response.


BUT WILL IT WORK?


Every worker who was presented with the letter signed immediately. Most people felt like the bosses would just laugh at our demands, but were interested in the idea of swarming their trailer at lunch and forcing them to read it in front of us.


We fielded many suggestions, from going straight home after delivering the letter to tipping over porta-johns on our way. We told our co-workers that if our response date came and went without change, we would be coming back around “to have a different conversation.”


But first the demand had to be made collectively and clearly. Many of our one-on-one talks were focused on assuring the workers that we would escalate if the letter went ignored: “This is only the beginning.”


We warned people about possible counter-strategies from the boss, and stressed the importance of demonstrating solidarity, especially across the trades. We didn’t invite the officers at the union hall or our reps, though we did inform them. “Every member is a steward” has become sort of a slogan for us.


IT WORKS


In the end we had 105 signatures and roughly 35 folks across four trades who gave up their lunch break to deliver the letter. The contractor read it, was brought outside to look at us, and immediately conceded to our terms.


Maybe they didn’t know how bad the bathrooms were, maybe they didn’t know how widely and deeply felt the issue was on site, or maybe they figured it was fine to ignore.


All we know for sure is, when even a fraction of us came together, with the backing of three times as many signatures, it didn’t matter if we had the union hall behind us. We are the union, the working people who don’t just walk away from a job which doesn’t satisfy us, and our demands have been met.


Kevin Szczesny is a member of IBEW Local 58 (Electrical Workers) in Detroit. A version of this story first appeared in his union newsletter.

author: Sophia Sheera
title: Israel Tries to Poach UK Doctors to Work on Illegally Occupied Land
content:
An Israeli government agency is encouraging doctors in London to emigrate to Israel and the occupied West Bank to compensate for a domestic brain drain amid the ongoing genocide and increased restrictions on the number of Palestinian doctors in its healthcare system. 


A medical fair, MedEx UK, was hosted in London last Sunday by the Israeli Ministry of Aliyah and Integration, alongside Zionist groups Nefesh B’Nefesh and the Jewish Agency for Israel, Middle East Eye reported. 


Attendees were invited to meet Israeli hospital representatives at the event and take on site Hebrew language tests required to obtain Israeli medical licences. 


Leaflets from medical providers Terem and Clalit, which operate in illegal West Bank settlements, were offered to guests. Representatives from Leumit Health Services, which

claims to run 30 establishments

 in the occupied West Bank, were included on a list of attendees seen by Middle East Eye. 


“They had a lot of very eminent professors there. They were only there for the day, and flew back the next day,” said an activist who infiltrated the event. They added that representatives for Clalit told guests: “Truly wherever you want to go in Israel, we can help with accommodation.”


Sunday’s MedEx event was held as part of a years-long drive to bring 2,000 doctors to Israel by 2029 as increasing numbers of its doctors go abroad. Some

1,369 medics left Israel

between 2023 and 2025, marking a fivefold increase over the previous decade.


The drive to recruit British doctors also comes as the Israeli Ministry of Health intensifies its efforts to exclude Palestinian medics. In 2019, the government brought in new restrictions on the number of foreign medical schools whose graduates are allowed to sit Israel’s licensing exams. Students from occupied Palestine cannot enrol in Israeli medical schools, forcing them abroad, whilst Palestinian citizens of Israel face structural barriers to entry. 


At the same time, the Israeli government has introduced financial incentives and streamlined processes aimed at attracting suitable foreign doctors. In 2025, it was announced that doctors with 10 years of experience could waive Israel’s licensing exam, down from 14 years.


The number of Palestinian doctors in Israel has skyrocketed in the last decade, with almost 45% of newly licensed medics categorised as “Arab and Druze” in 2023. But this number is expected to plummet as Palestinian doctors who started studying at foreign medical schools in 2019 are no longer considered eligible to practice in Israel.

author: Paige Collings
title: Tech Tips for Parents this Digital Parenting Week
content:
In today’s digital world, the internet is an

essential resource

 for young people to access information, explore community, and find themselves. But we know that this often comes alongside fears of experiencing online harms like doxxing, grooming, or bullying.


Trying to protect your family from everything all the time is impractical and exhausting, but some thoughtful planning can help families devise a workable plan that meets their needs and addresses their concerns.


That’s why this Digital Parent Week, we’re sharing easy tips on how parents and their children can work together to co-curate a digital safety plan that helps all members of the family enjoy the benefits of technology while protecting their online privacy and safety. 


Start with Open Conversations


Online safety begins with communication, not just restrictions. Talk with a young person about how they use the internet: their favourite apps, games, and social media platforms for example. Creating a supportive environment helps young people feel comfortable asking for help if something goes wrong online.


Together, you can think about:


What do we want to protect?

e.g., I want to protect a young person’s privacy and mental health when they’re playing Roblox. They love Roblox and use it to communicate and hang out with their best friend, so we’d like to find a way to make it as safe as possible.


Who do we want to protect it from?

 e.g., messages from strangers, staying up too late playing, wasting money on pointless digital junk in games.


How bad are the consequences if we fail?

e.g, losing some money on a scam or having creepy conversations with strangers that could escalate into something more nefarious or dangerous.


How likely is it that we will need to protect it?

e.g., I don’t know the likelihood of a stranger messaging you on Roblox because I’m not sure how communication works on the platform, but I’ve heard from their friends that strangers message them all the time in some games.


How much trouble are we willing to go through to try to prevent potential consequences?

e.g., I’m willing to learn from my child how the game works, play the game with my child, and learn how to work the parental controls. 


Who are our allies?

 e.g., my partner, our parents, as well as a young person’s best friends and their parents.


It's easy to think of a young person's experience on the internet as being totally disconnected and different from your own. But now is a great time to also interrogate your own internet habits, like the sorts of sites you engage with, tools you use, and privacy settings you've set. These questions are as valuable to help you as a parent as they are just an internet user.


Sometimes even just figuring out what conversations are worth having can take some effort, we've put together some ideas to get you started in

our guide

.


Make Privacy a Family Priority


Digital security training can feel overwhelming but this is why a

community-oriented approach

 helps. In speaking with your family and friends, you can build out digital security practices that work for you. This makes it more likely that your privacy practices will become second nature to you and your loved ones.


Use secure messaging services for every communication:

 Choosing a secure service ensures that your privacy is protected from government and corporate surveillance. If you can convince your family to get on board, options like Signal provide the most extensive privacy protections out of the box through its use of end-to-end encryption and limited data collection. But we understand that sometimes it's easier to stick with whatever the family already uses for a group chat, like WhatsApp, Apple's iMessage, or Google Messages, so take the time to familiarize yourself with the

limits of WhatsApp

 and

RCS encryption

.


Consider the content posted online:

It's easy to accidentally share personal information through photos, messages, and other content.


Children and adults may unknowingly share personal information through photos, messages, location settings and app permissions. Take time together to review privacy settings, check which apps can access the camera or location, and discuss why personal details should be shared carefully. Make sure you have family agreement about when and where to post photos of each other or your home.


Create incident response plans:

Developing a plan for if or when something bad happens is a good practice …

author: Andrea DiP
title: Solidão “premium”: como redes sociais e consumo transformam estar só em desejo
content:
No Pauta Pública desta semana, Andrea Dip recebe Lucas Liedke e André Alves, psicanalistas, pesquisadores e fundadores da Float Vibes, instituto de estudos culturais e pesquisa comportamental. Apresentadores do podcast Vibes em Análise, eles discutem como as redes sociais transformam a noção de coletividade e de individualidade e como as empresas por trás dessas plataformas se beneficiam da solidão. Para Lucas, o consumidor solitário tende a ser mais rentável para o mercado. 


Segundo um

relatório

 da Organização Mundial da Saúde, uma em cada seis pessoas no mundo se sente sozinha, com impactos significativos na saúde e no bem-estar. Para os entrevistados, as redes sociais prometem conexão e pertencimento, mas também podem intensificar o avanço da solidão entre as pessoas e transformar em espetáculo. “Quem filma a solidão […] no limite também está colocando a câmera como testemunha, ou a suposta audiência como testemunha… um artifício para não estar exatamente sozinho”, resume André Alves. Para Lucas Liedke, este é exatamente o ponto de atenção, já que as plataformas lucram com essa dinâmica. “O imaginário divertido e hipersocial das mídias sociais pode ser opressor”.


As redes sociais não só contribuem para este fenômeno como podem transformá-lo em uma espécie de espetáculo. 


Leia os principais pontos da conversa e ouça o podcast completo abaixo.


EP 239


											A solidão “premium” – com Vibes em Análise


23 de outubro de 2026


					·


				Psicanalistas do Vibes em Análise falam sobre o aumento da solidão e como as redes transformaram a ideia de coletividade


0:00


-:–


15


15


Veja mais episódios desta série


Vocês escreveram esse texto, Solidão Premium, que é uma análise sobre muitos temas que se entrelaçam. Então pra começar, o que é a solidão premium?


Lucas Liedke:

 A discussão sobre solidão vem acontecendo enquanto sintoma global há algum tempo. Com certeza com mais força há uns cinco anos, a partir da pandemia, do trabalho remoto, do isolamento social. Alguns fenômenos que já eram uma realidade, mas que foram ganhando expansão, se tornando uma necessidade e nós sabemos que muitas pessoas nunca conseguiram voltar ao que era antes.


No Japão tem esse fenômeno do

hikikomori

, que são os indivíduos que não saem de casa, de forma alguma, e ficam nesse confinamento extremo. Na China, a gente viu o lançamento de um aplicativo, que tem um nome bastante macabro, que é

Você Está Morto?

, onde as pessoas são convidadas a fazer um check-in a cada dois dias para mostrar para as outras que elas ainda estão vivas.


Nesse contexto, a gente começou a perceber um movimento também de influenciadores de solidão. Pessoas que afirmam ter um um orgulho de não ter uma família próxima, de não ter muitos amigos, de passar um sábado à noite sozinho em casa, assistindo o que quiser no streaming, comendo o que quiser no delivery, sem ter que negociar os seus gostos, as suas escolhas com ninguém. E isso é um contraste curioso para as redes sociais, que sempre foi um lugar mais de expor o quanto você é sociável, o quanto você se diverte, as suas conexões, enquanto uma espécie de capital social. Essa contradição foi o que nos levou a escrever esse texto “Solidão Premium”.


André Alves:

 Tem o famoso relatório da

OMS de 2025

 sobre como uma em cada seis pessoas no mundo se sente afetada pela solidão. Sob à luz da psicanálise – que é o campo de onde a gente parte – a definição da solidão parte de uma espécie de déficit relacional. “Eu não tenho quantitativamente e ou qualitativamente relações suficientes na minha vida”. Claro que nunca a gente tem a suficiência na psicanálise, a gente está sempre trabalhando exatamente com ausências e faltas, mas no caso da epidemia de solidão, é algo que diz sobre faltar demais, sobre eu não ter relações profundas o suficiente, e/ou pessoas o suficiente na minha vida com quem eu possa trocar e que considerem a minha dor como algo importante.


A Solidão Premium, da qual a gente tem falado e esse texto que o Lucas escreveu, parte da ideia de que, no estado atual desse movimento, a gente tem observado muitos criadores de conteúdo, e não só, mas também outras áreas da cultura e da vida de uma forma geral, promovendo uma espécie de estetização da solidão. rebranding
