author: Mario Trujillo
title: Court Should Curb Abuse of Grand Jury Subpoenas Targeting Social Media Users
content:
A federal appeals court should curb the government’s abuse of grand jury subpoenas to unmask social media users who criticize lawless immigration enforcement.


That is the message from the ACLU, EFF, and other civil liberties and trade groups who filed

a friend-of-the-court brief

 in a sealed case in the U.S. Court of Appeals for the District of Columbia.


The case involves

 the government’s investigation of an anonymous Reddit user who commented on a post about an immigration officer in Minnesota. The Department of Homeland Security (DHS) first issued an administrative subpoena to Reddit to unmask the user. When the user challenged the subpoena in court on free speech and statutory grounds (

as many others have

), DHS withdrew it. But then the government obtained a separate grand jury subpoena—a subpoena issued by a prosecutor to gather evidence to present to a grand jury before any criminal charges are filed—for much of the same information. The user then challenged the grand jury subpoena too, and the case is currently being appealed.


The right to speak anonymously is essential. It preserves privacy and shields critics from government retaliation. In the past year, the Department of Justice (DOJ) has issued grand jury subpoenas to social media companies for their users’ personal data. This is frequently done for improper purposes and without really showing that social media users have committed any crime. These subpoenas have the effect of intimidating and chilling critics, as immigration authorities have engaged in

invasive

,

unconstitutional

, and

sometimes violent conduct

.


As the amicus brief makes clear, courts should not defer to the government’s claims regarding the legitimacy of using grand jury subpoenas to unmask internet users. Instead, the subpoenas must receive proper First Amendment scrutiny. Like many other types of legal processes, grand jury subpoenas are issued by federal officials without prior court approval. And they too can be abused to harass or retaliate against people critical of the government.


The amicus brief was filed in early September and recently unsealed. The brief was signed by the American Civil Liberties Union of DC, EFF, the Center for Individual Rights, the Foundation for Individual Rights and Expression, the Cato Institute, and NetChoice.


It is notable that NetChoice signed the amicus brief. It is a trade group that represents many companies who have received similar subpoenas including Reddit, Google, Meta, PayPal, among others.

EFF has called on these companies

 to do more to defend their users’ speech and privacy rights in the face of these subpoenas.

author: Λουκάς Σταμέλλος
title: Η υπεράσπιση ενός βασανισμού
content:
Σύνδεσμος δημοσίευσης:

Η υπεράσπιση ενός βασανισμού


Οι αστυνομικοί στην Ελλάδα δεν δικάζονται συχνά με την κατηγορία των βασανιστηρίων. Ακόμα πιο σπάνια οι δίκες για τέτοιες υποθέσεις καταλήγουν σε καταδίκες. Και όταν φτάνουν να καταδικαστούν, οι ποινές δεν έχουν «επαρκή αποτρεπτικό χαρακτήρα», όπως

έχει κριθεί από το Ευρωπαϊκό Δικαστήριο Δικαιωμάτων του Ανθρώπου

 σε μια σχετικά πρόσφατη υπόθεση.


Οι

έξι αστυνομικοί που δικάζονται στο Μικτό Ορκωτό Δικαστήριο της Καρδίτσας

 κατηγορούνται για τον βασανισμό του Βασίλειου Μάγγου στις 14 Ιουνίου 2020, στο πλαίσιο παράνομης κατακράτησης («προσαγωγή» για δήθεν «επίθεση στη μεταγωγή» η οποία όμως δεν έγινε σύλληψη) στο μέγαρο της Διεύθυνσης Αστυνομίας Βόλου.


Οι αστυνομικοί της ΟΠΚΕ ξυλοκόπησαν τον Βασίλειο Μάγγο έξω από τα δικαστήρια Βόλου, απ’ όπου προσήχθη. Από εκείνη την ώρα, λίγο μετά τις 4 το απόγευμα, για περίπου μιάμιση ώρα ή μία ώρα και τρία τέταρτα, μέχρι τις 6, βρισκόταν στα χέρια των αστυνομικών στο αστυνομικό μέγαρο.


Την Πέμπτη 19 Οκτωβρίου, η εισαγγελέας της έδρας του Μικτού Ορκωτού Δικαστηρίου Καρδίτσας θα προτείνει

 ενοχή ή απαλλαγή για καθένα από τους έξι αστυνομικούς που κατηγορούνται.


Στις 2 Οκτωβρίου 2026 το δικαστήριο διάβασε τα αναγνωστέα έγγραφα, στις 5 και 8 Οκτωβρίου εξέτασε μάρτυρες υπεράσπισης, ενώ στις 12 Οκτωβρίου απολογήθηκαν οι έξι κατηγορούμενοι αστυνομικοί.


Τι συνιστά βασανισμό;


Περίπου στις έξι το απόγευμα της 14/6/2020, μια παρέα που πήγε στο αστυνομικό μέγαρο να αφήσει τηλεκάρτα και κάποια άλλα πράγματα στον κρατούμενο Θ.Σ., συλληφθέντα από τη διαδήλωση της 13/6/2020 ενάντια στην καύση σκουπιδιών, εντόπισε τον Βασίλειο Μάγγο να κάθεται καταρρακωμένος στην άκρη του δρόμου. Δεν μπορούσε να αναπνεύσει από τους πόνους. Ήταν πολύ ταραγμένος. Δεν ήθελε να πάει στο νοσοκομείο για να μη βρεθεί «από το ένα τρελοκομείο στο άλλο», όπως τους είπε. Τον πήγαν κοντά στο σπίτι του, όπου τον παρέλαβε η σύντροφός του κι ένας φίλος του. Οι γονείς του τον έπεισαν να πάει στο νοσοκομείο, όπως κι έγινε. Εκεί νοσηλεύτηκε για τρεις μέρες με έξι σπασμένα πλευρά, θλάση στο ήπαρ και εσωτερική αιμορραγία. Στο τέλος της νοσηλείας του δημοσίευσε την καταγγελία που είχε γράψει για ό,τι είχε συμβεί και μέσα στο αυτοκίνητο της «προσαγωγής του», αλλά και μέσα στο αστυνομικό μέγαρο του Βόλου.


Αυτά κατέθεσαν στο δικαστήριο

οι άνθρωποι που τον βρήκαν

 έξω από το αστυνομικό μέγαρο,

οι φίλοι του

,

οι γονείς του

 και

οι γιατροί

 που ήταν υπεύθυνοι για τη νοσηλεία του.


Αλλά ποια είναι τα βασικά στοιχεία που συνιστούν βασανισμό με την έννοια του νόμου;


Το άρθρο 137Α του Ποινικού Κώδικα αναφέρει:


1. Υπάλληλος ή στρατιωτικός, στα καθήκοντα του οποίου ανάγεται η δίωξη, η ανάκριση ή η εξέταση αξιόποινων πράξεων ή πειθαρχικών παραπτωμάτων ή η εκτέλεση ποινών ή η φύλαξη ή η επιμέλεια κρατουμένων, τιμωρείται με κάθειρξη έως δέκα έτη, εάν υποβάλλει σε βασανιστήρια κατά την εκτέλεση αυτών των καθηκόντων πρόσωπο που βρίσκεται στην εξουσία του

με σκοπό:

 α) να αποσπάσει από αυτό ή από τρίτο πρόσωπο ομολογία, κατάθεση, πληροφορία

ή δήλωση ιδίως αποκήρυξης ή αποδοχής πολιτικής ή άλλης ιδεολογίας

, β) να το

τιμωρήσει

 ή γ) να

εκφοβίσει

 αυτό ή τρίτα πρόσωπα. Με την ίδια ποινή τιμωρείται υπάλληλος ή στρατιωτικός, που με εντολή των προϊσταμένων του ή αυτοβούλως σφετερίζεται τέτοια καθήκοντα και τελεί τις πράξεις του προηγούμενου εδαφίου.

Βασανιστήρια συνιστούν

title: ABD ara seçimleri: Yenilgiye yürüyen Trump, Kongre'yle savaşa hazırlanıyor
content:
ABD Başkanı Donald Trump, 24 Ekim'de Georgia eyaletinde düzenlenen Cumhuriyetçi Parti seçim mitinginde İran savaşının Amerikan petrol şirketlerine nasıl büyük paralar kazandırdığından söz ederken danışmanlarının, bu konulara girmemesi için kendisini uyardığını anlattı.


Danışmanları, Başkana, halk benzin istasyonlarında durmadan yükselen fiyatlarla boğuşurken petrol şirketlerinin kazancıyla övünmesinin tepki çekeceğini hatırlatmıştı. Trump, bunlara hiç aldırmadan konuşmayı sürdüreceğini söyledi:


“Zerre kadar umurumda değil. Söyleyeceğim. Deli gibi servet kazanıyoruz." 


Trump, yükselen petrol fiyatları sayesinde ABD'nin zenginleştiğini savundu; fiyatların yakında düşeceğini vaat etti. Ancak Trump'ın petrol şirketleri açısından kazanç saydığı gelişme, milyonlarca Amerikalı için geçim sıkıntısının başlıca nedenlerinden biri olmaya devam ediyor ve pompada benzin fiyatı düşmüyor.


Amerikan Otomobil Birliğinin (AAA) 28 Ekim verilerine göre benzinin litresi ortalama 1,12 dolar. İran savaşından önce yüzde 40 daha düşüktü. Dizelin litresi ise 1,68 dolara ulaştı. Bu fiyatlar muazzam vergi yüküyle oluşan Türkiye'deki karşılıklarının altındaysa da, iki yakasını bir araya getirmekte zorlanan ABD tüketicileri açısından giderleri üzerine binen katlanılmaz bir yük halini alıyor. 


Yüksek akaryakıt fiyatları yalnızca otomobil sahiplerinin ulaşım masraflarını değil, nakliyeyi, tarımsal üretimi ve tüketim mallarının fiyatlarını da etkiliyor.


Demokratlar anketlerde önde, Kongre'nin geleceği belirsiz


Gelecek hafta, 3 Kasım Salı günü Temsilciler Meclisi'nin 435 sandalyesinin tamamı ve Senato'daki 35 sandalye için seçim yapılacak. Cumhuriyetçiler her iki meclisteki çoğunluklarını korumaya, Demokratlar ise Trump yönetimi üzerinde etkili bir Kongre denetimi kurmaya çalışıyor.


26 Ekim'de tamamlanan Reuters/Ipsos araştırmasında Trump'ın görevini onaylayanların oranı yüzde 32. Kayıtlı seçmenlerin yüzde 47'si Demokrat, yüzde 36'sı Cumhuriyetçi Kongre adaylarına oy vereceğini belirtiyor.


Ancak ülke çapındaki toplam oy üstünlüğü doğrudan Kongre'ye gönderilecek temsilci çoğunluğuna denk gelmiyor. ABD Temsilciler Meclisi'ne gidecek üyeler seçim bölgelerinin sınırlarına bağlı, her seçim bölgesi aynı sayıda seçmen barındırmıyor. Senatoda ise yalnızca belirli eyaletlerde seçim yapılması sonuçlar üzerinde belirleyici olabiliyor. 


Cumhuriyetçiler halen 100 üyeli Senato'da 53'e karşı 47 ile çoğunlukta. Demokratların bu mecliste çoğunluğu ele geçirmesi için net 4 sandalye daha kazanması gerekiyor.


Partiler özellikle Maine, Kuzey Carolina, Ohio, Iowa ve Teksas gibi kritik eyaletlerde yoğun kampanyalar yürütüyor. Seçim gözlemcileri, Temsilciler Meclisi'nde Demokratların kazanımlar elde edebileceği bir ortamın varlığından söz ederken Senato yarışlarının sonucuna ilişkin belirsizlik sürüyor.


İran savaşının 47 milyar dolarlık faturası


Cumhuriyetçilerin karşı karşıya olduğu en önemli sorunlardan başında, ABD ve İsrail'in 28 Şubat'ta İran'a saldırmasıyla başlayan savaşın ekonomik ve siyasi sonuçları geliyor. 


Reuters'ın 28 Ekim'de açıkladığı Pentagon hesaplarına göre savaşın doğrudan askerî maliyeti 47 milyar doları aştı. Bunun 29 milyar dolarından fazlası, kullanılan mühimmatın yenilenmesi ve 6 milyar dolardan fazlası, kaybedilen veya hasar gören askerî araçların yerine konması için gerekli. 


Bu hesaba savaşın küresel enerji piyasalarında yol açtığı fiyat artışları dahil değil.


Nisanda varılan ateşkes, kalıcı bir barış anlaşmasına dönüşmedi. ABD'nin İran'a uyguladığı deniz ablukası sürerken, Trump yönetimi yeni bir askerî operasyon olasılığını da gündemde tutuyor.


Trump, 8 Ekim'de, seçimlerden önce yeni bir saldırı düzenlemeyeceğini açıklamıştı. Ancak 28 Ekim'de bu seçim sonrasında İran'a yeniden saldırılıp saldırılmayacağı sorulduğunda “Her şey mümkün” yanıtını verdi.


Bu koşullar altında ABD seçmenleri, süre giden savaşın sonuçlanmadığı ve yeniden tırmanma olasılığının ortadan kalkmadığı bir dönemde sandığa gidiyor olacak.


ABD Çalışma İstatistikleri Bürosuna göre eylülde yıllık tüketici enflasyonu yüzde 3,7'ye ulaştı. Enerji fiyatları bir yıl içinde yüzde 20,4, benzin fiyatları ise yüzde 34,2 arttı.


İran savaşı böylece dış politika tartışmalarını aşarak Amerikalı ailelerinin günlük harcamalarına ve seçim tercihlerine doğrudan yansıyor.


Rusya'yla uzlaşmanın arkasındaki enerji hesabı


İran savaşının enerji piyasalarına etkisi, Trump'ın Ukrayna savaşına ilişkin girişimlerinde de hissediliyor.

author: labor4pal
title: ICE Is Running One of the Largest Anti-Left Surveillance Operations in US History (Wired)
content:
ICE’s Homeland Security Investigations is engaged in far-reaching spying against left-wing activists that rivals the FBI and CIA crackdowns on the Civil Rights and anti-war movements.

Attorneys for 15 Minnesota residents facing federal conspiracy charges have obtained evidence of a sweeping, possibly unconstitutional spying operation carried out by Immigration and Customs Enforcement against left-wing social movements in Minnesota and beyond.

The high-profile Minnesota 15 prosecution makes clear that the Department of Homeland Security (DHS), flush with federal funds and newly hired personnel, is now President Donald Trump’s primary tool against dissent, with a powerful array of post-9/11 investigative authorities brought to bear against everyday Americans organizing their communities.

Nothing of this scale has been seen in the United States, experts say, since the federal government’s counterinsurgency against the New Left and the anti-war movement in the 1960s and 1970s.

Among the records revealed during the discovery process in these cases are dozens of reports, audio transcripts, emails, intercepted Signal chats, photographs, database queries, and more. They reveal the inner workings of the domestic terrorism investigations, running under the names Project Whipple Shield and Operation Puppet Master, authorized by the controversial National Security Presidential Memorandum 7.

Published following Charlie Kirk’s assassination in September of last year, NSPM 7 instructs federal law enforcement to use every tool available against organizations and people who criticize the administration’s policies and espouse “anti-Christian” ideas. The full scope and extent of the investigations it authorizes remains unknown.

Defense attorneys for the Minnesota 15 claim that the prosecution stems from a broader nationwide surveillance operation aimed at opponents of the Trump administration’s immigration policies. One attorney in the case directly compares the DHS-run campaign to the FBI’s infamous Counterintelligence Program, or COINTELPRO, which unconstitutionally surveilled, infiltrated, and blackmailed racial justice, civil rights, and anti-war movements from the 1950s through the early 1970s.

Three former law enforcement officials who reviewed filings concur, telling WIRED that the case is almost certainly part of a wider intelligence-gathering operation that began long before the administration invaded Minnesota in December 2025.

Dueling motions in the case over discovery of DHS’s surveillance program reveal that personnel with Homeland Security Investigations—one of ICE’s two components—repurposed funding mechanisms and investigative tools for serious criminal probes and turned them on domestic dissenters. Operation Keyhole, the HSI undercover program that bankrolled the Minnesota 15 prosecution, dates back to 2008. As of June 2026, it was underwriting a half dozen active undercover investigations in the Minneapolis–Saint Paul area.

Around 120 HSI agents, many drawn from specialized units across the country that have served as the leading edge of the administration’s militarized immigration enforcement operations, were assigned to the case—including 11 undercovers. They used highly invasive surveillance techniques, including the deployment of Reaper drones and Patriot Act tools usually restricted to money laundering and terrorism investigations. Undercover operatives also infiltrated churches in apparent violation of a court order.

The Minnesota 15 indictment stems from the Trump administration’s demand that the Justice Department “go big and go loud” to crack down on community response networks during last winter’s Operation Metro Surge. Twin Cities activists organized volunteers to monitor DHS agents and their vehicles using encrypted Signal groups, homebuilt vehicle databases, and a centralized dispatch system. Government prosecutors claim that this amounts to a criminal conspiracy to block immigration enforcement, unlawfully identify and stalk federal agents, and even assault them.

Their defense attorneys say the heavy charges filed against the Minnesota 15 don’t align with their alleged conduct. “This is the first time I’ve had a client who’s accused of a conspiracy and went on a speaking tour,” says Kevin Riach, who represents defendant Isaac Sant.

author: Theia Chatelle
title: High Palestinian Turnout in Israeli Elections Came Down to Matters of Survival
content:
“We fear that if we do not get this government out of power, we will lose everything,” one Palestinian voter said.

Truthout is an indispensable resource for activists, movement leaders and workers everywhere. Please make this work possible with a quick donation.

Jaffa, Israel — Outside of Ahva Elementary School in Ajami, a historic Palestinian neighborhood just south of central Tel Aviv, the mood was defiant on October 27, the day of Israel’s national elections. “We fear that if we do not get this government out of power, we will lose everything,” one Palestinian voter told me after casting her ballot.

It came as no surprise that she, like most of the Palestinian citizens of Israel I interviewed on Election Day, asked not to be named. Since October 7, 2023, more than 400 Palestinian citizens of Israel have been investigated by police for “incitement,” often over social media posts, according to the legal rights group Adalah.

During the 1948 war, which Palestinians call the Nakba, most of Jaffa’s nearly 100,000 Palestinian residents fled or were expelled. The fewer than 4,000 who remained were concentrated in Ajami, fenced in with barbed wire, where they lived under Israeli military rule until 1949.

Just weeks ago, it was not clear that the parties most Palestinian citizens of Israel vote for would even appear on the ballot. In September, Israel’s Central Elections Committee, a body of party representatives, voted to disqualify both Arab parties — which are led by and draw most of their votes from Palestinian citizens of Israel — from running in the election. The Joint List is an alliance of three parties running together to clear the 3.25 percent threshold needed to enter the Knesset.

Hadash, a left-wing party with roots in Israel’s Communist Party, is the only one of the three with both Jewish and Palestinian members. Ta’al’s platform has historically focused on the rights of Palestinian citizens of Israel. Balad, a Palestinian nationalist party, calls for Israel to become a state of all its citizens, with equal rights for everyone.

The other party, running independently, is Ra’am, a conservative Islamist party led by Mansour Abbas, which in 2021 became the first Arab party to join an Israeli governing coalition.

The two Arab parties were eventually reinstated and allowed to run in the Israeli election, but only after an appeal to Israel’s Supreme Court.

As Israelis vote to elect the country’s 26th parliament (Knesset), Palestinian voters in the Ajami neighborhood said Gaza was at the top of their minds. Just down the road is a public memorial displaying photos of some of the more than 20,000 children who have, according to a UN commission, been killed by the Israeli military in Gaza since October 7, 2023.

The memorial, at Hajj Kahil Square, has been torn down more than once. In May, according to Bokra, a Palestinian news site, two men, one of them carrying a rifle, ripped the photos from the walls. The next day, Jaffa residents put them back up and renamed the traffic circle the “Gaza Children’s Roundabout.” Police, who ultimately answer to Itamar Ben-Gvir, Israel’s far right minister of national security, have also tried to stop protesters from displaying the images.

Whether or not to participate in Israel’s national elections has long been a fraught topic among Palestinian citizens of Israel.

Whether or not to participate in Israel’s national elections has long been a fraught topic among Palestinian citizens of Israel. Some fear that voting in the election would lend legitimacy to a state that expelled most of their families in 1948 and maintains a military occupation over Palestinians in the West Bank, and that human rights groups say has committed genocide in Gaza; but others view it as their only way to gather power in the Knesset, especially more than three years after October 7.

An unprecedented wave of homicides in the community has also pushed many to the polls. At least 184 Palestinian citizens of Israel have been killed this year, putting 2026 on pace to surpass last year’s record of 252, according to the Abraham Initiatives. Police filed indictments in just 12 percent of homicides in Palestinian communities by June 2026, compared with a historic rate of indictments in 65 percent of cases involving homicides committed against Jewish Israelis.

title: Správa o aktivitách počas Medzinárodného týždňa proti nevyplácaniu miezd (2026)
content:
Cieľom „Týždňa“ je poukázať na nevyplácanie miezd a ukázať, ako sa dá proti tomu brániť. Potešilo nás, že tento rok sa zvýšil počet participujúcich a že sa medzi nimi prvýkrát objavili organizácie z Ázie, Južnej Ameriky a Kanady. Väčšinou išlo o propagačné aktivity online a v uliciach, ale uskutočnili sa aj stretnutia pracujúcich, protestné akcie či workshopy. Pre lepšie zobrazenie článku odporúčame pozrieť tu:

https://priamaakcia.sk/sprava-o-aktivitach-pocas-medzinarodneho-tyzdna-proti-nevyplacaniu-miezd-2026.html


PA (Slovensko)


Zväz Priama akcia pripravil pred Týždňom a počas neho viaceré aktivity v Bratislave.


Zverejnili sme článok o Týždni ako takom a vyzvali sme ľudí, aby sa podelili o svoje skúsenosti a problémy.


Ozvalo sa nám niekoľko pracujúcich s otázkami týkajúcimi sa nevyplatených peňazí v prípade živnostníkov, kontaktovania zo strany nadriadených ohľadom pracovných záležitostí počas pracovného voľna a venovali sme sa aj problému zahraničného zamestnanca, ktorý si chcel overiť správnosť vyplatenej mzdy.


Zorganizovali sme tiež stretnutie venované nevyplácaniu miezd

, ktoré zopakujeme aj v novembri.


V uliciach Bratislavy sa tiež objavili nálepky PA. Jedným z miest bolo aj okolie 3 The Clubhouse, čo je podnik prepojený s ľuďmi okolo VegaNany, s ktorými vedieme spor o nevyplatené mzdy. K sporu sme uverejnili článok s novinkami

https://priamaakcia.sk/veganana-dalsi-prehraty-sud-nove-dlhy-ai-slop-a-nevyplatene-mzdy.html

. Pre viac informácií pozri

https://priamaakcia.sk/tag/veganana

.


ZSP (Poľsko)


Viaceré aktivity uskutočnil aj Zväz syndikalistov Poľska.


Už nejaký čas bojuje proti firmám ako Ochrona Mega Marcin Kowalski a Protego, ktoré vlastní jedna rodina. Po protestoch a priamych akciách týkajúcich sa nevyplácania miezd skončili niektoré prípady na súde a bolo vynesených niekoľko rozsudkov v prospech pracujúcich. ZSP už dávnejšie poukazoval na fakt, že spoločnosť Ochrona Mega Marcin Kowalski dostala veľkú sumu peňazí od štátnej agentúry, ktorá poskytuje zamestnávateľom dotácie na zamestnávanie osôb so zdravotným postihnutím.


Po proteste ZSP, na ktorom zväz požadoval, aby podniky, ktoré nevyplácajú mzdy, nedostávali príspevky z verejných zdrojov a aby sa začalo vyšetrovanie, agentúra dotácie zastavila. Druhá dobrá správa prišla 19. októbra – štátna agentúra bude od firmy žiadať vrátenie dotácií vo výške 3 miliónov zlotých (takmer 700 tisíc eur).


Zväz nahral aj video o Týždni, v ktorom zdôraznil, že úrady by mali ukončiť činnosť firiem, ktoré nevyplácajú mzdy. Aktivity za dosiahnutie tohto cieľa budú pokračovať.


V uliciach a pri podnikoch, proti ktorým v minulosti prebehli kampane za nevyplácanie miezd, sa objavili aj tematické plagáty.


ZSP tiež preložil do španielčiny brožúru o nevyplácaní miezd pre workshop, ktorý sa konal 24. októbra pre španielsky hovoriacich pracujúcich v Poľsku.


SF (Británia)


Federácia solidarity rozšírila informácie a protestovala proti workfare. Ide o systém, ktorý núti príjemcov sociálnych dávok vykonávať neplatenú prácu, ak si chcú zachovať nárok na tieto dávky. Podľa SF ide o priamy útok korporácií a štátu na celú pracujúcu triedu a nie iba iniciatívu zameranú na odbornú prípravu. SF proti tomuto systému viedla kampaň už aj v minulosti, pozri napríklad

https://priamaakcia.sk/Dolezity-uspech-kampane-proti-workfare--priame-akcie-prinutili-Holland--Barrett-vystupit-zo-systemu.html

. Prvky podobné workfare platia od 1. 9. 2025 aj na Slovensku (pozri kritické zhodnotenie napríklad tu:

https://www.amnesty.sk/ziadost-o-vetovanie-zakona-meniaceho-podmienkypristupu-k-pomoci-v-hmotnej-nudzi/

).


V septembri bol v Británii spustený nový program s názvom Opening Shift, v podstate je to však len nový názov pre rovnaké politiky ako v prípade workfare. Cieľom programu je umiestniť viac ako 100 000 mladých ľudí vo veku 18-24 rokov na dvoj- až štvortýždňové stáže v britských maloobchodných reťazcoch, ako sú napríklad Tesco, John Lewis, Marks & Spencer, Costa Coffee atď. Za túto prácu nedostávajú mzdu, ale musia ju robiť, inak by nedostali dávky. Vláda takto v podstate poskytuje korporáciám bezplatnú pracovnú silu, čo zhoršuje možnosť nájsť si platené zamestnanie.


Skupina SF v Liverpoole zorganizovala akcie proti firmám, ktoré sú súčasťou programu Opening Shift.


CNT-AIT (Francúzsko)


Začiatkom októbra navštívila miestnu organizáciu Národnej konfederácie práce v Toulouse skupina pracujúcich z jednej upratovacej spoločnosti. Chceli sa poradiť, ako …
